categories.description: Agriculture and food statistics: crop and livestock production, producer prices, trade, food balances, food security, land use, fertilizers and agrifood emissions.
Machine-learning models and datasets: cards, licenses, downloads, tasks, tags and files.
Mobile apps on the Apple App Store and Google Play: listings, ratings, review counts, charts, reviews and version history.
Cars for sale: dealer and private-seller inventory, listing details and book values.
Company records, filings, funding and firmographics.
Developer documentation, repositories, code and agent skills.
Website traffic, audience, search marketing and competitive digital intelligence.
Energy statistics: official supply, demand, generation, emissions and price series from agencies such as the IEA.
Films, TV shows, books and games: ratings, cast, release dates, reading lists.
Market prices, financial statements, ownership and macro rates.
Government programs and records: federal funding and procurement opportunities, eligibility, who is buying what and when responses are due.
Population health statistics: life expectancy, mortality, disease burden, immunization coverage, risk factors, health systems and WASH by country, region and year.
Healthcare providers and facilities: identifiers, specialties, licenses, practice locations and official registry records.
Job postings: who is hiring for which roles, where, and since when.
Encyclopedic and reference knowledge: articles, facts about entities, definitions and their sources.
Marketing research: website traffic, search interest and trends, audience insights, creator discovery and podcast sponsorships.
Reported news: articles, wires and the archives behind them.
The people at companies: who they are, what they do, and how to reach them.
Local businesses and places: what is near an address, with hours, phone, address, website, rating and review count.
What was said on a podcast: episodes, transcripts, guests and sponsors.
Political-science research data: democracy and regime indices per country-year, their codebooks, uncertainty bounds and dataset releases.
Property records and home valuation comparables.
Scientific papers, abstracts, relevant full-text passages and citation relationships.
Restaurant locations, opening hours, menus, prices and product options.
Products, prices, sizes, availability and customer reviews.
Website instructions and source files for agents and browser interactions.
Public social media accounts: profiles, follower counts, posts, hashtags, boards and pins.
Open-source packages: registry metadata, versions, licences, download counts and dependents on npm, PyPI, crates.io and Maven Central.
Sports federations and circuits: tournament calendars, match results and player rankings.
Travel: hotels, their guest ratings, rankings in a destination and public reviews.

adstransparency-google-com.name: Google Ads Transparency Center
adstransparency-google-com.description: Google Ads Transparency Center: resolve advertisers, list their ads by region, format, platform and date, read creative details (dates, previews, EU DSA and political impression/spend ranges, targeting), advertiser profiles, political ads insights and geo criterion lookups, from the site's own anonymous RPC endpoints.

aer-ca.name: Alberta Energy Regulator (aer.ca)
aer-ca.description: Alberta Energy Regulator public site: paginated listings of directives, bulletins, hearing / regulatory appeal / procedural decisions, notices, statistical (ST) reports and news releases (Drupal views tables with keyword filter), directive and bulletin detail pages (release and effective dates, PDF, body text, cross-references), Public Notice of Application and Publication of Decision records by application number (static notice bodies behind webapps.aer.ca), and the AddSearch-powered site search. Everything is anonymous server-rendered HTML or a public JSON search API; no login, token or antibot is involved.

afcd-foodstandards-gov-au.name: Australian Food Composition Database (AFCD, FSANZ)
afcd-foodstandards-gov-au.description: Food Standards Australia New Zealand's Australian Food Composition Database (AFCD Release 3.0, December 2025), the reference nutrient database for Australia: about 1,600 foods with up to 268 nutrients each (proximates, minerals, vitamins, fatty acids, amino acids, organic acids) per 100 g, with derivation and sampling notes, AUSNUT classification and food groups. Food search by name, letter or group, the complete nutrient profile of one food by Public Food Key, the food group hierarchy, the foods of a sub group, the nutrient catalogue and every food ranked by one nutrient. Anonymous JSON API behind the public AFCD search pages on www.foodstandards.gov.au (afcd.foodstandards.gov.au redirects there). Licence: CC BY 4.0, attribution 'Food Standards Australia New Zealand'; some borrowed values cite third-party sources (USDA, NZ FCD).

alibaba.name: Alibaba wholesale products
alibaba.description: Public wholesale product and supplier discovery, quantity pricing and specifications. Advertised facts, not live inventory or landed-cost quotes.

allbirds-com.name: Allbirds
allbirds-com.description: Explore Allbirds collections, product suggestions, size-level offers and published materials/care details.

alternativeto-net.name: AlternativeTo
alternativeto-net.description: AlternativeTo (alternativeto.net): crowd-sourced software catalog. Search apps, list alternatives to an app with platform/license/feature filters, browse the catalog by tag, and read an app's full public record (license, pricing, platforms, features, links, GitHub and App Store stats, ratings and reviews). Anonymous, read-only, English.

amazon-com.name: Amazon US
amazon-com.description: Amazon US public product details, photos, specifications, variants, displayed review totals, individual customer reviews with rating distribution, search, suggestions, Best Sellers lists, featured offers, sellers, stock and batch prices.

amtrak-com.name: Amtrak
amtrak-com.description: Amtrak (US national passenger rail) read-only: station directory and search with addresses, hours and amenities; named routes with ordered stops and train numbers; live train positions and stop-by-stop status decrypted from the public Track Your Train feed. Public feeds of www.amtrak.com and maps.amtrak.com, no login. Fares, schedules by date and booking are not covered (the /dotcom/ APIs sit behind Akamai Bot Manager).

answerthepublic-com.name: AnswerThePublic
answerthepublic-com.description: AnswerThePublic (answerthepublic.com) Free Market Research: the public catalog of brand keyword collections and, for every keyword in it, the pre-computed questions, prepositions, comparisons, alphabetical, number and related search suggestions with Google search volume and cost per click, from the site's own public JSON API. Ad-hoc keyword search is not covered: it needs a Cloudflare Turnstile token and is capped at one anonymous search per IP per day.

api-exchange-coinbase-com.name: Coinbase Exchange
api-exchange-coinbase-com.description: Public market data from the Coinbase Exchange REST API (api.exchange.coinbase.com): trading pairs, tickers with 24h stats, aggregated order books, tick-level trades with cursor pagination, historical OHLCV candles from 1 minute to 1 day walked in 300-bucket windows, exchange-wide volume summary, currencies with networks, and wrapped-asset conversion rates. Anonymous endpoints only; no trading or account access.

api-weather-gov.name: National Weather Service API (api.weather.gov)
api-weather-gov.description: NWS watches, warnings and advisories (active and last ~7 days) and daily/hourly forecasts for a GeoJSON geometry in the United States: the land contract shared with the other land programs (geometry in; spatial_precision, sources, missing and a location echo out).

apollo.name: Apollo
apollo.description: Person and company enrichment: find people by title and company, resolve them to verified work emails, and enrich companies from a domain with funding, headcount and technologies.

apps-apple-com.name: Apple App Store
apps-apple-com.description: Apple App Store listings from Apple's own catalog and iTunes APIs: app detail with per-device compatibility (iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple Vision), prices and in-app purchase/subscription prices, version history and ratings; paginated customer reviews; keyword search; top charts by genre; a developer's apps.

apps-fcc-gov.name: FCC OET Equipment Authorization System (apps.fcc.gov)
apps-fcc-gov.description: The FCC Office of Engineering and Technology's Equipment Authorization System (EAS) public reports at apps.fcc.gov/oetcf: equipment authorization search by FCC ID, grantee, applicant, grant date and technical filters; the exhibits (test reports, photos, manuals, with confidentiality flags and attachment ids) and the Form 731 grant of one filing; grantee registration search; the TCB list and the accredited test firm list. Server-rendered ColdFusion HTML, anonymous, stateless (no cookies or tokens required).

aptoide-com.name: Aptoide
aptoide-com.description: Android app metadata from Aptoide: search packages, inspect app permissions, downloads, ratings and signing certificates, and read version history.

arcgis-com.name: ArcGIS public GIS layers
arcgis-com.description: Public government GIS data published on Esri ArcGIS (parcels, zoning, flood zones, permits, addresses, boundaries, parks, utilities and similar layers) through the documented, keyless ArcGIS REST APIs every ArcGIS web map uses: ArcGIS Online / Hub catalog search, FeatureServer and MapServer service and layer metadata, and attribute and spatial queries. Works with layers hosted on ArcGIS Online (services*.arcgis.com) and on any agency's own ArcGIS Server; every response is verified to be ArcGIS service data, and token-protected services are never accessed.

arditicollection-com.name: Arditi Collection
arditicollection-com.description: Arditi Collection (arditicollection.com) luxury furniture catalogue: collections, product listings, product detail with USD prices and specifications, predictive search and recommendations from the public Shopify storefront JSON routes.

artificialanalysis-ai.name: Artificial Analysis
artificialanalysis-ai.description: Artificial Analysis LLM benchmarks: model and reasoning-effort records with Intelligence Index, benchmark scores, cost per task, list prices, output speed and latency, plus per-model and leaderboard-wide API provider endpoint benchmarks.

arxiv-org.name: arXiv
arxiv-org.description: arXiv e-print repository: paper search and per-paper metadata through the export.arxiv.org Atom API, category and archive listings, BibTeX export, OAI-PMH metadata harvesting by date window and set, and the list of harvestable sets. Anonymous, no session.

assembly-ab-ca.name: Legislative Assembly of Alberta
assembly-ab-ca.description: Legislative Assembly of Alberta (assembly.ab.ca): bills and their reading history with Hansard page references, Hansard and Votes and Proceedings sitting lists with the official PDF links, committee meeting transcripts, the Hansard speaker and subject indexes, and MLAs. Server-rendered public pages, no login.

auc-ab-ca.name: Alberta Utilities Commission
auc-ab-ca.description: Alberta Utilities Commission (auc.ab.ca) public regulatory record: the decisions, recent updates, notices, facility approvals, gas pipeline licence and monthly rate approval tables with eFiling document ids, the public PDF of any decision or notice with its extracted text, proceedings currently under review, featured (high-profile) applications, the hearing and events calendar, and the site's full-text search over decision PDFs and pages. Proceedings' party lists and exhibit indexes sit behind the eFiling login and are not covered.

auction-com.name: Auction.com
auction-com.description: Auction.com residential real-estate auctions (US): search foreclosure, bank-owned and other auction listings by state, city, county or ZIP, read listing details, third-party valuation and comparables, live bid state, and location suggestions, from the site's own anonymous GraphQL API.

auctions-yahoo-co-jp.name: Yahoo! Auctions Japan
auctions-yahoo-co-jp.description: Yahoo! Auctions (ヤフオク!) open and closed listing search with sold-price statistics, item detail with shipping fees and related items, seller profiles, category/brand/price facets and keyword suggestions, from the site's own JSON API.

auctiontime-com.name: AuctionTime
auctiontime-com.description: AuctionTime.com (Sandhills Global) online equipment auctions: search upcoming lots and auction results by keyword, category, manufacturer, model and state; one lot's specs, photos, seller and live bid snapshot; the upcoming auction calendar; one sale's catalog; the category directory.

authenticvintageposters-com.name: Authentic Vintage Posters
authenticvintageposters-com.description: Catalogue of original vintage posters, prints, labels and ads sold by Authentic Vintage Posters (Shopify storefront): product listing, search, collections and product detail with artist, size and condition.

autotrader-com.name: Autotrader
autotrader-com.description: Autotrader.com (Cox Automotive) US vehicle marketplace: search new, used and certified listings by location, make/model, year, price, mileage or one dealership (by dealer id or dealer website domain, with the dealer's new/used/certified inventory counts); read one listing with pricing, specifications, features and seller; resolve make/model names to codes; facet counts by model year, trim and city; model specifications by style id.

azroc-my-site-com.name: Arizona Registrar of Contractors license register (azroc.my.site.com)
azroc-my-site-com.description: Public contractor license register of the Arizona Registrar of Contractors (ROC), served by the AZRoc Salesforce Experience Cloud site at azroc.my.site.com/AZRoc/s/contractor-search. Search licensed contractors by business or person name, ROC license number, license classification and city; read a license record with its personnel, surety bonds and public complaint history; list the classification picklist and the official scope description of a license's classification. Anonymous guest access to the site's Aura Apex actions (class ARCP_ContractorSearch); no login, token or cookie is needed.

b3-com-br.name: B3 listed companies and indices
b3-com-br.description: B3 (Brasil, Bolsa, Balcão), the São Paulo exchange: listed-company registry search and enumeration, company detail with sector classification and financial summary, corporate actions, cash dividend history, CVM filings, index portfolios (IBOV, IBRX, SMLL, IDIV, IFIX...), stock-to-index membership, delayed quotes and the sector taxonomy. Public data, no credentials; Portuguese labels as B3 publishes them.

banks-data-fdic-gov.name: FDIC BankFind Suite
banks-data-fdic-gov.description: FDIC BankFind Suite (banks.data.fdic.gov), from its public keyless API at api.fdic.gov/banks: every FDIC-insured institution since 1934, current branch locations, quarterly Call Report financials since 1984, bank failures and assistance transactions since 1934, structure-change history, annual state and national banking aggregates, and the annual Summary of Deposits by branch since 1994. Filters, fuzzy name search, column projection, deterministic sort and offset pagination on every dataset.

baseballsavant-mlb-com.name: MLB Baseball Savant
baseballsavant-mlb-com.description: MLB Baseball Savant (Statcast): player name search and trending players, player bio by MLBAM id, per-plate-appearance game logs, pitch-by-pitch Statcast search over a date window, per-pitch-type summaries, season leaderboards (expected stats, exit velocity, sprint speed, outs above average, pitch arsenals) and the daily MLB schedule with win probability.

basketball-fantasysports-yahoo-com.name: Yahoo Fantasy Basketball (public)
basketball-fantasysports-yahoo-com.description: Yahoo Fantasy Basketball public data without a login: player search, a public league's player list with projected, total, average and standard-deviation stat windows and 9-category stats (FG%, FT%, 3PTM, PTS, REB, AST, ST, BLK, TO), Yahoo rank windows, public team rosters and the public Yahoo Sports player news index.

bbb-business-profiles-ratings-complaint.name: BBB business profiles
bbb-business-profiles-ratings-complaint.description: Better Business Bureau (bbb.org) business search, profiles with BBB letter grade and accreditation, complaint histories and customer reviews for the US and Canada.

bbb-org.name: Better Business Bureau
bbb-org.description: bbb.org business directory: search businesses by name/category and location across the US and Canada with rating and accreditation filters; read a full business profile with BBB letter grade, accreditation status and dates, complaint and review summaries, alerts and licences; list published complaints with business responses; resolve a pasted bbb.org URL or id to its canonical identity. Reads the server-rendered page state live on every call; bbb.org sits behind a Cloudflare managed challenge which the runner's solver clears.

bcb-gov-br.name: Banco Central do Brasil open data
bcb-gov-br.description: Banco Central do Brasil open data: SGS time series (Selic, CDI, IPCA, IGP-M, IBC-Br, USD/BRL and ~3,600 more series by code), PTAX official exchange rates (USD and other currencies, by date or date range), Focus market expectations (IPCA, Selic, PIB, cambio: median, mean, standard deviation, respondents), PIX statistics (by municipality, aggregate, registered keys, DICT users), retail credit rates by institution, SPI settlement and payment-instrument statistics, currency in circulation, plus discovery of Olinda OData services and of the dadosabertos.bcb.gov.br dataset catalogue. Anonymous JSON APIs; no key or session.

benzinga.name: Benzinga
benzinga.description: Real-time financial newswire and analyst coverage for US-listed companies: market-moving headlines, why-is-it-moving notes, press releases, ratings changes and consensus, announced deals, and unusual options activity.

bestbuy-com.name: Best Buy US
bestbuy-com.description: Public Best Buy US catalog, product details, prices, customer reviews and location-specific availability.

bid-cars.name: bid.cars
bid-cars.description: bid.cars, a public aggregator of US salvage and insurance auction lots from Copart and IAAI: active-lot search with the site's filters, sort and 50-per-page pagination, one lot's detail page (vehicle data, damage, documents, bidding state, sales history), the public sold comparables for a lot (the only anonymous source of final prices), and the make/model taxonomy with active lot counts. Anonymous, read-only; no bidding.

bidnetdirect-com.name: BidNet Direct
bidnetdirect-com.description: BidNet Direct (www.bidnetdirect.com), the US government bid portal of BidNet / mdf commerce: public solicitation search (keywords, state, NAICS-sector category, content group, publish window, sort, 25 rows per page) over open and closed bids, solicitation and statewide-notice detail pages (full public notice for closed BidNet-hosted solicitations including NIGP categories; open bids expose only title, location and dates because the rest is shown to registered members only), the location and category directories with live open-bid counts, and the first page of a purchasing group's participating agencies. Documents, plan-holder lists and member-only fields require a free vendor account and are not covered.

bilibili-com.name: Bilibili
bilibili-com.description: Bilibili (bilibili.com) public video metadata: video detail and batch verification by BV/av id, keyword search for videos and uploaders, uploader profiles and archive listings, comments and time-limited DASH stream URLs, all anonymous through the site's web JSON API with WBI request signing.

bing-com.name: Bing Maps
bing-com.description: Public Bing Maps local business search and structured business details.

bls-gov.name: BLS labor statistics
bls-gov.description: US Bureau of Labor Statistics time series: list surveys, discover series ids (curated Top Picks and full flat-file catalogs), read a series catalog page, and retrieve employment, wage, price and inflation observations from the keyless public API.

booking-com.name: Booking.com stays
booking-com.description: Booking.com accommodation: destination lookup, stay search by dates and guests with total prices, property details and policies, room availability with cancellation terms, guest reviews and surroundings, over Booking.com's public GraphQL endpoint.

branddb-wipo-int.name: WIPO Global Brand Database
branddb-wipo-int.description: WIPO Global Brand Database (branddb.wipo.int): search trademarks across 89 IP offices by brand name, owner, number, goods and services, Nice class, office, designation and status; read one record by its ST.13 number; goods and services term suggestions; per-office coverage and database-wide statistics. Public JSON API, no login.

branding.name: Website Branding
branding.description: Extract a website's logo, colors, fonts, typography and component styles through Firecrawl Scrape's branding format.

brevets-patents-ic-gc-ca.name: Canadian Patents Database (CIPO)
brevets-patents-ic-gc-ca.description: Canadian Intellectual Property Office patent database: keyword, fielded and date-range search over Canadian patents and applications, and the full bibliographic summary of one patent (titles, status, IPC, parties, dates, PCT and priority data, abstracts, claims and description text, event and fee history, owners on record, document list).

bsd-sos-mo-gov.name: Missouri Secretary of State business registry
bsd-sos-mo-gov.description: Missouri Secretary of State Business Services (bsd.sos.mo.gov) public business entity registry: search entities by business name or charter number, read an entity's registration record (names, type, charter number, domesticity, home state, status, formation date, duration, registered agent, filed documents with their public document links, principal office addresses, officers/owners/stock/contacts grids when the registry shows them) and read a registered agent's record with the entities it represents. Anonymous public access only; no certificates, orders or filings.

builtin-com.name: Built In
builtin-com.description: Technology job search, public role details and company profiles from Built In.

businessregistration-utah-gov.name: Utah business registry
businessregistration-utah-gov.description: Utah Division of Corporations and Commercial Code public business registry (businessregistration.utah.gov): search registered entities, DBAs and name reservations by name, entity number, principal or registered agent with status, type and formation-date filters; read an entity's registration record (identity, status, dates, registered agent, principals, addresses), its filing history, check a proposed name against the registry, and list the filter lookup values. Anonymous public access only; no Utah ID login, orders or filings.

california-dca-license.name: California DCA physician licenses
california-dca-license.description: Look up an exact California physician-and-surgeon license type, rank and number in the official DCA iServices API.

campspot-com.name: Campspot
campspot-com.description: Campspot campground marketplace (www.campspot.com): destination and park suggestions, dated park search by coordinates or place name with guest, pet, site-type, amenity and rating filters, park details and policies, per-park site-type availability and pricing for a date range, and the full park catalogue from the sitemap. Anonymous, read-only; nothing here books, holds or signs in.

cargurus-com.name: CarGurus
cargurus-com.description: CarGurus.com US used-car marketplace: search listings within a radius of a ZIP code (make/model/trim, price, year, mileage, body style, transmission, 11 sort orders, paginated), read one listing's full detail (price analysis, history, specifications, dealer), resolve free text to make/model/trim ontology ids, list makes and models, and read owner reviews for a model.

carsandbids-com.name: Cars & Bids
carsandbids-com.description: Cars & Bids (carsandbids.com) online car auctions: search live and past auctions, one auction's full listing with bids, photos and seller, its comments and bid history, search suggestions, member profiles with auction and bid histories, and similar auctions. Read-only, anonymous, via the site's own signed JSON API.

cbc-ca.name: CBC News (cbc.ca)
cbc-ca.description: CBC News, Canada's public broadcaster: keyword search across cbc.ca (GraphQL allSearchItems), section and region listings with a publish-date range (aggregate_api/v1/items), the full text of an article with its headline, byline, exact publish and last-updated instants and any correction or clarification notice (GraphQL contentItem), and a Canadian place lookup that resolves a city name to CBC's taxonomy path and regional slug.

cbssports-com.name: CBS Sports fantasy football and basketball
cbssports-com.description: CBS Sports (cbssports.com) NFL fantasy football and NBA fantasy basketball from its server-rendered pages. Football: weekly and rest-of-season projections and fantasy stats for every position in PPR and non-PPR scoring, and the weekly and draft rankings of its three fantasy experts. Basketball: season, rest-of-season and scoring-period projections, season, recent-day and scoring-period stats in CBS points scoring, and the RotoWire roto rankings. Anonymous.

census-gov.name: US Census Bureau
census-gov.description: Discover Census datasets, variables and geography codes, then retrieve published estimates, margins of error and counts with source annotations.

cftc.name: CFTC
cftc.description: Commitments of Traders: weekly futures and options positioning by trader category - speculators, hedgers, managed money, dealers, leveraged funds, index traders - for every reportable US futures market, from the CFTC.

cftc-gov.name: CFTC Commitments of Traders
cftc-gov.description: US Commodity Futures Trading Commission Commitments of Traders (COT) reports from the public reporting SODA API (publicreporting.cftc.gov): the seven weekly datasets (Legacy, Disaggregated and Traders in Financial Futures, each futures-only and combined, plus the Supplemental commodity index report) with filters, column projection, deterministic recent-first order and offset pagination, and a contract-market discovery function.

christies-com.name: Christie's
christies-com.description: Christie's auction lots and sales: keyword search of sold and upcoming lots with estimates and prices realised, sale search, sale headers with totals, full sale catalogues and lot detail pages, from christies.com's own anonymous APIs.

cis-scc-virginia-gov.name: Virginia SCC Clerk's Information System (business entity registry)
cis-scc-virginia-gov.description: Virginia State Corporation Commission Clerk's Information System public business entity search at cis.scc.virginia.gov: entity search by name or SCC entity id with entity type, status and jurisdiction filters; entity detail with status, formation and status dates, jurisdiction, industry code, registered agent, principal office, principals and shares; filing history with document ids; registered agent history and name history, all keyed by the site's internal numeric business_id. Server-rendered HTML behind a cookie-consent gate that the program clears itself; anonymous, no login. UCC, certificate verification, property-owner search and PDF images are not covered.

classpass-com.name: ClassPass
classpass-com.description: ClassPass class discovery and availability: find studios and class occurrences near a point for a date, read studio details and class types, a studio's schedule for a day, a single class occurrence with its availability status and displayed credit price, resolve locations and list markets. Anonymous same-origin JSON API of classpass.com; read-only, no reservations. Prices are ClassPass credits as displayed to anonymous visitors; member pricing is login-only and not returned.

clerk-house-gov.name: U.S. House Clerk roll call votes and members
clerk-house-gov.description: Office of the Clerk, U.S. House of Representatives (clerk.house.gov): roll call vote results for a congress, session and roll number with every member's position keyed by Bioguide ID, the votes listing with roll/bill/vote-type filters, a member's recent votes, and the current member roster.

clinicaltrials-gov.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
clinicaltrials-gov.description: ClinicalTrials.gov study registry via the public v2 REST API: search studies by condition, intervention, sponsor, location, status or Essie expression with page-token pagination; fetch one study record by NCT number; batch-resolve the raw ACTUAL/ESTIMATED start, primary-completion and completion dates for known NCT numbers; autocomplete conditions, interventions, sponsors and facilities; and read registry-wide field value statistics.

cmegroup-com.name: CME Group FedWatch and market data
cmegroup-com.description: CME FedWatch market-implied FOMC rate probabilities (the QuikStrike tool embedded on cmegroup.com: current view and per-meeting daily probability history) and CME Group's public CmeWS market data JSON: delayed futures quotes, daily settlements, volume and open interest, contract specifications, product search, and CME Term SOFR / SOFR average rates.

collections-search-bfi-org-uk.name: BFI Collections Search
collections-search-bfi-org-uk.description: BFI Collections Search (collections-search.bfi.org.uk), the British Film Institute's public catalogue of the BFI National Archive and BFI Reuben Library (Axiell Internet Server): expert search of any of its 12 databases (film and television works, film/video items, books, serials, articles, press cuttings, scripts and documents, posters, stills, special collections, library, persons and institutions) with field conditions, sorting and paging; the full label/value record of a work, person, item or book with its cross-reference links and the related records of its hierarchy; the searchable fields and sort options of a database; and controlled-vocabulary term lookups (genre, subject, ...). Read-only; no selections, downloads or e-mail features.

commbuys-com.name: COMMBUYS
commbuys-com.description: COMMBUYS (www.commbuys.com), the Commonwealth of Massachusetts' public procurement portal on Periscope BuySpeed Online: keyword and filtered bid solicitation search (organization, buyer, NIGP class, type, status, UNSPSC category, opening-date window) with the site's fixed 25-row pagination, the current Open Bids list, full bid solicitation detail pages with header fields, addresses, stateless attachment download URLs and UNSPSC line items, and master blanket / purchase order summaries. Anonymous public access only; quotes, bidding, bid holder lists and account actions are not covered.

courtlistener-com.name: CourtListener
courtlistener-com.description: Public CourtListener opinions, federal dockets, entries and court metadata.

courts-ca-gov.name: California Courts (courts.ca.gov)
courts-ca-gov.description: Judicial Branch of California public site: California Rules of Court by rule number and title index, Judicial Council court forms (search, catalog, form detail), slip opinions of the Supreme Court and Courts of Appeal (last 120 days, list and detail) and the site-wide search. Everything is read from the anonymous server-rendered Drupal pages of courts.ca.gov and selfhelp.courts.ca.gov; no login or token is involved.

craigslist-org.name: Craigslist
craigslist-org.description: Craigslist housing rentals: every region worldwide, filtered search of apartments, rooms, sublets and swaps by rent, beds, baths, pets, type and keyword, and full postings with attributes, photos, map location and timestamps.

cslb-ca-gov.name: California CSLB contractor license lookup
cslb-ca-gov.description: California Contractors State License Board (www.cslb.ca.gov) public Check a License service: read a contractor license record by license number (business information, entity, dates, status, classifications, bonds, workers' compensation, miscellaneous actions), search business names with cursor pagination, find currently licensed contractors by ZIP code or city and classification, list the personnel associated with a license, and read the public complaint disclosure cases of a license. Anonymous, read-only; no HIS registrations, application status, bulk Data Portal downloads or complaint filing.

curated-design.name: Curated (curated.design)
curated-design.description: Curated's public web design inspiration gallery: list featured websites by industry category, browse the server-rendered industry, style and tag shelves, read one site's detail page, search the library, and list the public filter vocabulary. Each site carries its name, live URL, preview image and video.

data-cityofnewyork-us.name: NYC Open Data property records (ACRIS, PLUTO, DOB)
data-cityofnewyork-us.description: New York City property records through NYC Open Data's Socrata SODA API and the Department of City Planning GeoSearch geocoder: resolve an address to BBL/BIN, read the MapPLUTO lot record (owner of record, building class, assessed value, zoning), list and read ACRIS recorded documents (deeds, mortgages, parties), and list DOB permits and DOB/ECB violations by building. Anonymous; no app token.

data-cms-gov.name: CMS Provider Data Catalog
data-cms-gov.description: CMS Provider Data Catalog datasets: NPI-keyed clinician procedure volume, plus Care Compare search and detail for hospitals (overall star rating), nursing homes (five-star ratings, staffing, inspections, penalties), home health agencies (quality star rating and measures) and dialysis facilities (star rating and standardized outcomes).

data-gov-au.name: data.gov.au open data catalogue
data-gov-au.description: Australia's national open data catalogue (data.gov.au, CKAN 2.11): search ~100k datasets from federal, state and local agencies with facets and filters, read a dataset's metadata and resources, read a resource and its DataStore schema, query DataStore tables row by row with filters and full-text search, and list or look up publishing organisations.

data-imf-org.name: IMF Data
data-imf-org.description: IMF SDMX dataflows, structures, observations and World Economic Outlook editions.

data-inpi-fr.name: INPI data.inpi.fr
data-inpi-fr.description: INPI's open data portal for French intellectual property and company records: trademarks with effect in France (INPI, EUIPO and WIPO/Madrid), patents published in France (FR, EP, WO, CCP), industrial designs (FR and Hague) and the French company register (RNE), through the JSON search and detail-by-id API behind the site's results page.

data-sf-gov.name: DataSF open data portal
data-sf-gov.description: San Francisco's open data portal (data.sf.gov, a Socrata site): search the dataset catalog, read a dataset's metadata and columns, query and count rows of any dataset with SoQL ($select/$where/$order/$group/$q and bare field filters, including spatial functions), and list the portal's category and tag facets.

data-worldbank-org.name: World Bank Data
data-worldbank-org.description: World Bank Indicators API v2: database catalog, indicator discovery, economies and aggregates, reference lists, observations (classic and dimension paths including International Debt Statistics) and extended series/economy metadata. Keyless public API.

databrowser-uis-unesco-org.name: UNESCO UIS
databrowser-uis-unesco-org.description: UNESCO UIS published versions, geographies, indicators and education observations.

datalegion.name: Data Legion
datalegion.description: Person and company enrichment with separate tier and contact products.

dataprivacyframework-gov.name: Data Privacy Framework participant list
dataprivacyframework-gov.description: U.S. Department of Commerce Data Privacy Framework (DPF) program: search the public list of self-certified participants (EU-U.S. DPF, UK Extension, Swiss-U.S. DPF), filter by status, state, framework, data covered, industry, recourse mechanism and verification method, read one organization's full certification record, and look up the reference lists behind the filters. Read-only, anonymous, from the site's own JSON API.

defillama-com.name: DeFiLlama
defillama-com.description: DeFiLlama analytics from the free llama.fi JSON APIs behind defillama.com: stablecoin supply and history, protocol and chain TVL, fees/revenue and DEX/options volume, yield pools, token prices and the hacks dataset.

delaware-gov.name: Delaware Division of Corporations
delaware-gov.description: Delaware Division of Corporations public records: the ICIS entity search (icis.corp.delaware.gov) by entity name or file number, the free entity details (formation date, kind, type, residency, registered agent) and the Division's list of Delaware registered agents (corp.delaware.gov/agents/). Paid status, franchise tax and filing history are not included.

dell-com.name: Dell
dell-com.description: Dell.com storefront and support: keyword search of the shop (offer ids, platform codes, prices, ratings, hero specs), the exact configured tech specs of one offer id, the support product catalog, the manuals and documents list of a support product, and owner's manual chapters with their specification tables.

discogs-com.name: Discogs
discogs-com.description: Public Discogs music releases, masters, artists and labels with search and paginated catalogs.

doi-org.name: DOI.org
doi-org.description: DOI resolution through the doi.org Handle proxy: landing URL and handle values for a DOI, registration-agency lookup for batches of DOIs, content-negotiated bibliographic metadata (CSL JSON, BibTeX, citations, RDF/XML, DataCite JSON), prefix administration, the registration-agency directory and DOI system statistics.

dominos-ca.name: Domino's Canada
dominos-ca.description: Public Canadian store directory, nearby locations, profiles and complete store-specific menus. Read-only; no order placement.

dominos-com.name: Domino's US
dominos-com.description: Public US store lookup, menus, product customization and published delivery fees.

draftsharks-com.name: Draft Sharks NFL rankings
draftsharks-com.description: Draft Sharks (draftsharks.com) NFL fantasy football rankings: weekly and rest-of-season boards for every position in standard, half PPR, PPR and TE-premium scoring, with or without superflex, each player carrying the site's median, floor, ceiling and consensus projections, tiers, matchup and strength of schedule. Read from the server-rendered table fragments the pages load; anonymous.

dsld-od-nih-gov.name: NIH Dietary Supplement Label Database (dsld.od.nih.gov)
dsld-od-nih-gov.description: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements' Dietary Supplement Label Database: the full label content of 200k+ dietary supplements sold in the US. Label search with the site's filters, one label in full (every Supplement Facts row with amount, unit and %DV, other ingredients, statements, claims, contacts, label image and PDF URLs), a brand's labels, A-Z/keyword product and brand browsing, ingredient groups with synonyms and fact sheets, and database-wide counts. Data are CC0 (public domain); NIH asks for the attribution `National Institutes of Health, Office of Dietary Supplements. Dietary Supplement Label Database, 2026. https://dsld.od.nih.gov/`.

earth-search-aws-element84-com.name: Element 84 Earth Search (Sentinel-2 L2A)
earth-search-aws-element84-com.description: Sentinel-2 L2A scenes over a geometry from Element 84's Earth Search STAC API, with per-field vegetation indices (NDVI, EVI, NDMI) and true-colour/NDVI clips read straight from the Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs on AWS Open Data by HTTP range request.

earthquake-usgs-gov.name: USGS Earthquake Catalog (ComCat)
earthquake-usgs-gov.description: Earthquake search and event detail from the USGS ANSS Comprehensive Earthquake Catalog (ComCat) via its public FDSN event web service: worldwide events with US coverage down to small magnitudes, PAGER alerts, ShakeMap intensities and Did You Feel It? reports. Public-domain US government data.

ebay-com.name: eBay listings
ebay-com.description: eBay.com listings through the site's item-module JSON: item detail, variations, shipping and returns terms, and search autosuggest. Keyword search, sold listings and seller pages are HTML behind Akamai/orch and are not offered. Public US marketplace (www.ebay.com, USD), anonymous session, no bidding or purchases.

ec-europa-eu.name: Eurostat (ec.europa.eu)
ec-europa-eu.description: Eurostat's public dissemination API on ec.europa.eu: search the dataset catalogue, read a dataset's metadata card and dimension code lists, run filtered JSON-stat data queries on any of the ~8,000 datasets, and typed wrappers for country price level indices (EU27=100) and the semi-annual purchasing power parities of EU capital and duty-station cities (Brussels=1). Anonymous, keyless.

ecb-europa-eu.name: European Central Bank (ECB Data Portal)
ecb-europa-eu.description: Official European Central Bank statistics from the ECB Data Portal's keyless SDMX API: euro foreign exchange reference rates (latest, one day or a range, with derived cross rates between two non-euro currencies), any ECB time series by dataflow and key (euro short-term rate €STR, key policy rates, HICP inflation, M3 and other monetary aggregates, bank interest rates, yield curves, balance of payments) with decoded titles, units and frequency, and dataflow search with dimension codes for building series keys.

ecorp-sos-ga-gov.name: Georgia Secretary of State business registry (eCorp)
ecorp-sos-ga-gov.description: Georgia Secretary of State Corporations Division public registry at ecorp.sos.ga.gov (PCC Technology Group eCorp): business entity search by name, control number, registered agent, officer or designated agent; entity detail with status, type, formation date, jurisdiction, principal office, registered agent and officers; filing history and name change history keyed by the site's internal business id; plus the service-of-process and state trademark search grids. Server-rendered HTML, anonymous, no documents (PDF retrieval is session-gated upstream).

efdsearch-senate-gov.name: US Senate financial disclosures (eFD)
efdsearch-senate-gov.description: United States Senate electronic Financial Disclosure search (efdsearch.senate.gov): search public financial disclosure filings of Senators, former Senators and Senate candidates by name, filer type, report type, state and date received, then read one filing: an electronic periodic transaction report (transactions table), an electronic annual report (Parts 1-10 with their tables), a scanned paper filing (page image URLs on efd-media-public.senate.gov) or a due-date extension notice. Every call requires the caller to acknowledge the statutory prohibitions on obtaining and using these reports (5 U.S.C. app. 105(c)); the program performs the site's acknowledgement step only after the caller has done so and repeats the statutory notice in every output. Public, anonymous, read-only.

eia-gov.name: US Energy Information Administration
eia-gov.description: Discover EIA energy data routes, enumerate facet values and retrieve energy observations with source units and labels.

elections-ab-ca.name: Elections Alberta results and political finance
elections-ab-ca.description: Elections Alberta (elections.ab.ca): official election results by electoral division and by voting location for general elections and by-elections, the list of electoral events, registered candidates with their financial filings, registered parties and their disclosure records, the contributor search, and referendum third-party advertisers. Read from the officialresults and efpublic ColdFusion pages, anonymously.

ema-europa-eu.name: European Medicines Agency
ema-europa-eu.description: EU centrally authorised medicines (EPAR medicine pages) and EMA-assessed medicine supply shortages from EMA's published JSON data files, with EMA attribution on every result.

espn-com.name: ESPN
espn-com.description: ESPN public sports data from the anonymous site and core JSON APIs: sport/league discovery, scoreboards by date or week (schedules, live and final scores with explicit status), event summaries, teams, team records and schedules, rosters, standings, player bios with career statistics, league injury reports, and site search. US and international coverage as ESPN exposes it (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, college sports, Premier League and ~219 soccer competitions incl. UEFA and FIFA tournaments).

etsy-com.name: Etsy
etsy-com.description: Etsy marketplace listings: listing details and prices, per-variation pricing, similar listings, shop sections and search query suggestions from Etsy's public ajax JSON API. Keyword search, shop listing enumeration and reviews are DataDome-gated and not available.

expedia-co-uk.name: Expedia UK hotels
expedia-co-uk.description: Expedia UK destination lookup, dated hotel search and live room offers in GBP for one room. Anonymous site prices; no bookings or member discounts.

faa-gov.name: FAA public records
faa-gov.description: FAA public records from faa.gov: the aircraft registry (N-number detail, owner, serial and dealer searches, recorded documents), airworthiness directives and other regulatory documents from the Dynamic Regulatory System (DRS), and live NAS airport delay and closure status.

fanatics-com.name: Fanatics US
fanatics-com.description: Fanatics US (www.fanatics.com) licensed sports merchandise: product search, league/team/department listings with facets, product detail with per-size stock and prices, and the team directory of a league, from the storefront's server-rendered page data and its Iris data API.

fantasydata-com.name: FantasyData NFL rankings
fantasydata-com.description: FantasyData (fantasydata.com) NFL weekly fantasy football rankings from the site's public ranking pages: rank, player, team, opponent, positional rank and projected points for every offensive position, kickers, team defenses and IDP, in standard, half-PPR and PPR scoring. Anonymous; the site shows the top 100 rows per page to visitors without Premium.

fantasyfootballcalculator-com.name: Fantasy Football Calculator NFL rankings and ADP
fantasyfootballcalculator-com.description: Fantasy Football Calculator (fantasyfootballcalculator.com) NFL data: the current week's rankings with projected fantasy points for standard, PPR, half-PPR and 2-QB leagues, dynasty and dynasty rookie rankings, and average draft position from the site's mock drafts by format, league size, season and position.

fcia-org.name: FCIA member directory
fcia-org.description: Firestop Contractors International Association (fcia.org) member directory: search firestop contractors, special inspection agencies, manufacturers, distributors and other members by service area (US state, Canadian province, Middle East country), region, accreditation (FM 4991, UL Qualified, IAS AC 291), member type and barrier-management service; search by company name; read one member's detail page with address, coordinates, phone, website, service areas, contacts and accreditation badges.

fda-gov.name: FDA
fda-gov.description: US FDA drug, food and device enforcement recalls, Drugs@FDA applications, structured labeling, device 510(k) decisions, FAERS drug adverse-event reports, the NDC directory and drug shortages via openFDA.

fdc-nal-usda-gov.name: USDA FoodData Central (fdc.nal.usda.gov)
fdc-nal-usda-gov.description: USDA Agricultural Research Service FoodData Central: the authoritative US food-composition database (Foundation Foods, SR Legacy, Survey/FNDDS, Branded Foods, Experimental Foods). Food search and listing by data type, the complete nutrient record of one food (per 100 g values, data points, min/max/median, derivation, portions, conversion factors, brand and label data), nutrient-centric search (which foods carry a given nutrient such as biotin, chromium, molybdenum or an amino acid, ranked by amount), the nutrient reference list and the food-category lists. Anonymous JSON backend of the public web portal; public-domain data (CC0 1.0).

fec-gov.name: FEC
fec-gov.description: US Federal Election Commission campaign finance data from the openFEC API: federal candidates and committees, committee financial totals per cycle, filed reports, itemized disbursements (Schedule B), independent expenditures (Schedule E) and individual-contribution aggregates by size, state and employer. Committee, candidate and aggregate data only: itemized individual contributions (Schedule A rows with contributor names) are not exposed, and Schedule B contribution refunds to individuals are withheld, because 52 U.S.C. 30111(a)(4) bars using individual contributor information for soliciting contributions or commercial purposes.

federalreserve-gov.name: Federal Reserve Board
federalreserve-gov.description: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (federalreserve.gov): press releases, speeches and testimony with full text, the events calendar, FOMC meeting materials (statements, minutes, projections) and Data Download Program statistical packages (H.15 interest rates, H.10 exchange rates and other releases), from the site's own listing JSON, server-rendered pages and CSV endpoints. Anonymous; no API key.

fftoday-com.name: FFToday NFL projections and rankings
fftoday-com.description: FFToday (fftoday.com) NFL fantasy football projections and rankings from the site's public pages: weekly projections (QB, RB, WR, TE, K) and season projections (also team defense and IDP) with per-stat lines and points in ten scoring presets, and weekly staff rankings with tiers for every position. Anonymous.

finance-yahoo-com.name: Yahoo Finance
finance-yahoo-com.description: Yahoo Finance public quotes, earnings estimates, ticker discovery, dividend history and historical OHLCV price bars.

find-and-update-company-information-serv.name: Companies House
find-and-update-company-information-serv.description: Public UK company searches, profiles, filings, officers, ownership, charges and historic records from the Companies House website.

firecrawl-developer-index.name: Developer Index
firecrawl-developer-index.description: Search developer documentation, repositories, issues and agent skills with matched passages.

firecrawl-gov-index.name: Government Index
firecrawl-gov-index.description: About 16 million pages from US federal, state, county and city government sites: statutes and code sections, regulations, zoning and municipal ordinances, permits, licences and fee schedules, court filings, tax forms, procurement and agency guidance, searched as one index, with the laws and cases each page cites.

firecrawl-research-index.name: Research Index
firecrawl-research-index.description: Find scientific papers, inspect metadata, read relevant passages and follow citation relationships.

fireround.name: Fireround
fireround.description: Startup funding rounds: venture capital (VC funding) of private companies from across the open web, pre-seed to growth, with amounts, valuations, stages, lead and other investors, certainty and sources, each read back against the pages it came from; the funded companies with their headquarters, sector, what they do and total raised; the investors behind them and the news that reported them.

fiscal-ai.name: Fiscal.ai
fiscal-ai.description: Company fundamentals with the record around them: standardized and as-reported statements, ratios, ownership, prices, earnings call transcripts, and what fund letters say about a company.

fiscaldata-treasury-gov.name: US Treasury Fiscal Data
fiscaldata-treasury-gov.description: US Treasury Fiscal Data (fiscaldata.treasury.gov): the dataset catalog, filtered rows from any of the ~180 API tables (Debt to the Penny, Daily and Monthly Treasury Statements, auctions, average interest rates, interest expense, gold reserve, rates of exchange, MSPD, ...), latest observations of the headline tables, the release calendar and published report files.

flights-google-com.name: Google Flights
flights-google-com.description: Google Flights airport/city lookup and one-way or two-step round-trip fare search, with optional carry-on/checked bag repricing.

flooranddecor-com.name: Floor & Decor
flooranddecor-com.description: Floor & Decor US (flooranddecor.com): catalog search and category browse, product detail with per-store USD pricing, type-ahead suggestions, store locator and store pages, and customer Q&A. Anonymous, read-only.

food-nutrition-canada-ca.name: Canadian Nutrient File, Health Canada (food-nutrition.canada.ca)
food-nutrition-canada-ca.description: Health Canada's Canadian Nutrient File (CNF), the reference food-composition table for Canada: 5,690 foods with up to 152 nutrients per 100 g, Canadian fortification values, serving measures with gram weights, refuse and yield factors, in English or French. Food search by name, the full nutrient record of one food (optionally converted to a chosen measure such as 250ml), the nutrient, nutrient-group and data-source reference lists, the 23 CNF food groups and the search for foods ranked by one nutrient within a food group. Anonymous JSON API of the public CNF web app plus two GET-and-POST pages of the same app for the food-group aware nutrient search. Data: Canadian Nutrient File, Health Canada, Open Government Licence - Canada; the online CNF is the 2015 publication (Health Canada is preparing a CNF 2026 dataset).

football-fantasysports-yahoo-com.name: Yahoo Fantasy Football (public)
football-fantasysports-yahoo-com.description: Yahoo Fantasy Football public data without a login: player search, a public league's player list with projected and actual stat periods and rank windows, public team rosters and the public Yahoo Sports player news index.

forever-codex-com.name: Forever Codex
forever-codex-com.description: Forever Codex, a World of Warcraft: Forever fan site built from the game files: a one-page overview of every class spec (stat values, racials that matter, the calculated pre-raid best in slot, consumables and crafted Tier 1), every class's talent trees with each talent's ranks, requirements and what changed since Classic Era, the dungeon finder (every dungeon and raid by level with its best drops per class) and dungeon pages (bosses, loot with chances, quests and rewards), read from the site's server-rendered pages.

foreverdb-net.name: ForeverDB
foreverdb-net.description: ForeverDB, a World of Warcraft: Forever database built from the game client: best-in-slot gear for every class and spec at any level from 1 to 60 for PvE, PvP or leveling (best item per slot with its score, stats, the next two picks, where it comes from and the best enchant, plus the stat weights used), item details (stats, effects, levels, what is new in Forever and where to get it), DPS simulator results and stat weights per damage spec, recommended talent builds per class and level, and dungeon and raid guides (levels, bosses, loot tables with drop chances, quests), read from the site's server-rendered pages.

forexfactory-com.name: Forex Factory economic calendar
forexfactory-com.description: Forex Factory's economic calendar (www.forexfactory.com/calendar): scheduled releases by day, week, month or custom range with impact, currency and event-type filters; per-event details, release history, numeric history series and indicator name search. Public, anonymous, read-only.

fred.name: FRED
fred.description: US and international economic time series from the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis: rates, prices, employment, output and money, with the full revision history behind each figure.

fred-stlouisfed-org.name: FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data)
fred-stlouisfed-org.description: FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data), the St. Louis Fed's database of US and international economic time series: headline US indicators such as the monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE), CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL), GDP (GDP, GDPC1), nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS), the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and Treasury yields (DGS10), plus 800,000+ other series. Search series by text, browse categories, releases, sources and tags, read one series' metadata (units, frequency, seasonal adjustment, source, notes, date range, last update) and fetch its observations (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly or annual values) with date window, frequency aggregation and transformation, paginated, from the site's keyless JSON, CSV and HTML endpoints.

fresha-com.name: Fresha
fresha-com.description: Fresha marketplace discovery without an account: find salons, spas and other venues near a geocode by treatment, filter by a date and time window to see available start times per service, read a venue's public service menu (advertised prices, durations, variants), team, hours and latest reviews, and find professionals and their profiles. Anonymous persisted GraphQL queries on www.fresha.com; reading only, no bookings, holds or carts.

fullenrich.name: FullEnrich
fullenrich.description: People and company search, profile lookups, firmographics, and verified contact data.

gartner-com.name: Gartner
gartner-com.description: Gartner's public marketing site: upcoming and on-demand webinars (listing servlet and detail pages with speakers, times and registration URL), the conference calendar, and public content lists (articles, newsroom press releases, experts). Anonymous, English (www.gartner.com/en).

github-com.name: GitHub
github-com.description: Public GitHub repositories, releases, issues, labels, contributors and raw file contents.

glassdoor-com.name: Glassdoor US jobs
glassdoor-com.description: Glassdoor US job search: one page of 30 job cards per call for a keyword, optionally in a Glassdoor location (city, state or country id from suggest_locations) with the site's own filters (posting age, remote, Easy Apply, sort, minimum salary, minimum employer rating, seniority, radius, employer size, employer, industry), cursor continuation into the following pages, and the autocomplete services behind the site header: locations, employers and job-title keywords. Employer reviews, salaries, interviews and job detail pages sit behind a Cloudflare managed challenge and are not covered.

gleif-org.name: GLEIF
gleif-org.description: Global LEI search, identity and reported direct/ultimate accounting-consolidation parents and children. Preserves reporting exceptions.

gmgn-ai.name: GMGN
gmgn-ai.description: GMGN (gmgn.ai) memecoin terminal data from its anonymous JSON API: trending tokens and new launches per chain, token detail with security and creator statistics, candles, trades, holders, top traders, first buyers and community posts, plus the smart-money wallet leaderboard, wallet statistics and developer launch history. Chains: sol, eth, base, bsc, tron, monad.

golfnow-com.name: GolfNow US
golfnow-com.description: GolfNow US public course discovery: location and course search, courses with tee times near a point, per-facility tee times with displayed rates, per-day availability summaries, course profiles and GolfNow reviews. Anonymous, read-only.

grants-gov.name: Grants.gov
grants-gov.description: Official federal funding opportunity search, detail and filter vocabularies.

greenhouse-io.name: Greenhouse job boards
greenhouse-io.description: Employer job boards hosted by Greenhouse: list every opening on a board, search it with Greenhouse's own keyword, department and office filters, read one post with its description, pay ranges and application questions, and enumerate a board's departments and offices. Keyed by the employer's board token; there is no directory of boards.

hertzcarsales-com.name: Hertz Car Sales
hertzcarsales-com.description: Hertz Car Sales (hertzcarsales.com), the US used-car retail arm of Hertz: search the used and Rent2Buy inventories by make, model, body style, fuel, state, ZIP radius, year, mileage and price with pagination; read one vehicle by VIN, vehicle id or URL with full specifications; list facet values and counts for a filter set; natural-language inventory search; Buy Online availability and payment estimates by VIN.

hibid-com.name: HiBid
hibid-com.description: HiBid (hibid.com), the North American online auction platform used by thousands of auction houses: search lots by keyword, auction, category, region or archive (hammer prices), read one lot with pictures and terms, its bid history and live bid state, search current and past auctions, read one auction's terms and bid increments, and look up auctioneers. Anonymous public GraphQL API; auctioneer subdomains such as citadelgalleryauctions.hibid.com are the same data scoped by auctioneer_id.

hipcamp-com.name: Hipcamp
hipcamp-com.description: Hipcamp campsite, cabin, glamping and RV listing discovery: dated search with location, group size and amenity filters, land details, per-site availability and displayed price quotes, blocked-date calendars, reviews, place autocomplete and public campground daily availability. Anonymous, read-only.

houzz-com.name: Houzz
houzz-com.description: Public professional discovery, service profiles and portfolio summaries.

hub-docker-com.name: Docker Hub
hub-docker-com.description: Docker Hub, the public container image registry: catalog search with badge, architecture, OS and category filters; repository metadata and README; tag listings and tag detail with per-architecture digests, sizes and push dates; a namespace's repositories and profile; catalog categories; Docker Scout vulnerability summaries by image digest.

huggingface-co.name: Hugging Face
huggingface-co.description: Search Hugging Face models and datasets, inspect repository metadata, and read public model and dataset cards.

hyperliquid-xyz.name: Hyperliquid
hyperliquid-xyz.description: Hyperliquid perpetual markets: live funding and open interest, historical funding, candles, order books, trades, per-address positions, fills (with liquidations), funding payments and ledger, plus vault details, from Hyperliquid's public info API.

icims-com.name: iCIMS
icims-com.description: Employer career portals hosted by iCIMS at <portal>.icims.com: search and paginate openings with the portal's own filters, read one posting with its header fields, body sections and JobPosting metadata, and describe a portal's categories, locations and position types.

icons-computer.name: Icons Computer
icons-computer.description: Find app icons by name, color, style, category and platform, with image links and source attribution.

iea-org.name: IEA
iea-org.description: Public energy highlights, country metadata and observations; paid and account-gated non-CC datasets are refused.

ihme-gbd-results.name: IHME GBD Results
ihme-gbd-results.description: IHME Global Burden of Disease Results tool metadata: release versions and the full cause, location, age, sex, measure, metric and risk-factor (REI) hierarchies for GBD 2021 and GBD 2023.

ikea-com.name: IKEA
ikea-com.description: IKEA category discovery, product specifications and advertised prices in the market's own currency, variants, materials, care, safety documents and review excerpts for any IKEA market on www.ikea.com (91 country/language storefronts in 50 countries). No store stock or delivery availability.

indeed-com.name: Indeed
indeed-com.description: Indeed job search, full job postings and employer profiles (rating, review category scores, size, revenue, industry, addresses, CEO, links) from Indeed's own GraphQL API for the US and 25 other country sites, with the public company page as fallback and salary and location normalised.

ironplanet-com.name: IronPlanet
ironplanet-com.description: IronPlanet (Ritchie Bros.) used heavy equipment and truck marketplace: category/make listings with filters, sort and pagination, keyword suggestions, the anonymous item preview (photos, features, serial, meter), upcoming online auctions per realm and one auction's lots.

jlcpcb-com.name: JLCPCB parts library
jlcpcb-com.description: Search the JLCPCB SMT assembly parts library (LCSC catalogue) by keyword, C-number, manufacturer part number or category; read one part's stock, assembly and purchase price breaks, package, basic/extended type, attributes and datasheet; list the two-level category taxonomy; and get search-box suggestions. Read-only, anonymous, USD prices as served to US visitors.

join-com.name: JOIN job ads
join-com.description: Employer career pages hosted by JOIN (join.com): read an employer's profile with offices and benefits, list its online job ads with category and city filters, read one ad with description, salary, contract and working terms, and enumerate the employer's job categories. Keyed by the employer's join.com slug; JOIN publishes no cross-employer search or directory.

justwatch-com.name: JustWatch
justwatch-com.description: JustWatch streaming availability: search movies and shows, per-country streaming/rent/buy offers with provider links and prices, title details with IMDb/TMDB ids, episodes, catalog browsing, new arrivals and provider lists from JustWatch's public GraphQL API.

kbb-com.name: Kelley Blue Book
kbb-com.description: US car inventory, listing details, model-year trims and regional Kelley Blue Book valuations.

kickstarter-com.name: Kickstarter
kickstarter-com.description: Kickstarter (www.kickstarter.com) crowdfunding projects: search and browse the public discover catalogue by term, category, location, tag, state and sort with seeded pagination; search-box suggestions; location lookup for the location filter; one project's full record with funding progress and reward tiers from its public page; lightweight live funding counters; the category tree and featured tags.

kings-printer-alberta-ca.name: Alberta King's Printer
kings-printer-alberta-ca.description: Official consolidated Alberta acts and regulations (Laws Online catalogue and full text by section, with per-section amendment history and consolidation dates) and the Alberta Gazette (Part 1 and Part 2 issue lists and verbatim issue text) from kings-printer.alberta.ca.

landefeld-de.name: Landefeld industrial parts catalogue
landefeld-de.description: Landefeld Druckluft + Hydraulik (www.landefeld.de): anonymous read access to the German storefront. Full-text and part-number search, catalogue browsing, article-group listings with spec filters and pagination, and article details with net EUR prices, availability, GTIN, specs, documents and images.

lda-gov.name: Lobbying Disclosure Act filings (lda.gov)
lda-gov.description: U.S. federal lobbying disclosures from the Senate Office of Public Records' Lobbying Disclosure Act REST API (lda.gov): LD-1 registrations and LD-2 quarterly activity reports (client, registrant, income or expenses, general issue codes, specific issues, lobbyists, government entities contacted, foreign entities), LD-203 contribution reports (FECA contributions and honorary, meeting, library and inaugural expenses by registrants and lobbyists), and registrant and client lookups. Filters by client, registrant, lobbyist, year, period, filing type and issue text; 25 records per page with continuation. Keyless public record; outputs carry the citation the API terms ask for.

leginfo-legislature-ca-gov.name: California Legislative Information (leginfo.legislature.ca.gov)
leginfo-legislature-ca-gov.description: California Legislative Information, the Legislature's official site for state law and bills: current text of any California code section or article, full code tables of contents, keyword search over bill text by session, and per bill the current text with digest and versions, status, complete history and roll-call votes. Server-rendered HTML; no API key.

legislation-gov-uk.name: legislation.gov.uk
legislation-gov-uk.description: UK legislation from legislation.gov.uk (The National Archives): search and listing feeds across every legislation type (UK Public General Acts, Statutory Instruments, Scottish, Welsh and Northern Ireland legislation, retained EU law), title-to-identifier lookup, tables of contents, the text of one provision or structural division (section, article, regulation, part, chapter, schedule) in its current, enacted/made or point-in-time version, and the changes-to-legislation register. Reads the site's stateless XML/Atom representations (CLML data.xml, Atom data.feed) under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

letterboxd-com.name: Letterboxd
letterboxd-com.description: Letterboxd film data from the public site: one film's identity, credits, crew, tagline, alternative titles, release dates, similar films and weighted average rating (by Letterboxd URL, boxd.it short link, slug, TMDB id or IMDb id); the full half-star rating histogram with watched/list/like counts; bulk average ratings for a list of film URLs or slugs; film search with cursor pagination; the all-time popular films browser with 72 average ratings per page; a film's member reviews (popular, newest, earliest, highest or lowest rated) with full text, star rating, like and comment counts; the comment thread under one review; the public lists that contain a film; and a list's entries with rank, owner rating and notes.

littlecaesars-com.name: Little Caesars US
littlecaesars-com.description: Little Caesars (littlecaesars.com) US store finder, store details, store-scoped menus with prices, item modifiers and toppings, create-your-own pizza options, ordering time slots and national/market promo deals, from the anonymous ordering BFF the order.littlecaesars.com app uses.

firecrawl-maps.name: Maps
firecrawl-maps.description: Business search, public reviews, monthly rating trends and directions for driving, walking, cycling and transit.

marcos-com.name: Marco's Pizza
marcos-com.description: Marco's Pizza (marcos.com) store finder and location-specific menus: categories, items, sizes and prices, toppings and modifiers, coupons and live wait times from the public ordering data files and API.

mempool-space.name: mempool.space
mempool-space.description: Bitcoin mainnet explorer data from the open-source mempool.space REST API: transactions with inputs, outputs, fees and confirmations, which transaction spent each output, address balances, histories and UTXOs, blocks by hash or height with mining pool and fees, recent blocks, fee estimates and the mempool backlog.

microcenter-com.name: Micro Center US
microcenter-com.description: Micro Center (microcenter.com) US retail catalog: store-scoped product search, exact SKU lookup with store price and inventory, product detail, the store list and Bazaarvoice reviews.

msc-com.name: MSC shipment tracking and schedules
msc-com.description: MSC (Mediterranean Shipping Company) public tools on msc.com: container, bill-of-lading and booking tracking with milestone events, point-to-point sailing schedules, vessel port-call schedules, port arrivals and departures, the port and vessel reference lists, first-EU-port arrivals and the customer advisories newsroom. Anonymous JSON endpoints behind the site's Sitecore pages.

msheritage-access-preservica-com.name: M&S Heritage digital archive (Preservica Universal Access)
msheritage-access-preservica-com.description: The Marks & Spencer Company Archive's public digital catalogue ('M&S Heritage', msheritage.access.preservica.com, a Preservica Universal Access tenant): keyword search of the catalogue with collection, format and reference-number filters, browsing of the collection hierarchy (Browse Collections root -> folders -> items) and the metadata of a single record (title, description, date, reference number, parent folder, breadcrumb, thumbnail). Anonymous and read-only; the asset viewer on mands.preservica.com needs a per-page-load token and is not fetched.

myfloridalicense-com.name: Florida DBPR licensing registry (myfloridalicense.com)
myfloridalicense-com.description: Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation public license verification at myfloridalicense.com (the ASP.NET MVC `portalsearches/VerifyLicensee` application that the legacy wl11.asp search now redirects to): search professional and business licensees by name or license number with board, license type, county, city and state filters and historic-license inclusion; the licensee detail page with status, rank, licensure and expiry dates, special qualifications and alternate names; the related-license table (qualifying agents, businesses) and the public complaint list. Server-rendered HTML, anonymous, stateless (no cookies or tokens required).

myworkdayjobs-com.name: Workday career sites
myworkdayjobs-com.description: Career sites of any employer on Workday Recruiting ({tenant}.wd{N}.myworkdayjobs.com and wd{N}.myworkdaysite.com): search a site's open requisitions with its own keyword search and facets (location, job category, time type, remote type and others as each site exposes them, with ids and counts), page through results, and read one posting with its full description, requisition id, locations, dates and apply link. Keyed by the career-site URL; there is no directory of Workday sites.

namecheap-com.name: Namecheap domain search
namecheap-com.description: Public, anonymous domain availability, premium and aftermarket status, TLD pricing, marketplace listings and auctions behind namecheap.com's domain search. Read-only; no cart, account or purchase actions.

nasdaq-com.name: Nasdaq.com news feeds and articles
nasdaq-com.description: Nasdaq.com's public news surfaces: ticker news, press releases, market-wide and topic feeds (JSON), the RSS feeds that carry publish times, and the full text and exact publish instant of a Nasdaq article or press release page.

nevo-online-rivm-nl.name: RIVM NEVO-online
nevo-online-rivm-nl.description: NEVO-online, the Dutch national food composition database published by RIVM: about 2,300 foods with up to 140 nutrient values per 100 g or 100 ml. Search foods by Dutch or English name, synonym, NEVO code or food group; read one food's full nutrient table with source codes and recipe ingredients; compare nutrient columns across several foods; list the food groups and nutrient columns. Labels are available in Dutch (nl) and English (en); the data is identical in both languages.

newegg-com.name: Newegg US
newegg-com.description: Search Newegg US electronics and open-box listings, retrieve live prices, condition and availability for an item, and page through every written customer review of an item.

newjersey-mylicense-com.name: New Jersey license verification (DCA)
newjersey-mylicense-com.description: New Jersey Division of Consumer Affairs public license verification (newjersey.mylicense.com/verification): the profession and license-type lists behind the search form, person and business licensee search by profession, license type, name, license number and city with the site's 40-row pages, and the License Information record (status, status change reason, issue and expiration dates, board action flag, CDS drug schedules, prerequisite licenses) for one license number. Classic ASP.NET WebForms parsed from HTML; every call establishes its own server session (form GET, search POST, results GET, detail GET) because result keys live in that session.

nfa-futures-org.name: NFA BASIC
nfa-futures-org.description: National Futures Association BASIC registry: firm, individual and commodity pool search, registration profiles, regulatory actions, arbitration awards, CFTC reparations, FCM financial reports and CPO pools, over BASIC's own JSON-RPC handlers.

nfl-com.name: NFL.com
nfl-com.description: Official NFL data from nfl.com's own API (api.nfl.com): weekly injury and practice participation reports, club rosters, standings, weekly schedules with scores, clubs, games, player profiles and news.

nhc-noaa-gov.name: NOAA National Hurricane Center (nhc.noaa.gov)
nhc-noaa-gov.description: Tropical cyclone data from NOAA's National Hurricane Center (Atlantic, eastern and central North Pacific): storms NHC is advising on now with position, intensity and GIS links; each season's storms with ATCF ids; every archived advisory product (public advisory, forecast/advisory, forecast discussion, wind speed probabilities) with parsed headline and summary; the Tropical Weather Outlook with 48-hour and 7-day formation chances; and ATCF best tracks with wind radii. US federal public-domain data.

nhtsa-gov.name: NHTSA
nhtsa-gov.description: US vehicle safety data from NHTSA's public APIs: VIN decode to NHTSA vehicle records, safety recalls by VIN-decoded vehicle or year/make/model, recall campaign detail with affected products and documents, consumer complaints, NCAP safety ratings, year/make/model discovery lists and child car seat inspection stations.

nike-com.name: Nike US
nike-com.description: Nike US products, prices, sizes, availability and public customer reviews from Nike's own web APIs.

nissanusa-com.name: Nissan USA dealer locator and inventory
nissanusa-com.description: Nissan USA (nissanusa.com) dealer locator: dealers by ZIP, city or coordinates, dealer details with hours and services, and public new / certified pre-owned inventory by dealer or VIN. Anonymous, read-only; no leads, bookings or accounts.

npiregistry-cms-hhs-gov.name: NPI Registry
npiregistry-cms-hhs-gov.description: Public CMS healthcare provider business identities, taxonomy and practice locations.

npmjs-com.name: npm
npmjs-com.description: npm, the JavaScript package registry: full-text and typeahead package search, package documents with dist-tags and version history, per-version dependencies and tarballs, download counts (totals, daily series, per version), dependents and packages by user or organization.

nvd-nist-gov.name: NIST National Vulnerability Database (NVD)
nvd-nist-gov.description: CVE vulnerability records from the NIST National Vulnerability Database CVE API 2.0 (services.nvd.nist.gov): look up a CVE by id, search by keyword, CPE product, CWE weakness, CVSS severity, CISA KEV membership and publication or modification dates, and list CVEs published or changed in the last days. Each record carries CVSS v4.0/v3.x/v2 scores, CWEs, CPE applicability matches, the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities flag and dates, and references. Every result carries NVD's required notice.

ollama-com.name: Ollama model library
ollama-com.description: Ollama's public model library at ollama.com: search and browse official and community models, read model pages, tags with download size and context window, per-tag layers with exact byte sizes from the Ollama registry manifest, and GGUF layer metadata (context_length, embedding_length).

openreview-net.name: OpenReview
openreview-net.description: OpenReview (openreview.net): full-text search over public submissions (title, abstract, authors, venue, PDF/HTML links, BibTeX) and over public reviews, meta-reviews, decisions and comments, the catalog of venues hosted on OpenReview and one venue's public configuration, all through the anonymous, stateless api2.openreview.net (v2) and api.openreview.net (v1) JSON endpoints. Browsing a venue's full submission list, fetching one paper or its review thread by id, and PDF download sit behind OpenReview's first-party Cloudflare Turnstile gate and are not offered.

openrouter-ai.name: OpenRouter
