openrouter-ai.description: OpenRouter model catalog and marketplace data: search models by modality, author, provider and price; per-model provider endpoints with pricing, limits, data policy and uptime; effective and listed price history; usage and availability stats; the provider directory; author lineups; and documentation pages such as the Decisions API reference and the Jev decision-model guide. Anonymous public endpoints only; no inference.

opensanctions-org.name: OpenSanctions
opensanctions-org.description: OpenSanctions sanctions, PEP and persons-of-interest database: entity search with facets and filters, full entity profiles with properties, sanctions programs, relationships and data sources from the public website, and the dataset catalogue from the public data mirror.

openstreetmap-org.name: OpenStreetMap
openstreetmap-org.description: OpenStreetMap data: Nominatim geocoding (forward and reverse), Overpass category search inside a bbox, radius, administrative area or polygon, and the OSM API v0.6 for element detail, batch fetch, bbox map dumps, element history, changesets and map notes.

oregonbuys-gov.name: OregonBuys
oregonbuys-gov.description: OregonBuys (oregonbuys.gov), the State of Oregon's public procurement portal on Periscope BuySpeed Online: keyword and filtered bid solicitation search with the site's fixed 25-row pagination, the current Open Bids list, and full bid solicitation detail pages with header fields, addresses, public attachment download URLs and line items. Anonymous public access only; bid holder lists, quotes and amendment acknowledgements need a supplier login and are not covered.

oriane.name: Oriane
oriane.description: Search indexed Instagram and TikTok profiles and posts through Oriane, including bios, follower counts and content engagement. Empty results do not trigger live scraping.

osv-dev.name: OSV.dev open source vulnerabilities
osv-dev.description: OSV.dev, Google's open source vulnerability database (api.osv.dev), keyless: known vulnerabilities for a package version, purl or Git commit across npm, PyPI, Go, Maven, crates.io, RubyGems, NuGet, Packagist, Linux distributions and more; batch checks of up to 100 dependencies; and full OSV records by OSV, GHSA or CVE id. Every record carries its source database (GitHub Advisory Database, PyPI, Go, RustSec, NVD, Debian, ...) and licence for attribution.

package-registry-metadata-download-stats.name: Package registries
package-registry-metadata-download-stats.description: npm, PyPI, crates.io and Maven Central package metadata: latest version, license, links, version history, weekly and monthly downloads and dependent counts.

particle.name: Particle
particle.description: Podcast intelligence: speaker-labelled transcripts, episode and show search, the people who appear, the sponsors and companies advertising, chart rankings, and bias and brand-suitability analysis.

patentscope-wipo-int.name: WIPO PATENTSCOPE patent search
patentscope-wipo-int.description: WIPO PATENTSCOPE (patentscope.wipo.int): full-text and fielded search over the PCT collection and 85 national and regional patent collections, bibliographic records of one PCT or national document (titles and abstracts per language, parties, classifications, priorities, designated states, family links), and the reference lists behind the query language (search field codes, office codes, IPC symbols). Anonymous, no login; result pages and records are the site's server-rendered JSF HTML, reference lists are its JSON autocomplete endpoints.

peerspot-com.name: PeerSpot
peerspot-com.description: Public PeerSpot software products, customer reviews, ratings and comparisons.

pennbid-bonfirehub-com.name: PennBid (Bonfire) public procurement portal
pennbid-bonfirehub-com.description: PennBid, the Pennsylvania public procurement portal hosted on Bonfire (pennbid.bonfirehub.com): the public lists of open and past (closed) opportunities and a lookup of one opportunity's listing record by ProjectID or detail URL. Read-only; no bidding, registration or vendor account surfaces. The opportunity detail page itself sits behind a Cloudflare managed challenge and is not read.

people-data-labs.name: People Data Labs
people-data-labs.description: Company identity resolution, enrichment and search from a domain, ticker, name or company profile.

pizzahut-ca.name: Pizza Hut Canada
pizzahut-ca.description: Canadian Pizza Hut store, menu, builder and promotion data from the public Yum storefront.

pizzahut-com.name: Pizza Hut US
pizzahut-com.description: Discover Pizza Hut US stores and read menus, products, modifiers, bundles and the paginated store directory.

play-google-com.name: Google Play Books and Movies & TV
play-google-com.description: Google Play Books and Movies & TV: search, ebook / audiobook / movie / TV show detail with rating histograms, offers and metadata, every season of a show with the episodes of any season by season id, book series and author pages, paginated user reviews, and the Google Books volume record by ISBN for joins. Logged-out store pages and the store's batchexecute RPC; apps are out of scope.

polymarket.name: Polymarket
polymarket.description: Prediction markets, outcome prices, events, topic tags, recurring series and sports metadata from Polymarket's Gamma API.

power-larc-nasa-gov.name: NASA POWER
power-larc-nasa-gov.description: NASA POWER (Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources) global weather history for a GeoJSON geometry: daily temperature, rainfall, solar radiation, humidity, wind and soil wetness since 1981, monthly and annual history, 2001-2020 climate normals, and the parameter catalog. Keyless public API; every value is for the 0.5 x 0.625 degree reanalysis grid cell containing the geometry's centroid.

prisjakt-nu.name: Prisjakt Sweden
prisjakt-nu.description: Prisjakt Sweden (prisjakt.nu) price comparison: product search and autocomplete, product detail with every retailer offer, lowest-price history, product and store reviews, and category listings. Prices in SEK from the site's own anonymous GraphQL API.

psacard-com.name: PSA
psacard-com.description: Browse public collectible price-guide categories, sets, grade values and featured dealer profiles. No cert or population lookup.

psauction-se.name: PS Auction
psauction-se.description: PS Auction (psauction.se), Sweden's online auction house for industrial equipment, vehicles, tools, bankruptcy estates and surplus goods: lot search with category, location, auction-type and shipping filters, lot detail, the current and ended auction calendar, one auction's lots or closed results, the filter taxonomy and the smart-search suggester. Read-only, anonymous, from the site's own bidder JSON API.

publicpurchase-com.name: Public Purchase
publicpurchase-com.description: Public Purchase (www.publicpurchase.com), The Public Group's e-procurement portal for US and Canadian public agencies: the region list, the per-region agency directory, each agency's public home page and the anonymous per-agency open-bid widget (title, short description, start/end dates, time left, addendum dates and the login-walled detail URL). Bid detail pages, documents, search and closed bids require a supplier login and are not covered.

pubmed-ncbi-nlm-nih-gov.name: PubMed and PMC
pubmed-ncbi-nlm-nih-gov.description: Biomedical literature from PubMed and PubMed Central (NIH National Library of Medicine): search with PubMed query syntax, document summaries, full article records with abstracts and MeSH indexing, PMID/PMCID/DOI resolution, similar and citing articles, and open-access full text. Uses NCBI's anonymous programmatic services (E-utilities, PMC ID Converter, BioC) only; the PubMed and PMC websites themselves sit behind a proof-of-work challenge and are not scraped.

purchasing-alberta-ca.name: Alberta Purchasing Connection
purchasing-alberta-ca.description: Alberta Purchasing Connection (purchasing.alberta.ca), the Government of Alberta's public procurement portal: search tender postings by text, status, organization, region, category, solicitation and opportunity type, UNSPSC code and post/close dates; one posting's full public record (dates, submission details, contact, documents metadata, plan holders, bidders, awards); the contracting-organization directory, the code tables used as filter values and the UNSPSC commodity-code lookup. Anonymous JSON API; document bytes are not retrievable (Cloudflare Turnstile plus login).

pypi-org.name: PyPI
pypi-org.description: Python Package Index: project and release metadata, dependencies and Python compatibility, distribution files with hashes, PEP 740 provenance, release feeds, the global change log, a user's projects and site statistics.

qasa.name: Qasa Swedish rentals
qasa.description: Swedish area resolution, rental search and listing details with SEK rent, service fees, dates and amenities.

quickstart-sos-nh-gov.name: New Hampshire business registry (QuickStart)
quickstart-sos-nh-gov.description: New Hampshire Secretary of State QuickStart business registry (quickstart.sos.nh.gov/online/businessinquire): search businesses by name, Business ID or filing number, read a business record (type, status, dates, addresses, principals, registered agent, NAICS purpose, trade names, trademarks) and its filing history. Anonymous public access only; no certificates, documents, orders or filings. Every call solves the site's JavaScript proof-of-work cookie gate itself; no solver.

ra-co.name: Resident Advisor
ra-co.description: Resident Advisor (ra.co) electronic music and nightlife events worldwide, read from RA's own anonymous GraphQL API: resolve a city to its RA area, list events for an area and date range with genre and keyword filters, facets and pagination, read one event with lineup, venue and the public primary ticket tiers (price, booking fee, currency, sale status, on-sale window), search events, venues, artists, promoters, labels and areas by name, and read venue and artist profiles with their upcoming events. Read only: no purchases, holds or resale offers.

rcc-acis-org.name: ACIS (NOAA Regional Climate Centers)
rcc-acis-org.description: Observed weather history for a piece of ground in the contiguous United States from the Applied Climate Information System: PRISM gridded daily and monthly precipitation, temperature and growing degree days for a GeoJSON point or polygon, nearby observing stations and their daily records, and county / climate-division / basin / forecast-office lookups. Anonymous public data API; every result carries spatial_precision, sources, missing layers and a location echo.

recherche-entreprises-api-gouv-fr.name: API Recherche d'entreprises (annuaire-entreprises.data.gouv.fr)
recherche-entreprises-api-gouv-fr.description: The French state's open company search (API Recherche d'entreprises, run by DINUM for annuaire-entreprises.data.gouv.fr): every diffusible French legal unit from INSEE Sirene and INPI's national company register (RNE) with legal form, NAF activity, salaried headcount band, INSEE size category, head office with address and coordinates, executives (dirigeants) as published, latest published revenue and net income, VAT numbers and public labels (ESS, RGE, Qualiopi, mission company...). Search by name, SIREN/SIRET or executive name and filter by NAF code or section, headcount band, category, legal form, postal code, commune, department, region, status, labels, revenue and net-income ranges and executive birth date; look a company up by SIREN; or list companies with establishments around a point. Keyless official open data under Licence Ouverte / Etalab 2.0.

reclameaqui-com-br.name: Reclame Aqui
reclameaqui-com-br.description: Reclame Aqui (reclameaqui.com.br), Brazil's consumer complaints platform: company reputation profiles (score, RA1000/Otimo/Bom/Regular/Ruim/Nao recomendada status, response and solution rates), company search by name or CNPJ, a company's complaints with tabs and pagination, full-text complaint search, single complaint text with the company reply and consumer evaluation, segment tree and best/worst segment rankings. Public read surfaces only; Portuguese (pt-BR) content.

recreation-gov.name: Recreation.gov
recreation-gov.description: Recreation.gov (US federal recreation reservations) read-only: search campgrounds, rec areas and permits by text, place or coordinates and stay dates; campground detail with rules, booking windows, rates and ratings; month availability grids; campsite listings and detail with open nights; visitor reviews; daily permit quota availability. Public anonymous JSON API of www.recreation.gov; availability and prices are snapshots, base fees only.

redfin-com.name: Redfin
redfin-com.description: Read publicly advertised US rental listings, floor plans, amenities and policies. Preview pending runner validation.

register-fca-org-uk.name: UK Financial Services Register (FCA)
register-fca-org-uk.description: The FCA's Financial Services Register (register.fca.org.uk): search authorised and registered firms by name or firm reference number, read a firm's record (status, permissions and their conditions, requirements, disciplinary history, waivers, appointed representatives, regulators, names, addresses, individuals), search approved individuals and read an individual's controlled functions, search and read funds (collective investment schemes), list the pre-set cryptoasset registers and the bulk CSV downloads. Anonymous public access to the register's own Aura API; no official FS Register API credentials.

reporter-nih-gov.name: NIH RePORTER
reporter-nih-gov.description: NIH RePORTER research funding database via the public, keyless api.reporter.nih.gov v2 API: search NIH and other HHS-funded research projects by text, principal investigator, organization, state, fiscal year, agency and activity code; read one project with abstract, investigators, program officers, costs and study section; and list the PubMed IDs of publications linked to a project.

resy-com.name: Resy
resy-com.description: Resy restaurant discovery and reservation availability from Resy's own web API: city lookup, venue search with inline slots, venue details, per-day availability with booked-out vs closed distinction, availability calendars and slot deposit/cancellation conditions. Read-only: no bookings, holds or notifications.

rover-com.name: Rover
rover-com.description: Rover public pet-care discovery without an account: search sitters by service (boarding, house sitting, drop-in visits, dog walking, doggy day care), location, dates, dog size and price; read a sitter's public profile with every listed rate (sitter rate and the full price including Rover's owner-side service fee), acceptance rules and cancellation policy; read the sitter's public availability calendar for a date window; list the sitter's reviews; and resolve free-text places to the location strings the search accepts. Source: the www.rover.com /api/v7/ JSON API the website calls anonymously. US market from a US ISP exit (country and currency follow the request IP); prices are sitter-listed advertised rates in USD, not quotes; availability is what the sitter listed, not a booking guarantee.

rtings-com.name: RTINGS
rtings-com.description: RTINGS public-tier lab reviews, buying guides, rankings and tested-product metadata; member-only measurements remain unavailable.

russelcoinc-com.name: Russelco Inc
russelcoinc-com.description: Russelco Inc (russelcoinc.com): a New Jersey wholesale distributor's public storefront (OTC medicine, personal care, baby, household, snacks; ~940 products, USD) built on the iinvy Next.js platform. Search and browse the catalogue with category, sort, on-sale and wholesale-price options, read one product by UPC with its 'you may also like' items, and walk the category tree. Anonymous and read-only: no cart, login or ordering.

safer-fmcsa-dot-gov.name: FMCSA SAFER and SMS carrier registry
safer-fmcsa-dot-gov.description: FMCSA's public motor carrier safety data: the SAFER Company Snapshot system (safer.fmcsa.dot.gov: carrier name search, Company Snapshot by USDOT or MC/MX number with identity, authority, fleet size, drivers, cargo, 24-month inspection/out-of-service/crash counts and safety rating) and the Safety Measurement System (ai.fmcsa.dot.gov/SMS: paginated carrier search with power units, inspection and crash totals, carrier overview with BASIC status, investigations and activity summary, the per-carrier XML export of individual inspections, violations and crashes, and name autocomplete). Anonymous, read-only; Licensing & Insurance (li-public, reCAPTCHA) and the QCMobile API (registered key) are not covered.

saferproducts-gov.name: CPSC Recalls (SaferProducts.gov)
saferproducts-gov.description: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission recalls from the public Recalls REST API on saferproducts.gov: search by title, product, category, firm, retailer and date, or read one recall's hazards, remedies, units, firms, countries, UPCs and images.

sam-gov.name: SAM.gov
sam-gov.description: US federal procurement notice search and detail, including agency, deadlines, attachments and amendment history.

sanctionssearch-ofac-treas-gov.name: OFAC Sanctions List Search
sanctionssearch-ofac-treas-gov.description: U.S. Treasury OFAC Sanctions List Search (sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov) and the Sanctions List Service REST API (sanctionslistservice.ofac.treas.gov): fuzzy name / ID-number / address search across the SDN and Non-SDN lists with program, country, type and list filters and a minimum match score; the Details page of one record (identifications, aliases, addresses); the structured Enhanced XML entity record of the Sanctions List Service; the reference lists of program codes and list names; and the publication history of list changes for a year. Anonymous, read-only, US-hosted.

search-ipaustralia-gov-au.name: IP Australia trade mark search
search-ipaustralia-gov-au.description: Australian Trade Mark Search (search.ipaustralia.gov.au), IP Australia's public trade mark register: quick search by words, owner name or number; advanced search with word, image, class, status, date, kind, party, attorney, ACN and number filters; 100-per-page pagination and sorting; and the full public record of a trade mark (words, image, status, dates, owners and addresses for service, goods and services, indexing constituents, history).

search-sunbiz-org.name: Florida Sunbiz
search-sunbiz-org.description: Florida official entity name lists and business registration records, including source-labelled officers, registered agents and filing links.

seatgeek-com.name: SeatGeek
seatgeek-com.description: SeatGeek event discovery: search events by team, artist, venue, place, date and category; event, performer and venue detail; search-box suggestions; event-level ticket availability snapshots (listing and ticket counts, price range). Reads the anonymous SeatGeek Platform API (api.seatgeek.com/2) with the web app's public client id. Per-listing offers are behind DataDome and not covered.

seattle-gov.name: City of Seattle
seattle-gov.description: City of Seattle (seattle.gov): the City Council roster with office phone, email, page ids and term dates, one councilmember's typed contact card with CMS provenance, the City Clerk's terms of office for every elected official, council district lookup by coordinates (ArcGIS), site search, generic CMS page content and Council Connection news. Anonymous throughout: the Ingeniux content API, the public ArcGIS feature services and the WordPress REST API need no cookies, tokens or keys.

sec-gov.name: SEC EDGAR
sec-gov.description: Official SEC company profiles, filings, filing sections, 13F holdings and XBRL concept facts, plus bulk collection of companies, XBRL facts and the daily filings index.

semanticscholar-org.name: Semantic Scholar
semanticscholar-org.description: Semantic Scholar's scholarly search and citation graph through its public Academic Graph API: keyword paper search with filters, title matching, paper details by S2 id, DOI, arXiv, PubMed or other identifiers, batch lookups, citations and references with contexts and intents, recommendations, and author search, profiles and publication lists. Anonymous public endpoints only.

services-ecourts-gov-in.name: India eCourts district court services
services-ecourts-gov-in.description: India eCourts Services portal for district and taluka courts (services.ecourts.gov.in, ecourtindia_v6): the state -> district -> court complex -> court establishment reference cascade the portal's search forms are built on, and the public case status record of a case identified by its 16-character CNR (Case Number Record): case type, filing and registration numbers and dates, status, court and judge, petitioners and respondents with their advocates, acts and sections, hearing history and listed orders. Anonymous, read-only; the portal's CAPTCHA-gated searches (by party name, case number, filing number, FIR, advocate, act, cause list, court orders) are not covered.

servicodados-ibge-gov-br.name: IBGE service data API
servicodados-ibge-gov-br.description: Brazil's national statistics institute (IBGE) open JSON API at servicodados.ibge.gov.br: territorial codes (localidades), SIDRA aggregated statistics (agregados: official municipal / state / national population and household counts from the 2022 Census and the yearly population estimates, IPCA, PNAD, GDP and ~8,000 other tables), 2010 Census first-name frequencies and rankings, IBGE news/releases and release calendar, country profiles and indicators (paises), territorial meshes (malhas) and the CNAE activity classification. Anonymous, no key, Portuguese-language values as published.

sevenrooms.name: SevenRooms reservations
sevenrooms.description: Look up a public SevenRooms venue and observe bookable reservation slots. Never creates bookings or holds.

shopify.name: Shopify
shopify.description: Search products across Shopify merchants or within one store, resolve product identifiers and inspect variants through Shopify's UCP catalogs.

similarweb.name: Similarweb
similarweb.description: Website traffic, audiences and search intelligence from Similarweb.

skyscanner-net.name: Skyscanner
skyscanner-net.description: Skyscanner flight search and fare comparison: place autosuggest (sky place ids and entity ids), live itinerary search by origin, destination, dates, passengers and cabin with airlines, durations, stops, fare policy flags and booking-source deep links, plus cached indicative fares per day and per month. Anonymous same-origin JSON APIs on www.skyscanner.com; live quotes and cached indicative prices are labelled as such; live quotes include the site's estimate of taxes and fees.

socrata-com.name: Socrata open-data portals
socrata-com.description: Discover and query datasets on any public Socrata (Tyler Data & Insights) open-data portal: city, county and state portals such as data.cityofchicago.org, data.ny.gov, data.austintexas.gov, data.wa.gov and hundreds more. Search the cross-portal catalog (Socrata Discovery API), read a dataset's columns, row count, license and update details, and query rows with SoQL (select/where/order/group/full text). Portals are verified as Socrata domains before they are contacted. Keyless; no app token.

sos-state-co-us.name: Colorado Secretary of State business database
sos-state-co-us.description: Colorado Secretary of State business database (the live registry at www.sos.state.co.us/biz): business name, ID and document-number search, entity summary with periodic report month and registered agent, and the filing history with document links and periodic-report due dates.

sothebys-com.name: Sotheby's
sothebys-com.description: Sotheby's (sothebys.com) auctions, lots with estimates and realized prices, Buy Now (marketplace) items and the site-wide search over lots, auctions, artists and articles, from the public GraphQL API (clientapi.prod.sothelabs.com) and Algolia search index behind the website.

spothero-com.name: SpotHero parking
spothero-com.description: SpotHero parking discovery and pricing for the US and Canada: hourly/daily, monthly and airport parking searches with itemised quotes for a time window, single-facility quotes, customer reviews, destinations (venue name search and per-id detail with typical price ranges), upcoming events, and the city and airport directories. Read-only: no holds, bookings or checkout.

stackexchange-com.name: Stack Exchange
stackexchange-com.description: Stack Exchange public questions, answers and accepted answers with source attribution. Quora is not covered.

startwho-com.name: StartWho NFL fantasy projections
startwho-com.description: StartWho (startwho.com) NFL fantasy football projections from the site's own JSON API: weekly projections built from sportsbook player props (each market with its consensus line, odds and per-sportsbook lines), season and rest-of-season projections with overall and positional rank, weekly projected-vs-actual results with the site's accuracy grading, and the injury list. Standard, half-PPR and PPR scoring; every position. Anonymous.

steelcitycollectibles-com.name: Steel City Collectibles
steelcitycollectibles-com.description: Steel City Collectibles (www.steelcitycollectibles.com), a US sports-card and trading-card retailer: keyword search, category listings with filters and sort, the group-break room, product detail with USD prices, stock, release dates, images and attributes, and the related-products feed, read from the storefront's server-rendered pages and its JSON routes.

stockx-com.name: StockX
stockx-com.description: StockX marketplace data from its own GraphQL gateway: product search and category browse, per-size market state (lowest ask, highest bid, last sale, statistics), recent sales and the ask/bid order book. US and GB markets.

stubhub-com.name: StubHub
stubhub-com.description: Search StubHub events, read event details and retrieve paginated public resale offers with quantity restrictions and price/fee disclosures. Uses anonymous web pages and read-only inventory requests.

substack-com.name: Substack
substack-com.description: Public Substack archives, search and free posts or paid previews.

successfactors-com.name: SAP SuccessFactors career sites
successfactors-com.description: Career sites of any employer on SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Marketing (Career Site Builder, formerly jobs2web), the platform behind many large European employers' job boards (Fraunhofer, EY, BASF, Boehringer Ingelheim, E.ON, Schaeffler, BMW, DLR and thousands more): search a site's open postings with its own keyword, location and facet filters and page through them, and read one posting with its full description, dates, location, requisition id and apply link. Keyed by the career-site URL (the employer's own domain); pages are verified to be SuccessFactors pages and robots.txt is respected on every request.

talentsforever-com.name: Talents Forever
talentsforever-com.description: Talents Forever, a World of Warcraft: Forever talent calculator built from the beta client: every class's talent trees with each rank's text, prerequisites and what changed from Classic, decoding of the site's build links into ranks per talent (CC BY 4.0 data from its JSON export), the most popular level 60 and level 30 builds per class and spec, and the order players place talent points in while leveling, with the talents held at any level.

target-com.name: Target
target-com.description: Discover featured Target US products, inspect product specifications and child variant options, and read every public customer review of a product with a resumable cursor. No search, price or inventory coverage.

tenders-etimad-sa.name: Etimad tenders (tenders.etimad.sa)
tenders-etimad-sa.description: Saudi Arabia's government procurement portal Etimad (منصة اعتماد, National Center for Government Resources Systems): visitor tender search with keyword, reference number, type, activity, agency, region, status and publish-window filters; tender detail with the basic information, dates (Gregorian and Hijri) and classification/execution-place tabs; direct-purchase and limited-tender announcements; pre-qualification invitations; future (pre-planning) projects; and the region/activity/agency/type lookups behind the filters. Anonymous JSON endpoints and server-rendered HTML; Arabic content, SAR amounts, Asia/Riyadh times. Supplier-only pages (announcement and pre-planning details, attachments) are not covered.

tenders-gov-au.name: AusTender
tenders-gov-au.description: AusTender, the Australian Government procurement portal: current and closed approaches to market (ATMs) with closing times in ACT local time and UTC, full ATM notices including the free-text instructions where mandatory briefings are announced, and Commonwealth contract notices from the public OCDS API by publication, modification, start or end date, or by CN id.

tenders-wa-gov-au.name: Tenders WA (tenders.wa.gov.au)
tenders-wa-gov-au.description: Western Australian Government procurement portal Tenders WA: open, new, closed, awarded, early-advice and DCSP tender notice listings, advanced tender search with keyword, state, type, agency, region and date filters, tender detail (status, UNSPSC, regions, closing time, specification document list, briefing/site visit and awarded contract link), recently awarded contracts, contract search, contract detail (value, dates, contractors, associated tender) and the agency/region lookup lists behind the search form. Read anonymously from the server-rendered Struts pages and JSON lookups; no login.

themoviedb-org.name: TMDB (The Movie Database)
themoviedb-org.description: The Movie Database (themoviedb.org) from the public website, no API key and no login: title search with TMDB ids, movie and TV show details (overview, release dates, genres, user score, top-billed cast, keywords, facts), full cast and crew, streaming / rent / buy availability per country (JustWatch-sourced offers as the TMDB watch page shows them), per-country theatrical and digital release dates with certifications, people (biography, personal info, filmography) and TV season episode lists.

tickpick-com.name: TickPick
tickpick-com.description: TickPick (US resale ticket marketplace, all-in pricing): discover sports, concert, theater and comedy events by free text, performer, venue or location, and read event details with event-level listing statistics (count, min/max/average all-in per-ticket price) and daily/hourly price history from TickPick's own web API. Per-listing offers are not available (DataDome-protected).

tiendanube-com.name: Tiendanube / Nuvemshop stores
tiendanube-com.description: Product catalogues, prices, stock, variants and categories from any Tiendanube (Nuvemshop in Brazil) store, read from its public storefront pages and sitemap while respecting the store's robots.txt. Input is the store's domain or any URL on it; pages are verified to be Tiendanube storefront pages.

todaytix-com.name: TodayTix
todaytix-com.description: TodayTix theatre discovery and availability: the cities the site sells in, show search by city, keyword, date, price and sort, show detail with event-level low prices and publicly disclosed Rush/Lottery information, per-performance ticket snapshots with price bands and seat counts, and venue profiles. Read-only; no holds, lotteries or checkout.

trademarks-ipo-gov-uk.name: UK IPO trade mark register
trademarks-ipo-gov-uk.description: UK Intellectual Property Office trade mark register: search owners by name or UK postcode, list the UK national marks an owner holds, and read a trade mark's case detail (status, dates, goods and services, owners, representatives, publications) and case history (status, event and goods history).

traderjoes-com.name: Trader Joe's
traderjoes-com.description: Trader Joe’s public store finder, store-specific product search and product nutrition, ingredients and allergens.

travel-state-gov.name: U.S. State Department Travel Advisories (travel.state.gov)
travel-state-gov.description: U.S. Department of State travel advisory levels (1-4) and advice for every destination it covers, plus the per-country travel information pages (entry requirements, safety, local laws, health, transportation, embassy contacts), from the Bureau of Consular Affairs public data API.

treasury-fiscal-data.name: Treasury Fiscal Data
treasury-fiscal-data.description: US Treasury Fiscal Data: the national debt to the penny, daily cash balances and tax receipts, monthly receipts and outlays, Treasury auction and buyback results, interest rates and expense on the debt, the gold reserve and official exchange rates.

firecrawl-trends.name: Trends
firecrawl-trends.description: Search interest over time and by region, related and rising queries, keyword suggestions and what is trending now.

trip-com.name: Trip.com
trip-com.description: Public hotel destination directories and hotel profiles, room types, amenities and policies. No date-specific availability or offers.

turo-com.name: Turo
turo-com.description: Search public US Turo rental vehicles, read vehicle details and request anonymous dated price estimates. Search is a bounded source window, not exhaustive inventory. No account, booking or checkout actions.

txsmartbuy-gov.name: Texas SmartBuy ESBD
txsmartbuy-gov.description: Texas Electronic State Business Daily (ESBD) on txsmartbuy.gov: search and read public solicitation notices, pre-solicitation notices, awards posted without a solicitation and grant opportunities, with attachments, from the Texas Comptroller's anonymous SuiteCommerce JSON services.

uhaul-com.name: U-Haul
uhaul-com.description: uhaul.com truck rental quotes and availability: search in-town (local) and one-way truck rates for a pickup location, optional drop-off location and pickup date, read the per-model rate basis (rental rate, mileage rate, extra day/mile, allowed days and distance, environmental fee) and the site's own availability text; autosuggest pickup/drop-off place names; list U-Haul locations in a city, read one location's profile (address, phone, hours, rating, base in-town rates) and its customer reviews. Read-only: no reservations, holds or checkout.

ungm-org.name: UN Global Marketplace
ungm-org.description: UN Global Marketplace (ungm.org), the procurement portal of the United Nations system: public procurement notices (tenders, RFPs, RFQs, EOIs) with deadlines, publishing agency, beneficiary country, reference, contacts, links and UNSPSC codes; published contract awards with supplier, award date and agency; and the UNSPSC category taxonomy used by both searches. Anonymous, read-only.

untourism-int.name: UN Tourism
untourism-int.description: Discover UN Tourism free statistical files and indicators, and read live country-year tourism observations with source units, flags and editions.

upspring.name: Upspring
upspring.description: Competitor ad intelligence from Upspring: Meta ads with their hooks, personas and offers, and the brands behind them.

us-forums-blizzard-com.name: Blizzard US Forums
us-forums-blizzard-com.description: Blizzard Entertainment's US community forums (us.forums.blizzard.com, Discourse multisite): categories, latest/top topic listings, topics with their posts, full-text post search, single posts, public user profiles with activity, and the latest-posts feed, for every locale/site forum on the host (WoW, WoW: Forever, Diablo, Hearthstone, Overwatch, StarCraft, ...). Anonymous read-only JSON routes; nothing behind Battle.net login.

usaspending-gov.name: USAspending
usaspending-gov.description: Federal awards, transactions, recipients and agencies from USAspending.gov.

uspto-gov.name: USPTO patents, trademarks and assignments
uspto-gov.description: United States Patent and Trademark Office public records: Patent Public Search (full-text patent and pre-grant publication search and bibliographic documents), Trademark Search (word-mark search), TSDR trademark status records by serial or registration number, and Assignment Center ownership records for patents and trademarks. Anonymous, stateless JSON APIs behind the USPTO web applications; US coverage only.

uswitch-com.name: Uswitch broadband
uswitch-com.description: UK home broadband price comparison from Uswitch's own broadband API: addresses at a postcode, availability-checked deals with prices, speeds, contract terms and fees, deal detail, provider directory and Trustpilot scores. Read-only; no switching or sign-up.

v-dem-net.name: V-Dem
v-dem-net.description: Official V-Dem democracy indices, codebook metadata, country crosswalk and regime transformation episodes.

vpic-nhtsa-dot-gov.name: NHTSA vPIC vehicle decoder
vpic-nhtsa-dot-gov.description: NHTSA's Product Information Catalog and Vehicle Listing (vPIC): decode a VIN or WMI into make, model, year, trim, plant and vehicle type; list makes, models, manufacturers and their WMIs; look up the decode variable dictionary. Public US federal data, no key.

vrbo-com.name: Vrbo vacation rentals
vrbo-com.description: Vrbo (US storefront) destination lookup, dated vacation-rental search, listing details and anonymous USD stay quotes. Read-only; no bookings, inquiries or account data.

walmart-com.name: Walmart.com
walmart-com.description: Walmart US storefront: product search, category browsing, product detail with variants, prices and fulfillment options, customer reviews, search suggestions and store pages, read from the server-rendered __NEXT_DATA__ of www.walmart.com and its public typeahead JSON.

wayfair-com.name: Wayfair Careers and Product Reviews
wayfair-com.description: Wayfair job postings from the careers site's own JSON search endpoint and server-rendered job pages: filtered job search with the full employer-authored description available per job, one job's complete detail (JSON-LD JobPosting plus the page's inline job data), and the filter vocabularies (teams, categories, countries, states, locations, job types) with their ids. Also the storefront's customer reviews for one product (paged to the last review, newest first, with rating distribution and totals).

web-archive-org.name: Wayback Machine
web-archive-org.description: Find archived website snapshots and read text from archived HTML pages.

web-pcc-gov-tw.name: Taiwan Government e-Procurement (web.pcc.gov.tw)
web-pcc-gov-tw.description: Taiwan's Government e-Procurement System (政府電子採購網): search tender notices (招標公告) and award / failed-to-award notices (決標公告, 無法決標公告), read the full notice detail pages, and look up agency codes. Anonymous, server-rendered HTML; no login, no documents behind the member login.

who-int.name: WHO Global Health Observatory
who-int.description: Official WHO indicator search, dimension codes and paginated observations with source licensing and attribution.

wikipedia.name: Wikipedia
wikipedia.description: Wikipedia and its sister projects through Wikimedia Enterprise, the Wikimedia Foundation's official API: current articles by title, parsed infoboxes and sections, and Wikidata entities.

wildfirerisk-org.name: USFS Wildfire Risk to Communities
wildfirerisk-org.description: USDA Forest Service Wildfire Risk to Communities (wildfirerisk.org): 30 m raster wildfire risk values (burn probability, risk to homes, wildfire consequence, hazard potential, exposure type, flame length) for a GeoJSON point or polygon, the containing county, community and tribal area with their percentile ranks, place search, per-place summaries and rankings within a county, state or the nation. US only (CONUS, Alaska, Hawaii).

woocommerce-com.name: WooCommerce stores
woocommerce-com.description: Product catalogues, prices, stock, variations and categories from any WooCommerce store through the public WooCommerce Store API that storefronts use. Input is the store's domain or any URL on it; responses are verified to be Store API data.

world-openfoodfacts-org.name: Open Food Facts
world-openfoodfacts-org.description: Open Food Facts, the open database of packaged foods (world.openfoodfacts.org): product facts by barcode (name, brand, quantity, countries, ingredients, allergens, additives, Nutri-Score, NOVA, per-100g and per-serving nutrition, images), full-text and filtered product search over the Search-a-licious service, and taxonomy autocomplete for categories, brands, labels and countries. Anonymous read API; data under ODbL, images CC BY-SA.

worldhappiness-report.name: World Happiness Report
worldhappiness-report.description: Official WHR dashboard aggregate rankings, country-year indicators and edition appendix metadata; not Gallup respondent microdata.

worldtabletennis-com.name: World Table Tennis
worldtabletennis-com.description: Public WTT table tennis events, official match results and cards, and senior/youth ITTF ranking lists.

wowhead-com.name: Wowhead
wowhead-com.description: Wowhead (World of Warcraft and Blizzard games): news RSS feeds and paged news lists with articles and comments, the Blizzard Blue Tracker (forum posts and news), search suggestions and database tooltips, all from the site's anonymous JSON, XML and server-rendered data islands. Public guide discovery (class, build, leveling and every other category, on retail and each Classic branch) and full guide markup with the guide's page navigation and structured talent builds, paginated page comments, complete comment replies, Blue Tracker news detail, and the public Wowhead forums (board topic listings and topic posts).

www-60-tools.name: 60.tools
www-60-tools.description: 60.tools, a World of Warcraft: Forever database and gear planner: curated best-in-slot lists per class and role at the beta level cap (30) and a level-20 archive, with ranked items per slot, Alliance and Horde picks, sources, crafting materials, enchants, consumables and the talent build that goes with the gear; every class talent with its Forever change versus Classic; and item details with Classic comparison, sources and the lists that rank the item. Read from the site's server-rendered pages.

x-com.name: X
x-com.description: Inference-backed public X research with sourced structured outputs.

xe-com.name: XE currency data
xe-com.description: XE (xe.com) mid-market foreign exchange data read from the public site: convert an amount between two currencies with 7/30/90-day statistics, the full live rate table for a base currency, the historical rate table for any past date, a decoded chart series over 1 day to 10 years, the currency encyclopedia profile of one currency, and the list of every currency XE covers. Anonymous, read-only; money-transfer quoting and account features are out of scope.

ycombinator-com.name: Y Combinator
ycombinator-com.description: Public YC startup directory: browse or search companies by batch and filters, list batches, read company profiles and advertised jobs.

youtube.name: YouTube
youtube.description: Read public YouTube video metadata, descriptions and available transcripts through Firecrawl Scrape.

zillow-com.name: Zillow
zillow-com.description: US home search, property details, photos, schools, scores and valuation history, plus rental listings (apartments, houses, townhomes, condos, rooms) and apartment buildings with per-unit availability, and the Zillow Observed Rent Index (ZORI) market rent series by metro, city, county or ZIP from Zillow Research.

ziprecruiter-com.name: ZipRecruiter US
ziprecruiter-com.description: ZipRecruiter US job marketplace: job search by title and city/state (the public /Jobs/ directory pages, 20 cards a page with pay, employment and location types, benefits and posting time), full job postings (JobPosting JSON-LD plus the page's job details), a company's open jobs near a city, salary percentiles for a title in a city, and title/location autocomplete.

zockify-com.name: Zockify
zockify-com.description: Zockify's World of Warcraft: Forever tools (zockify.com/forever/): the talent calculator's full talent trees per class, the gear planner's stat weight presets (stat priorities and hit caps per role) and ranked item lists per class, slot and level, and the class guides with what changed in Forever and which talents are new or removed. Read from the static data files the planners load and the server-rendered guide pages.

tools.name: Get ad
tools.description: Use with ids from list_ads. The same creative shows more fields under topic=political or an EU region than under the US all-ads context. An unknown creative is not_found.

tools.name: Get advertiser
tools.description: Use with an advertiser_id from suggest, search_advertisers or list_ads. An unknown id is not_found.

tools.name: List ads
tools.description: Use after suggest/search_advertisers resolved an advertiser_id or domain, or with a pasted advertiser page URL. For topic=political the advertiser/domain filter is optional (the regional political feed, most recent first). Pass `continuation` back with identical filters for the next page.

tools.name: Political stats
tools.description: Use for election-ad aggregates. Shares are fractions of the regional total as published by the site (labels inferred from the Insights UI). The daily series has ~3000 points; request it with include_daily.

tools.name: Resolve locations
tools.description: Use to label criterion ids such as 21162 (Nebraska). Unknown ids are reported in missing_ids; if none resolves the call is not_found.

tools.name: Search advertisers
tools.description: Use when you need a paged, exhaustive advertiser list (suggest caps at 20) or political advertiser metadata. Pass `continuation` back with the same query, region and topic for the next page.

tools.name: Suggest
tools.description: Start here to turn a brand or company name into an advertiser_id (for list_ads / get_advertiser) or a domain (for list_ads). A query with no match is a valid empty result.

tools.name: Get bulletin
tools.description: When you know the bulletin number (directive pages name the bulletin they were released with) and want its text and the directives it announces.

tools.name: Get directive
tools.description: When you know the directive number and want its current edition's dates, PDF and summary. Use list_publications with collection=directives to find numbers.

tools.name: Get public notice
tools.description: When you have an application number from the PNoA listing, a notice or a decision and want the notice record as published.

tools.name: Get published decision
tools.description: When you have an application number and want to confirm whether and when the AER decided it. For the notice before the decision call get_public_notice.

tools.name: List publications
tools.description: To browse or filter AER publications of one type by date or keyword, and to find the directive / bulletin numbers, decision numbers and PDF links to pass to the detail functions. For a free-text search across the whole site use site_search.

tools.name: Site search
tools.description: To find pages and PDFs about a topic, directive, company or decision anywhere on aer.ca when you do not know which listing holds it.

tools.name: Foods by nutrient
tools.description: To rank or compare foods by a nutrient, e.g. iron (FE) across ready-to-eat breakfast cereals (sub_food_group_id 30), sodium (NA) in cheeses, or the highest-protein foods overall.

tools.name: Get food
tools.description: After search_foods, list_foods_in_group or foods_by_nutrient returned a pfk, or when the user pastes an AFCD food URL. Answers 'nutrients in Vegemite' (F008785).

tools.name: List food groups
tools.description: To discover the group and sub group ids before filtering or listing foods by category (e.g. find 'Breakfast cereals, ready to eat').

tools.name: List foods in group
tools.description: To enumerate every food in a category with its provenance notes, e.g. all yeast extract spreads (2/11) or all ready-to-eat breakfast cereals (7/30). Ids come from list_food_groups.

tools.name: List nutrients
tools.description: To find the nutrient code for foods_by_nutrient (e.g. 'iron' -> FE, 'sodium' -> NA, 'energy' -> ENERGY-04) or to read how AFCD defines a nutrient.

tools.name: Search foods
tools.description: To find the AFCD Public Food Key of a food by name (e.g. 'vegemite', 'weet-bix', 'lamb chop'), to list all foods in a group, or to browse foods starting with a letter. Follow with get_food for the nutrient profile.

tools.name: Price tiers
tools.description: Read advertised quantity-based unit prices in USD from source dollarPrice fields. Excludes shipping, tax and customization; localized display strings are separate and not labeled USD.

tools.name: Product
tools.description: Read an Alibaba wholesale product title, MOQ, quantity unit and supplier identity. Source-advertised facts; availability remains unknown.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Find wholesale products and suppliers in Alibaba's public keyword listing (/premium/<keyword>.html), which is mostly sponsored placements. Returns 40 offers per page with source price strings and MOQ, not normalized price or verified inventory. Pass the returned next_cursor as cursor for the next page; the listing serves about 50 pages (2,000 offers), so has_more is false past page 50 even when source_total is larger. Narrow the query to reach offers beyond that.

tools.name: Specifications
tools.description: Read supplier-advertised product specifications as name/value pairs. Preserves duplicate attribute labels and makes no independent certification claims.

tools.name: Supplier
tools.description: Read the supplier summary attached to an Alibaba product: identity, country, business type, platform tenure and source-reported response/delivery metrics. Not a supplier background verification.

tools.name: Collections
tools.description: List curated collection links from the Allbirds US homepage. Partial discovery, not every archived collection.

tools.name: Details
tools.description: Read substantive product design, materials, sustainability and care sections. Unsupported layouts fail closed.

tools.name: Product
tools.description: Read the canonical product profile and source-labelled offer currency; stock is a source snapshot.

tools.name: Products
tools.description: Browse one Allbirds collection page. Follow next_page with the same collection and limit; prices are omitted until product details supply currency.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Find predictive product suggestions for a query. Up to ten results; this is not exhaustive or paginated search.

tools.name: Variants
tools.description: Compare published sizes, SKUs, color labels and size-level prices and stock for one product.

tools.name: Browse software
tools.description: Explore a category or feature across the catalog rather than alternatives to one product.

tools.name: Get alternatives
tools.description: When the user asks for alternatives to a known product; chain from search_software's url_name.

tools.name: Get software
tools.description: After search_software or get_alternatives returned a url_name, or when the user pastes an alternativeto.net/software/... URL.

tools.name: Search software
tools.description: Start here to resolve a product name to its url_name, then call get_software for details (structured license, pricing, rating, links) or get_alternatives for its alternatives.

tools.name: Bestsellers
tools.description: Rank products in an Amazon US category (top sellers in headphones, books, toys) without a search query. Pair with product or specifications for details of a ranked ASIN.

tools.name: Offer
tools.description: Get the featured buy-box offer for one Amazon.com ASIN or product URL: displayed price, list price and savings, boolean in-stock state with Amazon's availability text, seller and shipper, item condition, delivery promise, coupon and other-offers hints. Unknown values are null.

tools.name: Photos
tools.description: Get the selected product image gallery.

tools.name: Prices
tools.description: Check current buy-box price and stock state for up to five Amazon.com ASINs in one call. Each row carries price, list price, in-stock flag, availability text, seller and condition; an ASIN that cannot be read gets an error string instead of failing the batch.

tools.name: Product
tools.description: Get public Amazon product details, displayed price, images, variants and review totals.

tools.name: Review summary
tools.description: Get the displayed rating and count; individual review text is not included.

tools.name: Reviews
tools.description: What buyers say about a product or book: individual review text, stars, dates, verified purchase and the rating distribution, from the public product-page sample. For totals only, use review_summary.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Fetch one search page. Next-page input is returned; blocked pages raise an error.

tools.name: Specifications
tools.description: Get product specification tables (including detail-bullet lists for books and media), best sellers rank per category, and feature bullets.

tools.name: Suggestions
tools.description: Get autocomplete suggestions for a search prefix.

tools.name: Variants
tools.description: List the variant dimensions (color, size, style...) and sibling ASINs of an Amazon.com product, with the swatch availability flag Amazon renders. Set include_prices to also fetch the buy-box price and stock state of the selected ASIN and up to max_priced-1 sibling ASINs.

tools.name: Variations
tools.description: List product variants and their attributes. Availability and prices require a separate lookup.

tools.name: Get route
tools.description: Route detail after `list_routes`; the train numbers feed `train_status`, the stop codes feed `get_station`.

tools.name: Get station
tools.description: Station detail once you have a code from `list_stations`, `search_stations`, a route's stops or a train's stops.

tools.name: List routes
tools.description: Find a route code or name for `get_route`, or filter `live_trains` by `route_name`.

tools.name: List stations
tools.description: Start here to find station codes for `get_station`, `search_stations` inputs or route stops; filter by `state` to keep the result small.

tools.name: Live trains
tools.description: A snapshot of where trains are right now; use `train_status` for one train with its stop-by-stop times.

tools.name: Search stations
tools.description: Find a station code when you know a place name or a partial name; `get_station` for full detail.

tools.name: Train status
tools.description: Train status by number, the Track Your Train equivalent. Train numbers come from `get_route` or `live_trains`.

tools.name: Get keyword research
tools.description: The core research call: pass a keyword slug from list_collection_keywords (or the keyword text / research page URL). Filter sources or cap rows per modifier to keep the response small; the related group alone can hold 2,500 rows.

tools.name: List collection keywords
tools.description: Browse a collection from list_collections to find the keyword slug to pass to get_keyword_research.

tools.name: List collections
tools.description: Start here to discover collection slugs for list_collection_keywords, or to see how many brand keyword reports the free catalog holds.

tools.name: Get candles
tools.description: Backtests and price history, e.g. 1-minute BTC-USD candles between two dates: call with `granularity: 60`, `start`, `end`, `max_candles: 3000`, then follow `next_start` until it is null.

tools.name: Get currency
tools.description: Networks and precision of an asset before interpreting sizes or addresses.

tools.name: Get order book
tools.description: Liquidity and spread at a point in time; use `depth` to bound the payload.

tools.name: Get product
tools.description: Validate a product id or read its tick sizes before interpreting prices and sizes.

tools.name: Get ticker
tools.description: Current price and 24h range of a pair; poll it instead of the order book when you only need best bid/ask.

tools.name: Get wrapped asset
tools.description: The cbETH:ETH conversion rate, APY and circulating supply.

tools.name: List currencies
tools.description: Find a currency id, or list every online crypto or fiat currency.

tools.name: List products
tools.description: Find the `product_id` (e.g. `BTC-USD`) for tickers, order books, trades and candles, or list every market quoted in a currency.

tools.name: List trades
tools.description: Tick-level trade history; walk `next_after` backwards for a backfill, or poll with `before` set to the newest trade id you have.

tools.name: List volume summary
tools.description: Rank or screen markets by volume, or check whether a pair trades on the spot book, RFQ or conversions.

tools.name: Alert
tools.description: Read the full text of an alert returned by alerts_active or alerts_history.

tools.name: Alerts active
tools.description: Which watches, warnings and advisories (red flag, fire weather, flood, heat, severe storms) are in effect right now for this paddock, parcel or point, optionally including those within up to 5 km. For past alerts use alerts_history; for one alert's full text use alert.

tools.name: Alerts history
tools.description: Which alerts affected this parcel or paddock in the last week (start/end as YYYY-MM-DD). Pass `continuation` from the previous page to continue; alerts_active for what is in effect now.

tools.name: Forecast daily
tools.description: How much rain is forecast per day over the next 7 days for this field, with highs, lows, wind and minimum humidity. Hourly detail: forecast_hourly.

tools.name: Forecast hourly
tools.description: Hourly temperature and humidity for the next two days (default 48 hours, up to 156) at this paddock or parcel.

tools.name: Bulk company enrichment
tools.description: Enrich up to ten companies in one call, billed 30 Firecrawl credits per matched company; unmatched records are free.

tools.name: Company enrichment
tools.description: Use when you have a domain or LinkedIn company URL and need the company behind it. For a company you can only name, search first.

tools.name: Complete company information
tools.description: Look up a company by its Apollo ID; use companies/enrich when you have a domain instead.

tools.name: Company job postings
tools.description: Find current hiring activity at a known company. Each requested page costs 30 Firecrawl credits.

tools.name: Company news search
tools.description: Find news about known Apollo companies, optionally filtered by category and dates. Each requested page costs 30 Firecrawl credits.

tools.name: Company search
tools.description: Use to build a list from a shape: size, location, industry, technology. It bills per page, so ask for the page size you need rather than paging through the whole market.

tools.name: Bulk people enrichment
tools.description: Enrich up to ten identified people in one call, billed 30 Firecrawl credits per matched person; unmatched records are free.

tools.name: Complete person information
tools.description: Retrieve a known Apollo person by ID. Use people/match to unlock contact information.

tools.name: Person match
tools.description: Use to resolve one person you have already found. Prefer the id from people/search, then a LinkedIn URL, then email; a bare name needs a domain beside it or it will match the wrong person.

tools.name: Person search
tools.description: Always start here. It is free and it tells you who exists before anything is spent. Never match a list of guesses: search, read the previews, then match only the people worth revealing.

tools.name: App
tools.description: Verify device or watchOS compatibility, subscription and in-app purchase prices, the current version or release notes of a specific app.

tools.name: Developer apps
tools.description: List everything one publisher offers, given the developer id from `app`, `search` or a developer page URL.

tools.name: Reviews
tools.description: Read what users say about an app; page with `offset` from `next_offset`.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Find candidate apps by name or topic before calling `app` for compatibility and subscription detail.

tools.name: Top charts
tools.description: Rankings: what is popular now in a category or overall on a storefront.

tools.name: Get application exhibits
tools.description: After search_authorizations or lookup_fcc_id, with a row's application_id and fcc_id, to list test reports, photos, manuals and other exhibits of a filing.

tools.name: Get application grant
tools.description: After search_authorizations or lookup_fcc_id, with a row's application_id and fcc_id, for the authorized technical parameters and conditions of a grant.

tools.name: List tcbs
tools.description: To list or look up the certification bodies (TCBs) that issue grants, e.g. to resolve a tcb_code filter for search_authorizations.

tools.name: List test firms
tools.description: To find accredited test laboratories recognized by the FCC, by name or city.

tools.name: Lookup fcc id
tools.description: When you have an FCC ID (from a device label) and want its filings and their application_id for exhibits and grant detail.

tools.name: Search authorizations
tools.description: To find FCC equipment authorization filings by grantee, applicant, date range or technical filters; use lookup_fcc_id for one exact FCC ID.

tools.name: Search grantees
tools.description: To resolve a company to its grantee code(s) before an FCC ID search, or to look up who holds a grantee code.

tools.name: App
tools.description: Metadata for one Android package on Aptoide: latest APK (version name/code, size, md5, min SDK, signing certificate, malware scan), declared permissions and features, downloads (store and all-store), rating histogram, developer, age rating, description, what's new and screenshots. Errors when the package is not hosted.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Search Aptoide's Android APK catalog by keyword (app name, developer or package fragment). Returns up to `limit` listings with package name, latest version, size, store, downloads and ratings; paginate with `offset`.

tools.name: Versions
tools.description: Version history for one Android package: the APK uploads Aptoide holds across its stores, newest first, each with version name/code, size, md5, min SDK, CPU ABIs, malware verdict, store, downloads and rating. Depth depends on what uploaders kept; an empty list means Aptoide has no other builds.

tools.name: Describe layer
tools.description: Before query_layer: find the right layer id in a service and the exact field names and codes for a where clause (zoning codes, flood zone values), or check a layer's licence and record limits. Pass a url from search_datasets or a pasted ArcGIS REST URL.

tools.name: Query layer
tools.description: Look up the parcel, zoning district, flood zone, permit, address point or boundary at a location or matching an id (e.g. an assessor parcel number), or page through a layer's records. Get field names from describe_layer first.

tools.name: Search datasets
tools.description: Find which public ArcGIS layer holds the data (a county's parcels or zoning, FEMA flood zones, a park's trails, a city's permits) and get its service URL. Start here unless you already have a .../FeatureServer or .../MapServer URL.

tools.name: Get product
tools.description: Detail for a handle returned by any listing or search function, or a pasted product URL. A 0.00 price means the store sells on quote (price_on_request).

tools.name: Get recommendations
tools.description: After get_product or a listing supplied a numeric id. An unpublished or unknown id is not_found; an empty list is a legitimate 'no recommendations'.

tools.name: List collection products
tools.description: Browse a category by handle (from list_collections) or a pasted collection URL. Shopify throttles this feed per exit IP with 429/retry-after 60; the function retries once with the Firefox identity before reporting upstream_rate_limited.

tools.name: List collections
tools.description: Start here to discover collection handles for list_collection_products; 219 collections fit in one page at limit 250.

tools.name: List products
tools.description: Bulk catalogue pulls (about 930 products, 4 pages at limit 250). Never throttled in the capture; prefer it over collection feeds for full exports.

tools.name: Search products
tools.description: Find products by keyword. Shopify pads a no-match query with unrelated fallback products; those are removed and counted in dropped. For exhaustive browsing use list_products.

tools.name: Get model
tools.description: When you have a model slug from search_models (or a pasted /models/{slug} URL) and need the full benchmark record.

tools.name: List model providers
tools.description: To compare where to run a given model: prices and measured speed per provider. Needs a model slug from search_models.

tools.name: Search models
tools.description: Start here to find a model slug (e.g. `claude-fable-5-1-high`) for get_model or list_model_providers, to rank models by intelligence, price or speed, or with `slug` to fetch one known model/effort row (legacy slugs included) without paging the whole table.

tools.name: Search provider endpoints
tools.description: To find the fastest or cheapest endpoint for a model, or all models a provider hosts. Use list_model_providers for one model's percentile detail.

tools.name: Get bibtex
tools.description: Cite a paper found with `search_papers`, `list_category` or `get_paper`.

tools.name: Get paper
tools.description: Look up one paper by identifier or URL. Use `get_bibtex` for a citation entry and `harvest_records` for the license.

tools.name: Harvest records
tools.description: Bulk or incremental synchronisation of arXiv metadata by date window, or the only surface that states a paper's license. For topical search use `search_papers`.

tools.name: List category
tools.description: Browse what was announced in a category, or walk a month's submissions. Identifiers feed `get_paper` and `get_bibtex`.

tools.name: List sets
tools.description: Discover valid `set` values for `harvest_records` and category codes for `list_category`.

tools.name: Search papers
tools.description: Find papers by topic, title, author or category, or find the arXiv identifier that `get_paper`, `get_bibtex` and the listing functions take. Citing or replicating papers are not an arXiv concept: arXiv serves no citation graph.

tools.name: Get bill
tools.description: Bill status and legislative history for one bill. Get the billinfoid from list_bills. Unknown ids answer not_found (the site renders an empty placeholder).

tools.name: Get member
tools.description: Member profile; the mid comes from list_members or from get_bill.sponsor.mid.

tools.name: Hansard index
tools.description: Find where a member spoke, or where a subject was debated, without reading the PDFs: this is the Assembly's own index. Letter A of a busy session is large; use heading_contains to keep one speaker or subject.

tools.name: List bills
tools.description: Start here to find a bill's billinfoid for get_bill, or to enumerate a session's bills. Legislature 31 is the current one (session 2 opened October 2025).

tools.name: List committee transcripts
tools.description: Committee transcripts by committee code: PA (Public Accounts), EF (Alberta's Economic Future), RS (Resource Stewardship), FC (Families and Communities), LO (Legislative Offices), MS (Members' Services), HS (Heritage Savings Trust Fund), PB (Private Bills and Private Members' Public Bills), CEB, CI.

tools.name: List members
tools.description: Roster of MLAs for a legislature; the mid keys get_member and matches the sponsor id on bills.

tools.name: List sitting documents
tools.description: To find the Hansard or Votes and Proceedings PDF for a date, or the docid of the session's speaker/subject index. The PDFs are static files on docs.assembly.ab.ca; this program returns their URLs, not their text.

tools.name: Get document
tools.description: Read the full text of a decision or notice found through `list_documents`, `search` or a featured application. Not for eFiling exhibits, which need a login.

tools.name: Get featured application
tools.description: Get the official numbers and overview of a high-profile proceeding and the links to its application and decision PDFs.

tools.name: List current applications
tools.description: Check whether a proceeding or applicant has an application under review and get its application number.

tools.name: List documents
tools.description: Find decisions, notices or approvals by proceeding, applicant, date or type; feed `get_document` with `efiling_document_id`. Not for proceedings' party lists or exhibits (eFiling login only).

tools.name: List events
tools.description: See which hearings are scheduled in a date window and for which proceedings.

tools.name: List featured applications
tools.description: Discover which proceedings the AUC presents as featured, then call `get_featured_application` for the proceeding, application and decision numbers and the overview text.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Find decisions or pages by topic, facility type, place or applicant when you do not have a proceeding id; verify any hit through `get_document`.

tools.name: Get auction status
tools.description: Refreshing bid state for listings already known, or checking many listings cheaply.

tools.name: Get listing
tools.description: Full detail for a listing found through search_listings or a pasted auction.com/details URL.

tools.name: Get valuation
tools.description: Pricing context for a listing (AVM, comps, last sale prices, assessed and tax values).

tools.name: Search listings
tools.description: Finding auction properties in an area; listing sold (closed) auctions with winning bids; locating a listing_id for get_listing, get_valuation or get_auction_status.

tools.name: Suggest locations
tools.description: Resolving a user's place name to the state/city/county/ZIP values search_listings expects, or finding the listing behind a street address.

tools.name: Category facets
tools.description: To discover category ids to pass to search, or to see brand and price distribution for a category or keyword.

tools.name: Item
tools.description: Full detail for an auction id from search or a pasted auctions.yahoo.co.jp / page.auctions.yahoo.co.jp listing URL.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Start here to find auction ids (then call item) or to get sold-price history for a keyword. Provide at least one of query, category_id or seller_id.

tools.name: Seller
tools.description: After search or item returned a seller user_id and you need the seller's rating or profile.

tools.name: Suggest
tools.description: Before search when the exact Japanese term is unknown; an unknown prefix legitimately returns no keywords.

tools.name: Get auction lot
tools.description: Full detail for a lot found with `search_auction_lots` or `get_sale_catalog`.

tools.name: Get sale catalog
tools.description: List everything in one auctioneer's sale.

tools.name: List auction events
tools.description: Discover auction dates and standalone sales; take `event_id` into `get_sale_catalog`.

tools.name: List categories
tools.description: Find a category id before searching by category.

tools.name: Search auction lots
tools.description: Find equipment lots to bid on or to look up; take `listing_id` into `get_auction_lot`. Use `list_categories` for category ids.

tools.name: Get collection
tools.description: Check that a collection handle exists and how many products it holds before paging through it. Unknown handles are not_found.

tools.name: Get product
tools.description: You have a product handle or URL (from list_products, search_products, list_collection_products or a pasted link) and want its full record. Unknown handles are not_found.

tools.name: List collection products
tools.description: Browse a decade (1930s), style (art-nouveau), price band (100-249) or subject collection; handles come from list_collections. Follow next_page. Shopify throttles this route per IP (429 with retry-after); retry later on upstream_rate_limited.

tools.name: List collections
tools.description: Discover collection handles before calling list_collection_products or get_collection. About 420 collections; page through with next_page.

tools.name: List products
tools.description: Browse or export the full catalogue without a search term; follow next_page until it is null. For one known product use get_product; for a theme or decade use list_collection_products.

tools.name: Search products
tools.description: Find products by artist, subject, title words or keywords (e.g. mucha, cognac, ski). Zero matches is a legitimate empty result. Follow next_page for more.

tools.name: Get listing
tools.description: After search_listings, or when the user pastes an autotrader.com/cars-for-sale/vehicle/{id} URL or a VIN.

tools.name: Listing facets
tools.description: To see which years, trims or cities have inventory before searching, or to pick a trim_code for search_listings.

tools.name: Search listings
tools.description: Discovering vehicles for sale in the US, or reading one dealership's Autotrader inventory and its new/used/certified counts by dealer_id or dealer website domain (e.g. comparing a dealer's own site against its marketplace syndication). Chain listing_id into get_listing, style_id into vehicle_specs and seller.owner_id into dealer_id. Use suggest_make_model to turn 'Toyota Camry' into make_code/model_code first.

tools.name: Suggest make model
tools.description: Before search_listings or listing_facets when you have a make/model name rather than codes.

tools.name: Vehicle specs
tools.description: After get_listing or search_listings, to read the manufacturer specifications behind a listing.

tools.name: Get classification description
tools.description: After search_contractors or get_license, to explain what work a license's classification permits.

tools.name: Get license
tools.description: After search_contractors, with a license's license_id, to verify status, bonding and complaint history.

tools.name: List classifications
tools.description: To pick the exact classification spelling before a filtered search_contractors call.

tools.name: Search contractors
tools.description: Start here to find a contractor and the `license_id` of each of its licenses; then call get_license for the full record, bonds and complaints.

tools.name: Cash dividends
tools.description: When the `trading_name` (e.g. PETROBRAS) is known from `search_companies` or `company`.

tools.name: Company
tools.description: After `search_companies` returned a `code_cvm`, or when the CVM code is known.

tools.name: Company filings
tools.description: For a company's regulatory disclosures; filter by `category` id (1 Assembleia, 2 Reunião da Administração, 3 Aviso aos Acionistas, 4 Fato Relevante, 6 Comunicado ao Mercado, 7 Dados Econômico-Financeiros, 8 Valores Mobiliários Negociados e Detidos, ...).

tools.name: Corporate actions
tools.description: When the four-letter issuer code (`issuing_company`, e.g. PETR) is known, typically from `search_companies` or `company`.

tools.name: Index portfolio
tools.description: To get an index's composition; page through with `page` (default 120 rows covers IBOV in one call).

tools.name: Industry classification
tools.description: To interpret or filter the `segment` and classification labels returned by the company functions.

tools.name: Quote
tools.description: For a ticker such as PETR4, VALE3, BOVA11. Quotes are delayed per B3 policy.

tools.name: Search companies
tools.description: First step to find a company's CVM code (`code_cvm`), issuer code and trading name for the detail functions.

tools.name: Stock indices
tools.description: To learn the indices a company (e.g. PETR) is a member of.

tools.name: Deposits
tools.description: Deposit market share: how much each bank holds in a city, county, state or MSA, or where one bank's deposits sit. Filter by `cert`, `year`, branch `state` and `city`, or by any column with `filters` (`CNTYNAMB`, `MSABR`, `ZIPBR`).

tools.name: Failures
tools.description: Which banks failed in a period or state, who acquired them, how large they were and what they cost the Deposit Insurance Fund. Filter with `from` / `to` on the failure date, `state`, or `cert` for one institution.

tools.name: Financials
tools.description: A bank's balance sheet, earnings, capital and asset quality over time, or every bank in one quarter. Filter by `cert` for one institution's trend or by `report_date` (a quarter end) to compare institutions; use `fields` to fetch only the columns needed. Use `summary` for state or industry totals by year.

tools.name: History
tools.description: What happened to a bank or its branches over time: when it opened, merged, changed its name or charter, or opened and closed branches. Filter by `cert`, by `change_code` (110 new institution, 211 failure, 223 merger without assistance, 510 name change, 711 branch opening, 721 branch closing...) and by effective date with `from` / `to`.

tools.name: Institutions
tools.description: Find a US bank or savings institution and its FDIC certificate number (CERT), which every other function filters on, or list banks by state, size or status. Use `name` for a forgiving name search and `cert` for one institution's profile; use `financials` for quarterly history beyond the latest figures.

tools.name: Locations
tools.description: Where a bank has branches, or which banks have offices in a city, ZIP or state. Filter by `cert` (from `institutions`) for one bank's network. Use `deposits` for deposits held at each branch and `history` for branch openings and closings.

tools.name: Summary
tools.description: State or national banking totals by year: how many banks a state had, total industry assets or deposits, net income, new charters or failures per year. For one institution use `financials`.

tools.name: Get leaderboard
tools.description: Season-level rankings across players; take `player_id` into the player functions. Boards not listed here are not supported.

tools.name: Get pitch type summary
tools.description: A compact pitch-mix / pitch-outcome profile for a known `player_id` without pulling every pitch.

tools.name: Get player
tools.description: After `search_players`, to confirm identity and get bio fields before pulling Statcast data for the id.

tools.name: Get player gamelogs
tools.description: Per-plate-appearance detail for a known `player_id` and season; take `play_id` or `game_pk` into further lookups.

tools.name: Get schedule
tools.description: Find `game_pk` values and scores for a day; a date in the off-season legitimately has zero games.

tools.name: Search players
tools.description: Resolve a player's name to the MLBAM `player_id` needed by `get_player`, `get_player_gamelogs`, `get_pitch_type_summary` and `search_statcast`.

tools.name: Search statcast
tools.description: Statcast pitch-level data for a known `player_id` (or team abbreviation) in a date window; narrow the window or add `pitch_types` to keep results small.

tools.name: Trending players
tools.description: Discover who is being looked up on Baseball Savant right now; feed `player_id` into the detail functions.

tools.name: List players
tools.description: Browse or rank players by 9-category stats in a public league. Pass stat_period explicitly (S_AS_2025 = 2025-26 per-game averages, S_S_2026 = 2026-27 season totals, S_AL14 = last 14 days averages, S_PS7 = next 7 days projected, S_PSR = rest of season projected).
