Sort by OR (pre-season rank), AR (current rank), R_PO (% rostered), MPG, NAME or a stat id (5 FG%, 8 FT%, 10 3PTM, 12 PTS, 15 REB, 16 AST, 17 ST, 18 BLK, 19 TO). For rank windows use player_rankings.

tools.name: Player news
tools.description: Recent news about a player resolved by search_players (news_url / player_id). Does not use the login-gated Fantasy player-note panel.

tools.name: Player rankings
tools.description: Compare players by Yahoo's pre-season and actual rank windows in a public league. Sort with OR (pre-season), AR_S, AR_L30, AR_L14, AR_L7 (total-stats ranks) or AR_AS, AR_AL30, AR_AL14, AR_AL7 (average-stats ranks); page with offset.

tools.name: Public team roster
tools.description: Inspect a specific public team (league_id + team_id, e.g. from a /nba/{league}/{team} URL). NBA rosters are daily: pass date (YYYY-MM-DD) or week, not both; omitted: the league's current date. Private leagues are refused with upstream_blocked (login required).

tools.name: Search players
tools.description: Resolve a player name to Yahoo player ids/keys before list_players, public_team_roster or player_news. Give league_id or league_url of any public league (10000 is a Yahoo-run public 9-category league); player ids are league-independent.

tools.name: Complaint history
tools.description: One page (10) of the public complaint history for a BBB business identified by profile URL or bbb_id + business_id: complaint type, status, date, redacted text and business/consumer responses, with per-type and per-status counts, optional type/status filters, and the profile's complaint totals (all, closed in 3 years, closed in 12 months).

tools.name: Business profile
tools.description: One BBB business profile identified by its bbb.org profile URL or by bbb_id + business_id (from search): BBB letter grade with reasons, accreditation status and dates, file-opened/start/incorporation dates, years in business, entity type, categories, address, coordinates, contacts, websites, social links, local BBB office, alerts, and complaint and customer-review totals.

tools.name: Customer reviews
tools.description: One page (10) of BBB customer reviews for a business identified by profile URL or bbb_id + business_id: star rating, reviewer display name, date, text and business/customer follow-up responses, plus the profile's review total and average star rating.

tools.name: Business search
tools.description: Find BBB business profiles by business name or category near a place (US or Canada). Returns one page of 15 results with each business's BBB letter grade, accreditation flag, categories, address, phones, coordinates and profile URL, plus totals for pagination. BBB's matching is fuzzy: check the returned name.

tools.name: Complaints
tools.description: You need the complaint detail behind a business's complaint counts, filtered by status (answered, resolved, unanswered) or type.

tools.name: Profile
tools.description: You have a BBB `id` (from search or resolve) or a pasted bbb.org profile URL and need ratings, accreditation and complaint summary figures.

tools.name: Resolve
tools.description: Normalise a bbb.org link an agent found elsewhere, or confirm an `id` exists, before calling profile or complaints.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Start here to find a business and its `id` for profile / complaints / resolve, or to list businesses in a category and place.

tools.name: Credit rates
tools.description: Compare bank lending rates (mortgage, payroll loans, vehicle, credit card, ...) for a month.

tools.name: Datasets search
tools.description: Find an SGS series code or an Olinda service name before calling `sgs_series` or `olinda_service`.

tools.name: Focus expectations
tools.description: Market consensus for inflation, policy rate, GDP or FX by reference month/year or Copom meeting.

tools.name: Olinda service
tools.description: See which entity sets and functions an Olinda service exposes before querying it.

tools.name: Payment statistics
tools.description: SPI settlement volumes, payment-instrument mix, cash in circulation.

tools.name: Pix statistics
tools.description: PIX volumes by municipality or segment, registered keys, DICT users.

tools.name: Ptax currencies
tools.description: Discover which currency symbols `ptax_currency` accepts.

tools.name: Ptax currency
tools.description: Rates for EUR, GBP, JPY, ... against BRL. Take `moeda` from `ptax_currencies`.

tools.name: Ptax usd
tools.description: USD/BRL PTAX for a day or a range. Use `ptax_currency` for other currencies.

tools.name: Sgs series
tools.description: Get the numbers for a known SGS code. Find codes with `datasets_search` (CKAN `codigo_sgs`).

tools.name: Consensus ratings
tools.description: Use for where analysts stand in aggregate right now on one company. For the individual changes that moved the consensus, use calendar/ratings instead.

tools.name: Mergers and acquisitions
tools.description: Use for who is buying whom, at what price, and whether the deal is pending or closed. For the coverage and commentary around a deal use news/search.

tools.name: Analyst ratings
tools.description: Use for how analysts have moved on a stock: upgrades, downgrades, initiations and target changes. Filter by parameters[analyst_id] or parameters[firm_id] to follow one analyst or firm. It carries the ratings, not the reasoning behind them.

tools.name: Analyst roster
tools.description: Use to resolve an analyst by name, or to judge how accurate a particular analyst has been, and to get the id you then pass to calendar/ratings as parameters[analyst_id]. For the ratings themselves use calendar/ratings; for the list of firms rather than people use calendar/ratings-firms.

tools.name: Research firms
tools.description: Use to enumerate the covering firms or to turn a firm name into the id that calendar/ratings filters on as parameters[firm_id]. For an individual analyst and their track record use calendar/ratings-analysts; for the ratings themselves use calendar/ratings.

tools.name: Removed calendar events
tools.description: Use when you keep a copy of the ratings or M&A calendar and need to know which previously returned events have since been withdrawn, which Schedule C.10 requires you to act on. It answers only what disappeared; for the events themselves use calendar/ratings or calendar/mergers-acquisitions.

tools.name: Press releases
tools.description: Use this for company-issued announcements distributed over the wires, the primary-source wording behind a story. For Benzinga editorial coverage and the wider newswire use news/search, and for the one-line explanation of a price move use news/wiims.

tools.name: Removed news
tools.description: Use this when you keep a copy of Benzinga news and need to know which stories have been withdrawn so you can delete them, which Schedule C.10 requires. It never returns story content; for the stories themselves use news/search.

tools.name: News search
tools.description: Use for what was reported about a company or subject, and when. Scope it to tickers or a date range: unscoped it returns the whole newswire. For the analyst reaction to a story use calendar/ratings.

tools.name: Why Is It Moving
tools.description: Use this to answer why a stock moved: WIIMs are the short attributed explanations Benzinga files against a ticker's price action. For the underlying coverage use news/search, and for the company's own announcement use news/press-releases.

tools.name: Unusual options activity
tools.description: Use for positioning: large directional bets before a catalyst. It reports orders, not outcomes, and a sweep filled at or above the ask (execution_estimate) is a stronger signal than one at the midpoint.

tools.name: Availability
tools.description: Get shipping, delivery and pickup promises for a SKU, ZIP code and store. pickup_summary gives each pickup record an explicit available, unconfirmed (eligible but undated) or unavailable status. Quantities are upstream indicators, not verified stock counts.

tools.name: Pricing
tools.description: Get displayed US pricing, condition and mobile-contract terms.

tools.name: Product
tools.description: Get public Bestbuy product details, displayed price, images, variants and review totals.

tools.name: Review summary
tools.description: Get the displayed rating and count; individual review text is not included.

tools.name: Reviews
tools.description: Page through all customer reviews of one Best Buy US product (SKU or product/review URL), 20 per source page, via the endpoint Best Buy's own review pages call. Each review: stable review_id, 1-5 rating, title, text, author display name, submitted_at (ISO 8601), verified_purchase, incentivized, recommended, helpful/unhelpful votes, pros/cons, attribute ratings, photo URLs and the purchased variant. Also total_reviews, average_rating and the 1-5 star rating_distribution. sort: newest (default), oldest, most_helpful, highest, lowest, relevant. Pass next_cursor back as cursor until it is null to read every review (pages=1-10 fetches that many source pages per call). Incremental sync: sort=newest and stop at the first review_id or submitted_at already stored; for a backfill under live writes prefer sort=oldest, whose offsets do not shift when new reviews arrive.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Fetch one search page. Next-page input is returned; blocked pages raise an error.

tools.name: Stores
tools.description: Find nearby open Best Buy stores by US ZIP code with names, street addresses, dated sales hours and distances in miles; use store_id for availability.

tools.name: Suggestions
tools.description: Get autocomplete suggestions for a search prefix.

tools.name: Variations
tools.description: List product variants and their attributes. Availability and prices require a separate lookup.

tools.name: Get lot
tools.description: Read one lot in full after `search_lots`, or from a VIN or a bid.cars lot URL.

tools.name: Makes models
tools.description: Discover valid `make` / `model` / `vehicle_type` values for `search_lots`, or count active lots per model.

tools.name: Search lots
tools.description: Browse or filter lots currently at auction; find the lot id or VIN for `get_lot` and `similar_sold_lots`.

tools.name: Similar sold lots
tools.description: Price a lot against recent sales after `search_lots` or `get_lot`.

tools.name: Get solicitation
tools.description: Read the detail of a solicitation found through `search_solicitations`, or of a pasted bidnetdirect.com solicitation URL.

tools.name: List agencies
tools.description: Enumerate the buyers (school districts, cities, counties, utilities) that publish through a state purchasing group.

tools.name: List categories
tools.description: Look up a sector's `category_id` or compare open-bid volume across sectors.

tools.name: List locations
tools.description: Look up a state's `location_id` or compare open-bid volume across states.

tools.name: Search solicitations
tools.description: Find solicitations by keyword, state or category; pass a row's `id` and `kind` (or `detail_url`) to `get_solicitation`.

tools.name: Search uploaders
tools.description: To find an artist's or uploader's mid from a name (e.g. `ピノキオピー`) before calling uploader_profile or uploader_videos.

tools.name: Search videos
tools.description: To discover videos by keyword (e.g. `VOCALOID 初音ミク`), optionally restricted to a partition such as 30 (VOCALOID·UTAU) and sorted by plays, before verifying them with video_detail or video_batch.

tools.name: Suggest
tools.description: To expand or correct a search term before search_videos.

tools.name: Uploader profile
tools.description: When you have a mid (from video_detail owner or search_uploaders) and need the uploader's profile and follower count.

tools.name: Uploader videos
tools.description: To list everything an uploader published (e.g. all MVs of mid 203655966) page by page.

tools.name: Video batch
tools.description: When you hold a curated list of BV/av ids (e.g. 30 Vocaloid MVs) and need their titles, uploaders and URLs verified in one call.

tools.name: Video comments
tools.description: To read viewer reactions to a video identified by its aid (from video_detail).

tools.name: Video detail
tools.description: When you have a BV/av id or a video URL and need to verify the title, uploader and canonical URL, or need a cid for video_streams / an aid for video_comments.

tools.name: Video streams
tools.description: When you need a direct, time-limited media URL for a video; take cid from video_detail (omit it to use the first part).

tools.name: Business
tools.description: One local business by its Bing ypid (from `search`): name, structured address, display and E.164 phone, website, coordinates, categories, aggregate rating with review count and source, current open-status sentence, and structured weekly opening hours (per day, 24h HH:MM ranges, all-day flag, closed days). Missing values are null; hours are null when Bing publishes none.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Local businesses matching a category or a business name near a street address, city/state or postal code (US and other Bing Maps markets). One page of up to 30 results with Bing ypid, name, street address, phone, website, coordinates, category, aggregate rating with review count and source (Yelp/Tripadvisor/...), and current open status (Open/Closed in the business's local time, with Bing's rendered sentence such as "Open · Closes 10 PM"). Results are not filtered by opening hours: to find what is open now, read `open_status` on the rows. Use the ypid with `business` for structured weekly hours.

tools.name: Bls cpi
tools.description: A direct inflation lookup by category; for other CPI items or percent changes use bls_series_search on survey cu and bls_series.

tools.name: Bls series
tools.description: Retrieving the numbers once the series ids are known (from bls_top_picks, bls_series_search or the id conventions). The unregistered API allows 25 queries per day per address; the failure is upstream_rate_limited.

tools.name: Bls series detail
tools.description: To learn what a series id means (its labels) without an API key, or to read history older than the API's 10-year window. For many series at once use bls_series.

tools.name: Bls series search
tools.description: Free-text series discovery (the site's own Data Finder is reCAPTCHA-gated). Pick the survey first with bls_surveys or bls_top_picks; catalogs range from 1 MB (cu) to 15 MB (ln), and a few (sm, oe, en) exceed the 32 MB fetch limit and fail with a clear message.

tools.name: Bls surveys
tools.description: To learn which survey abbreviation covers a topic (CU consumer prices, LA local unemployment, CE payroll employment, SM state employment, LN labor force, WP producer prices, AP average prices) before discovering series.

tools.name: Bls top picks
tools.description: The cheapest way to find well-known series ids for a survey before calling bls_series; use bls_series_search for anything not in the curated list.

tools.name: Bls unemployment rate
tools.description: A direct answer to 'what is the unemployment rate in X'; the resolved series id is returned for follow-up calls.

tools.name: Availability
tools.description: Retrieve availability, total prices and policies for one property (hotel_id from `search`) and dates.

tools.name: Hotel
tools.description: Detail step after `search` (country_code + page_name) or from a pasted booking.com/hotel/{cc}/{page}.html URL. Prices and rooms are in `availability`.

tools.name: Locations
tools.description: First step when the caller has a place name and needs a Booking.com destination id; also resolves a hotel name to its hotel_id.

tools.name: Reviews
tools.description: Read guest feedback for a hotel_id from `search`; pass ufi and country_code from the same result to save a lookup.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Compare accommodation for given dates in a city, district, region, landmark or airport area (dest_id from `locations`), or by free-text `query`; then call `hotel`, `availability` or `reviews` with the ids returned.

tools.name: Surroundings
tools.description: Location context for a hotel_id from `search` (pass its ufi to save a lookup).

tools.name: Get coverage
tools.description: To list the office codes accepted by search_trademarks and see how fresh each collection is.

tools.name: Get database stats
tools.description: For the size of the database and the distribution of records by office or country.

tools.name: Get trademark
tools.description: After search_trademarks, with a result's st13.

tools.name: Search trademarks
tools.description: Start here to find trademark records and their st13 identifiers; pass an st13 to get_trademark for the full record.

tools.name: Suggest terms
tools.description: To expand a goods/services keyword before search_trademarks.

tools.name: Extract website branding
tools.description: Extract a website's brand identity: logo, color palette, fonts and typography, spacing and button styles, from one public page URL. Use for brand kits, design-system cloning and on-brand generation. Scrape pricing per successful attempt: 1 credit base, before other Scrape surcharges such as proxy tiers. The wrapper adds no charge; the underlying Scrape request is billed separately at its current rate.

tools.name: Get patent
tools.description: You have a CA patent or application number (from search_patents or a CPD URL) and need its bibliographic data, status, abstract, history or document list.

tools.name: Search patents
tools.description: Start here to find patent numbers by keyword, title, inventor, applicant or owner name, IPC class, PCT or international publication number, or a date range; then call get_patent with a returned patent_number.

tools.name: Get entity
tools.description: You have a business_entity_id from search_entities or get_registered_agent and need the full registration record, filing history or document links.

tools.name: Get registered agent
tools.description: You have a reg_agent_id from search_entities or get_entity and need the agent's address or the list of entities it represents.

tools.name: Search entities
tools.description: You know (part of) a Missouri business name or a charter number (LC1041362, LP0013885, FL001415560, 00123456 ...) and need the entity's internal id, status, type or registered agent, or want to page through all matches.

tools.name: Company
tools.description: Read one company profile by returned slug: description, website, logo, source employee count and industries. Headcount is a public source observation; founding year omitted because source metadata is unreliable.

tools.name: Job
tools.description: Read one canonical Built In job URL: description, employer, source salary range/currency/unit, posting/expiry dates, locations, benefits and industry. Missing values remain unknown; a listing is not a current hiring guarantee.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Search Built In public technology jobs by keyword, with pages1–100 and source ordering. Returns job URLs and company slugs for detail lookups. No location or remote filters in this initial contract.

tools.name: Check name availability
tools.description: Check whether a proposed Utah business name is already taken or close to an existing registration.

tools.name: Get entity
tools.description: You have a business_id (and reservation_id for a Name Reservation row) from search_entities and need the registration record, registered agent, principals or addresses.

tools.name: Get filing history
tools.description: You have a business_id from search_entities and need the chronological filings of the entity (formation, annual reports, amendments, dissolution).

tools.name: List lookup values
tools.description: You need the entity_type key for a search_entities filter or want to know which statuses and status details the registry uses.

tools.name: Search entities
tools.description: Find Utah entities by name, entity number, principal or registered agent and get their business_id for the detail functions.

tools.name: Physician
tools.description: Check the DCA status code and expiry for an exact California physician-and-surgeon license rank and number; a status alone does not establish permission to practice.

tools.name: Get park
tools.description: Details for a park found through search_parks, suggest_locations, list_parks' booking slugs or a pasted https://www.campspot.com/book/{slug} URL.

tools.name: Get park availability
tools.description: After search_parks or get_park, to see which site types and campsites a park has free for given dates and what they cost. Prices are in the park's currency (get_park currency_unit) and are the site's displayed quotes, not confirmed bookings.

tools.name: List parks
tools.description: Enumerate every park on the marketplace or find a park by a word in its slug. Marketplace slugs are not booking slugs: use suggest_locations or search_parks to get a park_id for get_park.

tools.name: Search parks
tools.description: Find parks near a place or coordinates, optionally for a date range and party. Follow with get_park for details and get_park_availability for site-level availability and prices.

tools.name: Suggest locations
tools.description: Turn free text ('Austin', 'Yellowstone', a park name) into coordinates or a park_id before search_parks or get_park. search_parks also accepts the text directly through its `location` input.

tools.name: Get listing
tools.description: After search_listings, to read the full record of one vehicle. Also accepts a pasted https://www.cargurus.com/details/{id} URL.

tools.name: List makes
tools.description: To enumerate makes or find a make's id for list_models and search_listings.

tools.name: List models
tools.description: After list_makes or suggest_vehicles, to pick the model entity_id for search_listings or model_owner_reviews.

tools.name: Model owner reviews
tools.description: Research on a model's owner satisfaction, keyed by the model_id of a search result or suggestion.

tools.name: Search listings
tools.description: Finding used vehicles for sale near a US ZIP code, comparing prices against CarGurus' market value, or enumerating trims and counts for a model in an area. Chain listing_id into get_listing, entity_id into model_owner_reviews, and use suggest_vehicles or list_makes/list_models to obtain entity ids first.

tools.name: Suggest vehicles
tools.description: To turn a vehicle name typed by a user into the entity_id / make_model_trim_paths that search_listings and model_owner_reviews take.

tools.name: Auction
tools.description: Full detail for an auction id from `search_auctions`, a sitemap or a pasted https://carsandbids.com/auctions/{id}/{slug} URL.

tools.name: Auction comments
tools.description: Bid history (`filter: bids`) or the discussion for an auction id from `search_auctions` or `auction`.

tools.name: Search auctions
tools.description: Find auctions or past results; take `auctions[].id` into `auction` and `auction_comments`, `seller_username` into `user_profile`.

tools.name: Similar auctions
tools.description: Comparable listings and recent results for an auction id.

tools.name: Suggest
tools.description: Resolve a loose car name to the search phrases the site itself proposes before calling `search_auctions`.

tools.name: User profile
tools.description: Seller or bidder background for a `seller_username` from `search_auctions` / `auction` or a `username` from `auction_comments`.

tools.name: Get article
tools.description: Full text, exact timestamps and correction history of a story found by search_articles or list_articles, or of a pasted cbc.ca article URL.

tools.name: List articles
tools.description: Browse a section or region, optionally within a date range (for example everything CBC Edmonton published last week). Category slugs come from a search hit's category_slugs, from lookup_region's leaf_slug, or from the slug in a cbc.ca section URL (/news/canada/edmonton -> edmonton).

tools.name: Lookup region
tools.description: Turn a user's city or region name into CBC's taxonomy path and the candidate category slug for list_articles.

tools.name: Search articles
tools.description: Find CBC stories by keyword, optionally within a section, then call get_article with a hit's source_id for the full text. For a region or section within a date range use list_articles instead.

tools.name: Projections
tools.description: This week's or next week's projected points and stat lines for a football position, rest-of-season projections, or NBA fantasy basketball season and scoring-period projections.

tools.name: Rankings
tools.description: Start/sit rankings for a football position this week, football draft rankings, or NBA fantasy basketball roto rankings by position.

tools.name: Stats
tools.description: Actual fantasy production: last week's football scores, this season to date, a past season's totals, or recent NBA fantasy basketball form.

tools.name: Data
tools.description: Retrieve estimates. Input: dataset path (acs/acs5, acs/acs1, acs/acs5/subject, acs/acs5/profile, dec/pl, dec/dhc, pep/population, cbp ...), vintage, 1-200 variable names or group(TABLE) tokens, and a geography as Data API for/in predicates (for: 'county:*', in: ['state:06']). Returns one row per geography with values as published, sentinels turned into null plus annotation, FIPS parts, variable metadata with units, and the equivalent api.census.gov URL. Unknown variables are rejected with invalid_input naming them.

tools.name: Datasets
tools.description: Search the Census Data API catalog. Input: free-text query over dataset path, title and description plus an optional vintage (year). Returns one record per dataset/vintage with its API endpoint, metadata links, publication date and supported geography levels.

tools.name: Geographies
tools.description: Geography resolver. Input: a place, county, state, tract or other geography name (e.g. 'Travis County, Texas'). Returns matching Census geographies with summary level, GEO_ID, FIPS parts and the exact `for`/`in` predicates to pass to `data`.

tools.name: Variables
tools.description: List variables of one dataset vintage. Input: dataset path and vintage, plus a group (table id such as B01003 or DP05) and/or a free-text query matched against group descriptions and variable labels. Returns variable name, verbatim label, concept, predicate type, group and the unit phrase the label carries.

tools.name: Disaggregated combined
tools.description: Positions and open interest from the CFTC Disaggregated - Combined report for one or many markets and weeks. Use `markets` first to find contract_market_code values; use `fields` to keep the payload small.

tools.name: Disaggregated futures only
tools.description: Positions and open interest from the CFTC Disaggregated - Futures Only report for one or many markets and weeks. Use `markets` first to find contract_market_code values; use `fields` to keep the payload small.

tools.name: Legacy combined
tools.description: Positions and open interest from the CFTC Legacy - Combined report for one or many markets and weeks. Use `markets` first to find contract_market_code values; use `fields` to keep the payload small.

tools.name: Legacy futures only
tools.description: Positions and open interest from the CFTC Legacy - Futures Only report for one or many markets and weeks. Use `markets` first to find contract_market_code values; use `fields` to keep the payload small.

tools.name: Markets
tools.description: Start here to find the contract_market_code (and exchange_code / commodity names) to pass to a report function, or to see which markets a dataset covers and how far back.

tools.name: Supplemental
tools.description: Positions and open interest from the CFTC Supplemental Commodity Index report for one or many markets and weeks. Use `markets` first to find contract_market_code values; use `fields` to keep the payload small.

tools.name: Tff combined
tools.description: Positions and open interest from the CFTC Traders in Financial Futures - Combined report for one or many markets and weeks. Use `markets` first to find contract_market_code values; use `fields` to keep the payload small.

tools.name: Tff futures only
tools.description: Positions and open interest from the CFTC Traders in Financial Futures - Futures Only report for one or many markets and weeks. Use `markets` first to find contract_market_code values; use `fields` to keep the payload small.

tools.name: Disaggregated report, futures and options combined
tools.description: The disaggregated split with options included. Prefer it for crude, natural gas and gold, where a large share of managed-money exposure is held through options and the futures-only figure understates it.

tools.name: Disaggregated report, futures only
tools.description: Physical commodities - agriculture, energy, metals - when the question is which kind of participant is positioned, not just speculator versus hedger: managed money is the fund positioning most reports quote, swap dealers carry the index-fund flow, producers and merchants are the physical hedge. Financial futures are not here; use the financial report.

tools.name: Financial futures report, futures and options combined
tools.description: The financial split with options included, which matters most for equity index and Treasury futures, where options open interest is a large fraction of the total.

tools.name: Financial futures report, futures only
tools.description: Currencies, Treasury and SOFR futures, equity index futures, VIX: who is long the dollar, how short leveraged funds are in ten-year notes, how asset managers are positioned in S&P futures. Leveraged funds is the hedge-fund column; asset managers is pensions, insurers and mutual funds.

tools.name: Legacy report, futures and options combined
tools.description: The legacy split with options included, which is the fuller picture of a group's exposure in markets where options are liquid - energy, metals, rates. The row id ends in C rather than F; everything else reads the same as futures-only.

tools.name: Legacy report, futures only
tools.description: The report most commentary means by 'the COT': speculators versus hedgers, futures positions only, back to 1986 for every market. Filter by `cftc_contract_market_code` or `commodity_name` and order by `report_date_as_yyyy_mm_dd DESC` for the latest week. Use legacy/combined when options positions matter, and the disaggregated or financial report when the two-way speculator/hedger split is too coarse.

tools.name: Supplemental report, commodity index traders
tools.description: Thirteen agricultural markets - corn, wheat, soybeans, sugar, coffee, cocoa, cotton, cattle, hogs - when the question is how much of the length is passive index money rather than a directional view. Nowhere else in the COT is index-trader positioning stated on its own.

tools.name: Get auction
tools.description: A known sale id (from search_lots `sale.sale_id`, get_lot `sale.sale_id`) or a christies.com/en/auction/ URL.

tools.name: Get lot
tools.description: Full record of a lot found through search_lots or list_auction_lots (numeric `object_id`), or a pasted christies.com/en/lot/lot-… URL. Online-only lots (object ids like 24550.171) live on onlineonly.christies.com and are not covered.

tools.name: List auction lots
tools.description: Full catalogue or results of a sale whose sale_id, sale_number and sale_room_code you have (get_auction returns all three).

tools.name: Search auctions
tools.description: Find a sale by name, collection or keyword; then get_auction with the returned `url` for its header and lot count.

tools.name: Search lots
tools.description: Find lots by artist, title or keyword across all Christie's sales; refine with the `filter_groups` option ids. Use get_lot for full details of one lot and list_auction_lots for a whole sale.

tools.name: Get entity
tools.description: After search_entities, to read the full record and current status of one entity.

tools.name: Get entity agent history
tools.description: To see past and current registered agents of an entity.

tools.name: Get entity filings
tools.description: To list an entity's filings and their document ids after search_entities or get_entity.

tools.name: Get entity name history
tools.description: To see former and fictitious names of an entity.

tools.name: Search entities
tools.description: Start here to find an entity's business_id and SCC entity id; use get_entity for the full record.

tools.name: Location
tools.description: Turn a city or address into latitude/longitude for search_schedules / search_venues.

tools.name: Markets
tools.description: Coverage check and a starting coordinate for search_schedules / search_venues without a geocoder.

tools.name: Schedule
tools.description: Detail for an `id` from search_schedules or venue_schedule.

tools.name: Search schedules
tools.description: Discovery of classes near a location on a date. Get coordinates from `location` or `markets`; pass a result's `id` to `schedule`, its `venue.id` to `venue` / `venue_schedule`.

tools.name: Search venues
tools.description: Discovery of studios near a location. Pass a result's `id` to `venue` or `venue_schedule`.

tools.name: Venue
tools.description: Details for a `venue.id` / `id` from search_schedules or search_venues.

tools.name: Venue schedule
tools.description: The day's timetable of a known studio (`venue_id` from search_venues / search_schedules / venue).

tools.name: Member
tools.description: You have a Bioguide ID (from `vote`, `member_vote` or a congress.gov URL) and want the member's current profile. Former members are not covered.

tools.name: Member vote
tools.description: Answering 'how did member X vote on roll call N of session S of the Cth Congress'.

tools.name: Member votes
tools.description: Listing how a current member has been voting recently. For a specific historical roll call use `member_vote`.

tools.name: Members
tools.description: Finding a member's Bioguide ID by state or party, or enumerating a delegation. Use `member` for one known Bioguide ID.

tools.name: Vote
tools.description: You know the congress, session and roll call number (for example from `votes` or from a clerk.house.gov/Votes/{year}{roll} URL) and want the full result with member positions. Use `member_vote` for a single member.

tools.name: Votes
tools.description: Finding roll call numbers (to pass to `vote` or `member_vote`) for a bill, a date range or a session; browsing what the House voted on.

tools.name: Field values
tools.description: You need the valid values of a registry field or the distribution of a field across all studies.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Discover NCT numbers for a topic before calling study or study_dates; list trials by sponsor, status or location.

tools.name: Study
tools.description: You have an NCT number (from search, a pasted clinicaltrials.gov/study URL or elsewhere) and need the full protocol, eligibility, locations, outcomes or posted results.

tools.name: Study dates
tools.description: You already have NCT numbers and need to know whether their start and primary completion dates are actual or estimated, or their current status.

tools.name: Suggest
tools.description: Normalize a drug, condition, sponsor or facility name to the spelling the registry uses before searching.

tools.name: Contract specs
tools.description: Use to understand a product found with product_search before reading its quotes or settlements.

tools.name: Fedwatch meetings
tools.description: Start here for market-implied probabilities of the next FOMC rate decision and the list of meeting dates to pass to fedwatch_probability_history.

tools.name: Fedwatch probability history
tools.description: Use for the probabilities of a specific meeting (take latest) or for how they evolved over time. Meeting dates come from fedwatch_meetings.

tools.name: Futures quotes
tools.description: Use for the current futures strip behind FedWatch (product 305, 30 Day Fed Funds) or any other CME futures product id from product_search.

tools.name: Futures settlements
tools.description: Use for official daily settlement prices of the Fed Funds or SOFR futures strip, or any CME futures product.

tools.name: Futures volume
tools.description: Use for liquidity and positioning in the Fed Funds or SOFR futures contracts FedWatch is derived from.

tools.name: Product search
tools.description: Start here to find the product_id for futures_quotes, futures_settlements, futures_volume and contract_specs.

tools.name: Sofr rates
tools.description: Use for the SOFR benchmark levels alongside FedWatch probabilities.

tools.name: Get record
tools.description: Read the full record behind a `search_records` row or a pasted /web/Details/{database}/{priref} URL.

tools.name: List search fields
tools.description: Before `search_records` on a database whose field names you do not know.

tools.name: Lookup terms
tools.description: Find the exact genre, subject, work type or other authority term spelling before searching on it.

tools.name: Search records
tools.description: Find BFI catalogue records (films, TV programmes, archive items, books, articles, posters, stills, people) matching field conditions, then follow the prirefs with `get_record`. Use `list_search_fields` first when unsure which field names a database supports.

tools.name: Get bid
tools.description: After search_bids or list_open_bids, to read a solicitation in full or to get its attachment download URLs. An unknown bid number is `not_found`; supplier-only pages (bid holder list, quotes) are not fetched.

tools.name: Get blanket
tools.description: After search_bids returns a `blanket_number`, or with a statewide contract number such as `C14597-vCurrent`, to read the awarded contract's summary and attachment URLs. An unknown PO number is `not_found`.

tools.name: List open bids
tools.description: Enumerate everything currently open for responses without choosing a filter; follow `next_cursor` for later pages and pass a row's `bid_number` to get_bid.

tools.name: Search bids
tools.description: Find solicitations by keyword (description; with `match: any` also item description, bid number and alternate id), organization (agency), buyer, NIGP class, type code, status, UNSPSC category or opening-date window; pass a row's `bid_number` to get_bid and a `blanket_number` to get_blanket. Use list_open_bids instead for the site's curated list of currently open solicitations. At least one criterion is required; a legitimate zero-row answer sets `total_count` to 0.

tools.name: Courts
tools.description: List the courts CourtListener indexes, with their ids for the court filter of the search functions. Filter by jurisdiction code (S = state supreme, SA = state appellate, ST = state trial, F = federal appellate, FD = federal district, FB = federal bankruptcy) and page through 20 courts at a time.

tools.name: Docket entries
tools.description: List the docket entries and filed documents of one federal PACER docket identified by its CourtListener docket_id (from search_dockets), oldest first by default. Each entry carries the entry number, filing date, description, PACER document id, availability and a free PDF link when RECAP has the document.

tools.name: Search dockets
tools.description: Search federal PACER dockets (RECAP archive) on CourtListener by party name, attorney, case name, docket number, judge, nature of suit, cause, court and filing dates, or look one docket up by docket_id. Returns docket metadata (parties, judge, dates, PACER case id) and the docket_id needed for docket_entries.

tools.name: Search opinions
tools.description: Search published case law (opinions) from federal and state courts on CourtListener by full text, citation, case name, judge, docket number, court and filing date. Returns opinion clusters with citations, court, dates, cite counts and per-opinion snippets, PDF links and cited-opinion ids.

tools.name: Form
tools.description: After forms_search or forms_list, or when you already know the form number.

tools.name: Forms list
tools.description: To enumerate every court form. Prefer forms_search when you have a topic or number.

tools.name: Forms search
tools.description: To find a court form when you know a topic (`discovery`, `custody`) or a form number prefix. Use forms_list to walk the whole catalog and form for one form's detail page.

tools.name: Opinion
tools.description: After opinions_search, to get the DOCX link and confirm the record. Pass the formats_url as case_number, or kind + date + case_number.

tools.name: Opinions search
tools.description: To list recent opinions or to locate one by case number (the case-number filter returns the row with its filing date, which opinion needs). A filter that matches nothing returns total 0 and no rows.

tools.name: Rule
tools.description: When you know the rule number and need the current text of a California Rule of Court (not a statute: the Code of Civil Procedure lives on leginfo.legislature.ca.gov, which this program does not cover). Use rules_index to browse the numbers of a title first.

tools.name: Rules index
tools.description: To find rule numbers on a subject before calling rule, or to list a whole title. Titles: one (all courts), two (trial court), three (civil), four (criminal), five (family and juvenile), six (Judicial Council), seven (probate), eight (appellate), nine (State Bar), ten (judicial administration), standards (Standards of Judicial Administration), ethics (Code of Judicial Ethics).

tools.name: Site search
tools.description: When you do not know whether the answer is a rule, a form page or a program page. For rule text call rule; for forms call forms_search.

tools.name: Posting
tools.description: Pass a card's `url` (or its posting_token as posting_id). A numeric post id also needs `region` (and optionally `category`). A deleted or unknown posting is not_found; flagged or expired ones return with flagged/expired true.

tools.name: Regions
tools.description: Find the `region` slug for search (sfbay, newyork, austin, london) or list all regions in a country.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Search rentals in a region; narrow large regions with `subarea` (abbreviations come from `regions`, e.g. sfbay: sfc san francisco, eby east bay) or with `lat`/`lon`/`radius` around a neighborhood; then call `posting` with a card's url or posting_id for the full text and attributes. Page with `cursor` (pages of 36, up to 91 pages).

tools.name: Find contractors by location
tools.description: You need licensed contractors of a given classification (B, C-10, C-53 ...) near a California ZIP code or in a city.

tools.name: Get complaint disclosure
tools.description: You have a license number (typically one whose get_license output carries complaint_disclosure_url) and need its disciplinary cases.

tools.name: Get license
tools.description: You have a CSLB license number (from search_contractors_by_name, find_contractors_by_location, list_license_personnel or a pasted LicenseDetail.aspx URL) and need the full license status record.

tools.name: List license personnel
tools.description: You have a license number and need its qualifying individuals, officers or owners.

tools.name: Search contractors by name
tools.description: You know (the start of) a California contractor's business name and need the license number(s) to look up.

tools.name: Get site
tools.description: After list_sites, list_shelf_sites or search_sites returned an id, or when the user pastes a curated.design/sites/s/ URL. An unknown id is not_found.

tools.name: List filters
tools.description: To pick a `category` for list_sites or a `slug` for list_shelf_sites, or to show what the gallery can be filtered by.

tools.name: List shelf sites
tools.description: The public route for the issue's 'filter by style' (dark, minimal, ...) or by tag (saas, ecommerce, ...). Slugs come from list_filters. A slug without a shelf or a page past the end is not_found.

tools.name: List sites
tools.description: The default listing. Use `category` with an industry slug from list_filters (`agency`, `portfolio`, `finance`, ...). For style or tag filters (dark, minimal, saas, ...) use list_shelf_sites instead: style filters on this feed are Pro-only.

tools.name: Search sites
tools.description: Finding a specific featured site by name or topic. Not for exhaustive listing: use list_sites or list_shelf_sites for that. Sections are Pro-only on the site (`locked: true`); templates are products in Curated's store.

tools.name: Acris document
tools.description: Who sold to whom, for how much, on which lots, for a document id returned by `acris_documents`.

tools.name: Acris documents
tools.description: Sales and deed history, mortgages and other recorded instruments for a parcel by BBL. Follow with `acris_document` for parties (grantor/grantee) and the decoded document type.

tools.name: Dob permits
tools.description: Construction, alteration, plumbing or demolition permit history for a building once you have its BIN (from `resolve_address`).

tools.name: Dob violations
tools.description: Open or resolved DOB violations, ECB/OATH summonses and outstanding penalties for a building by BIN.

tools.name: Property
tools.description: Owner of record, lot and building facts, assessed value or zoning for a parcel once you have its BBL (from `resolve_address`).

tools.name: Resolve address
tools.description: First step for any 'who owns / what was filed at <address>' question: turn the address into a BBL (for `property`, `acris_documents`) and a BIN (for `dob_permits`, `dob_violations`).

tools.name: Dialysis facilities
tools.description: Find Medicare-certified dialysis facilities and their CMS star ratings and modalities. Use dialysis_facility with a CCN for standardized outcomes.

tools.name: Dialysis facility
tools.description: Look up a dialysis facility's CMS star rating and patient outcomes versus expected. Get the CCN from dialysis_facilities.

tools.name: Home health agencies
tools.description: Find Medicare-certified home health agencies and their CMS quality star ratings. Use home_health_agency with a CCN for services offered and individual measures.

tools.name: Home health agency
tools.description: Look up a home health agency's CMS star rating, services and quality measures. Get the CCN from home_health_agencies.

tools.name: Hospital
tools.description: Look up a hospital's CMS star rating and how many of its measures are better, no different or worse than national rates. Get the CCN from hospitals.

tools.name: Hospitals
tools.description: Find Medicare-certified hospitals and their CMS overall star ratings. Use hospital with a CCN for measure-group detail. Star ratings summarize CMS quality measures; they are not clinical outcome guarantees.

tools.name: Nursing home
tools.description: Look up a nursing home's CMS ratings, staffing, inspections and penalties. Get the CCN from nursing_homes. Penalties cover the last three years as published by CMS.

tools.name: Nursing homes
tools.description: Find Medicare/Medicaid nursing homes and compare their CMS five-star ratings. Use nursing_home with a CCN for staffing, inspection, penalty and chain detail.

tools.name: Utilization
tools.description: Look up a clinician's reported Medicare procedure occurrences, not unique patients, quality or outcomes. Check displayed_on_profile before showing profile-facing results; CMS does not give a reason for an N flag. Use the separate NPI Registry program for clinician identity.

tools.name: Get dataset
tools.description: After search_datasets, to read a dataset fully and pick a resource id for get_resource or query_datastore.

tools.name: Get resource
tools.description: Before query_datastore: confirm `datastore_active` and read the field ids and types; otherwise use `url` to fetch the file from the publisher.

tools.name: List organizations
tools.description: To find the organisation slug to filter search_datasets by (e.g. `q: "statistics"` for the Australian Bureau of Statistics).

tools.name: Query datastore
tools.description: For tabular data (population, income, business counts ...) once get_resource or a dataset card shows `datastore_active: true`. Field ids come from `fields`; do not guess them.

tools.name: Search datasets
tools.description: Start here to find datasets and their resource ids. Use `organization` with a slug from list_organizations (ABS Census tables: `government-of-the-commonwealth-of-australia-australian-bureau-of-statistics-australian-urban-researc`; ABS: `australianbureauofstatistics`). Add `fq: "res_datastore_active:true"` to keep only datasets whose rows query_datastore can read.

tools.name: Data
tools.description: Retrieve observations from any IMF dataflow (BOP current account, ER exchange rates, IL reserves, IMTS bilateral trade, CPI, GFS, FM, WEO) by dimension key. Codes are validated against the dataflow's availability; unknown codes fail with invalid_input listing valid ones. Observations carry source codes, unit, scale, status and dataset vintage; a valid key with no observations returns complete=true and no records.

tools.name: Dataflows
tools.description: List IMF Data portal dataflows (WEO, BOP, ER, IMTS, CPI, GFS_*, FM and 200+ more, including frozen vintages) filtered by a free-text query over id, agency and name. Returns dataflow records with stable AGENCY:ID identifiers for structure and data.

tools.name: Structure
tools.description: Describe one dataflow: its dimensions in SDMX key order, the concept/codelist each one uses, the codes that currently carry data, attribute ids, series count and time coverage. Use before data to learn valid REF_AREA/INDICATOR/FREQ codes.

tools.name: Weo
tools.description: World Economic Outlook observations for one edition (2026-04 current, 2025-10, 2025-04, or `latest`), given WEO subject codes (NGDP_RPCH, PCPIPCH, LUR, GGXWDG_NGDP, BCA_NGDPD, ...) and ISO3 economy or WEO group codes. Every row carries the edition, publication date and is_estimate (year after LATEST_ACTUAL_ANNUAL_DATA), so two editions can be compared for revisions.

tools.name: Get company
tools.description: When the 9-digit SIREN is known (from search_companies or a trademark holder's identifier).

tools.name: Get design
tools.description: When a design id from search_designs is known.

tools.name: Get patent
tools.description: When the publication number with its country prefix is known.

tools.name: Get trademarks
tools.description: After search_trademarks, or when the office code + application number is known.

tools.name: Search companies
tools.description: Find a French company's SIREN and registration facts; chain `items[].siren` into get_company.

tools.name: Search designs
tools.description: Find designs by product name or applicant; chain `items[].id` into get_design.

tools.name: Search patents
tools.description: Find patents by keyword, applicant or inventor; chain `items[].id` into get_patent.

tools.name: Search trademarks
tools.description: Find trademarks by name, owner or Nice class, e.g. all FR/EM/WO marks named 'chanel' in class 3. Chain the returned `items[].id` into get_trademarks for the full record.

tools.name: Dataset
tools.description: Before `rows`: column field names and datatypes must come from here, not be guessed. Accepts a 4x4 id or any data.sf.gov / data.sfgov.org dataset URL.

tools.name: Datasets
tools.description: Start here when the 4x4 dataset id is unknown: find the dataset, then call `dataset` for its columns and `rows` for its data. Only results with type `dataset` (and a non-null api_url) have rows.

tools.name: Facets
tools.description: Discover how the portal organises its assets before searching by category or tag.

tools.name: Row count
tools.description: Size a `rows` query before paging, or answer a pure how-many question.

tools.name: Rows
tools.description: Any question that needs actual records from a DataSF dataset. Get the 4x4 id from `datasets` and the column field names from `dataset` first. Use `row_count` to size a query before paging.

tools.name: Concept values
tools.description: Enumerate what a source can be queried by, e.g. IDS creditor codes for `source_data`.

tools.name: Countries
tools.description: Resolve country codes for `data`, or enumerate the members of a region or income group.

tools.name: Country
tools.description: Confirm a code and read its region, income level and lending type before querying data.

tools.name: Data
tools.description: Fetch the actual numbers once you know the indicator id(s) and country code(s).

tools.name: Indicator
tools.description: You have an indicator id and need its definition or its source before calling `data`.

tools.name: Indicators
tools.description: Discover indicator ids for `indicator` and `data`; browse a topic (see `reference` kind topic) or a database.

tools.name: Metadata
tools.description: Read the definition, license or methodology notes behind a series, or an economy's statistical profile.

tools.name: Reference
tools.description: Find valid `topic_id`, `region`, `income_level` or `lending_type` codes.

tools.name: Source concepts
tools.description: Before `concept_values` or `source_data` on an unfamiliar source.

tools.name: Source data
tools.description: Use for IDS (source 6) series, or when you want the dimension-keyed form of a series from any source.

tools.name: Sources
tools.description: Start here to find the source id of a database (2 WDI, 6 IDS, 15 GEM) or to read its vintage.

tools.name: Data
tools.description: Retrieve observations for up to 20 indicator codes across ISO3 countries and/or UIS regional aggregates, optionally limited to a year range and pinned to a data version. Each observation keeps the source value, magnitude and qualifier flags, footnotes and the version id; pages are sorted by indicator, geo unit, year.

tools.name: Geographies
tools.description: List UIS geo units of one type: countries (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 ids) or regional aggregates (`GROUP: Name` ids such as `SDG: Sub-Saharan Africa`), optionally filtered by name substring or aggregate family, for the default or a pinned version.

tools.name: Indicator
tools.description: Look up one indicator code and return its full metadata: name, theme, unit label, data availability, glossary definition and calculation method, and the disaggregation dimensions the code encodes. Unknown codes answer not_found.

tools.name: Indicators
tools.description: Search the full UIS indicator catalogue (about 5,000 codes including sex, wealth-quintile, location and parity-index disaggregations) by free text and theme, with data availability per indicator. Returns one page; follow next_cursor for more.

tools.name: Versions
tools.description: List every published UIS data version (release) with its publication date, description, and per-theme last-update status, flagging the current default. Use a version_id to pin data, indicators and geographies to a release.

tools.name: Company enrichment (base)
tools.description: Match a known company using identifiers with the base product. Contact entitlement comes from the dedicated credential, never from field projection.

tools.name: Company enrichment (premium)
tools.description: Match a known company using identifiers with the premium product. Contact entitlement comes from the dedicated credential, never from field projection.

tools.name: Person enrichment (base-no-contact)
tools.description: Match a known person using identifiers with the base-no-contact product. Contact entitlement comes from the dedicated credential, never from field projection.

tools.name: Person enrichment (base-with-contact)
tools.description: Match a known person using identifiers with the base-with-contact product. Contact entitlement comes from the dedicated credential, never from field projection.

tools.name: Person enrichment (premium-no-contact)
tools.description: Match a known person using identifiers with the premium-no-contact product. Contact entitlement comes from the dedicated credential, never from field projection.

tools.name: Person enrichment (premium-with-contact)
tools.description: Match a known person using identifiers with the premium-with-contact product. Contact entitlement comes from the dedicated credential, never from field projection.

tools.name: Get participant
tools.description: After search_participants, with the organization_id of a row (or the pasted https://www.dataprivacyframework.gov/participant/{id} URL), for the certification record itself.

tools.name: List reference data
tools.description: To turn an industry name into industry_ids or to see the exact recourse mechanism names before calling search_participants.

tools.name: Search participants
tools.description: Start here to find an organization_id and its current status per framework; use get_participant for the full certification record. Filter values for industry_ids and recourse_mechanisms come from list_reference_data.

tools.name: Search site content
tools.description: For questions about the program's rules and procedures rather than about a specific participant.

tools.name: Chain tvl history
tools.description: TVL trend of a chain or of DeFi overall.

tools.name: Chains
tools.description: Ranking chains by TVL or finding the exact chain name for `chain_tvl_history`, `stablecoin_history` and the chain filters.

tools.name: Hacks
tools.description: Researching exploits of a protocol, on a chain, or the largest recent hacks.

tools.name: Metrics overview
tools.description: Which protocols earn the most fees or trade the most volume, overall or on one chain.

tools.name: Price chart
tools.description: A token's price over a window (daily or hourly candles as points).

tools.name: Prices
tools.description: Spot or point-in-time USD prices for tokens by CoinGecko id or chain:address.

tools.name: Protocol
tools.description: Details and TVL history for a protocol whose slug you know (from `protocols`, or from a defillama.com/protocol/{slug} URL).

tools.name: Protocol metrics
tools.description: Fee, revenue or volume figures and history for a protocol whose slug you know.

tools.name: Protocols
tools.description: Finding a protocol slug for `protocol`/`protocol_metrics`, ranking protocols by TVL, or listing protocols in a category or on a chain.

tools.name: Stablecoin chains
tools.description: Comparing chains by stablecoin liquidity or checking how much stablecoin value sits on one chain.

tools.name: Stablecoin history
tools.description: The issue's named example: historical stablecoin supply for one asset (e.g. Tether id `1`), overall or on a chain like `Ethereum`.

tools.name: Stablecoins
tools.description: Finding a stablecoin's id for `stablecoin_history`, ranking stablecoins by supply, or listing the stablecoins on one chain or with one peg.

tools.name: Yield pool history
tools.description: APY/TVL trend of a pool whose uuid you have from `yield_pools`.

tools.name: Yield pools
tools.description: Finding yield opportunities by chain/project/asset, or a pool id for `yield_pool_history`.

tools.name: Entity
tools.description: You have a Delaware file number (from `search` or a filing) and need the registration record and registered agent.

tools.name: Registered agents
tools.description: You need the contact details of a Delaware registered agent named on an entity record, or the full list of agents the Division publishes.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: You know an entity name or a Delaware file number and need the matching registrations and their file numbers; follow up with `entity` for the free details.

tools.name: Manual chapter
tools.description: After support_documents gave you a book_id and a guid, read a chapter; use the returned toc to find the guid of 'Keyboard', 'External ports and slots', 'Power adapter' or any other specification chapter. A guid the book does not contain is not_found.

tools.name: Search products
tools.description: Find the offer_id (e.g. pb16250_fixed_20) and platform code for a model number or product name; then call tech_specs with the offer_id. Pass `page` to paginate (next_page tells you when more exist).

tools.name: Support documents
tools.description: Given a support product code (from support_search) or a shop platform code (from search_products, lowercased), list the owner's manual, setup guide, statements and release notes. Then call manual_chapter with the book_id and a guid. An unknown product code is not_found.

tools.name: Support search
tools.description: Turn a model number or product name (PB16250, XPS 13 9310, Latitude 5550) into a support product code such as dell-pro-pb16250-laptop. Zero matches is a legitimate empty result.

tools.name: Tech specs
tools.description: You have an offer_id from search_products (or a Dell product URL ending in /spd/{platform}/{offer_id}) and need the manufacturer's current specification for that exact SKU, e.g. keyboard layout or Thunderbolt/USB-C Power Delivery ports. An unknown offer id is not_found.

tools.name: Artist
tools.description: One Discogs artist or group by artist ID: name, real name, profile text, name variations, aliases, members (for groups) or groups (for people), external URLs and images.

tools.name: Artist releases
tools.description: Releases by an artist (their discography as Discogs credits it), one page at a time: masters and standalone releases with role (Main, Remix, Appearance, ...), year, format and label, sortable by year, title or format.

tools.name: Label
tools.description: One Discogs label by label ID: name, profile, contact info, parent label, sublabels, external URLs and images.

tools.name: Label releases
tools.description: A label's catalog, one page at a time: every release on the label with its catalog number, artist, title, format and year, in Discogs' catalog-number order.

tools.name: Master
tools.description: One Discogs master release (the grouping of all pressings of the same album or single) by master ID: title, artists, original year, main and most recent release IDs, genres, styles, canonical tracklist, images, videos and marketplace summary. Use master_versions to list its pressings.

tools.name: Master versions
tools.description: Pressing variants of a master release: every release (country, label, catalog number, format, year) grouped under the master, one page at a time, with the filter facets Discogs offers (format, label, country, released) and optional filters and sort.

tools.name: Release
tools.description: One Discogs release (a specific pressing or edition) by release ID: artists, labels with catalog numbers, companies and pressing plants, formats and their descriptions, identifiers (barcodes, matrix/runout etchings, label codes), tracklist, notes, images, videos, marketplace count and lowest price, community have/want and rating.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Search the Discogs database for releases, masters, artists or labels by free text, artist, release title, track, label, catalog number or barcode, optionally narrowed by year, format, country, genre and style. Returns one page of matches with type, title, year, country, formats, labels, catalog number, barcodes and IDs to pass to the detail functions.

tools.name: Metadata
tools.description: You need the title, authors, venue, year or a citation for a DOI, or the full CSL/DataCite record.

tools.name: Monthly statistics
tools.description: Chart DOI system growth or resolution volume over time.

tools.name: Prefix
tools.description: Learn which agency and which metadata endpoint serve every DOI under a prefix.

tools.name: Registration agencies
tools.description: List the agencies that issue DOIs and where to find them.

tools.name: Registration agency
tools.description: Triage a list of DOIs before fetching metadata: which are real, and which agency's metadata service will answer.

tools.name: Resolution statistics
tools.description: Size the DOI system or see where resolutions come from.

tools.name: Resolve
tools.description: You hold a DOI (or a doi.org link) and want its canonical landing URL, its registration agency and the raw handle record.

tools.name: Menu categories
tools.description: Read the flattened menu category tree and coupon categories for a store.

tools.name: Category products
tools.description: Read products and priced size/crust variants in a category and its direct subcategories.

tools.name: Store directory
tools.description: List Canadian stores from the public national directory: store ID, city, province and page URL.

tools.name: Full menu
tools.description: Read the whole structured store menu: categories, products, variants, modifier tables and coupons.

tools.name: Product options
tools.description: Read full sizes, crusts, toppings, sides, cooking instructions and priced variants for a product.

tools.name: Store details
tools.description: Read one store profile, hours, payment methods, waits and service capabilities.

tools.name: Find nearby stores
tools.description: Find Canadian stores near latitude and longitude; returns address, hours, availability and waits.

tools.name: Categories
tools.description: List menu categories for one US store.

tools.name: Category
tools.description: Read category products and direct subcategories for one store.

tools.name: Delivery cost
tools.description: Read the published store delivery fee and minimum in USD. Does not validate an address or create an order.

tools.name: Menu
tools.description: Read the complete store menu, variants, modifiers, preconfigured (ready-made) SKUs and coupons in one request. Topping cost is in each variant's `pricing` map (`Price1-N`: price with N added toppings); toppings carry no price of their own.

tools.name: Modifiers
tools.description: Read product sizes, bases, toppings, sides and cooking options.

tools.name: Store
tools.description: Read public store details, availability and hours.

tools.name: Stores
tools.description: Find US stores near a postal code or city and state, nearest first with the distance in miles. Returns the fixed nearest set Domino's publishes for the query (at most 10 stores) in one complete response; the store lookup has no page, limit, cursor or radius parameter upstream, so this is not paginated and nothing beyond that set is reachable for one query.

tools.name: Ros rankings
tools.description: Rest-of-season trade and waiver value for a position.

tools.name: Weekly rankings
tools.description: Weekly start/sit rankings and point projections for a position, for example week 4 half-PPR quarterbacks. Omit week for the current week.

tools.name: Brand products
tools.description: List a brand's catalogue after finding the exact `brand_name` in search_labels or browse_brands.

tools.name: Browse brands
tools.description: Find how DSLD spells a brand before calling brand_products or search_labels with a `brand` filter.

tools.name: Browse products
tools.description: Enumerate products alphabetically or by a word in the product name without full-text ranking; use search_labels for ingredient or brand filters.

tools.name: Ingredient groups
tools.description: Resolve a user's ingredient term (e.g. `ashwagandha`) to DSLD's group name and synonyms before filtering search_labels by `ingredient_name`, or to read fact-sheet links.

tools.name: Label
tools.description: You have a `dsld_id` (from search_labels, brand_products or browse_products) or a `https://dsld.od.nih.gov/label/{id}` URL and need ingredient amounts, %DV, directions or warnings.

tools.name: Search labels
tools.description: Find supplements by name, brand, ingredient or UPC (quote the formatted UPC, e.g. `"0 15794 08124 1"`); page with `offset`/`next_offset`; then call `label` for amounts and %DV.

tools.name: Summary
tools.description: Discover the filter codes (product_type, supplement_form, target_group) and how many labels DSLD holds, or check data freshness.

tools.name: Render clip
tools.description: To show a field on a given date. Get the scene id from search_scenes. Sizes grow with the geometry: keep max_px small for large fields.

tools.name: Scene availability
tools.description: To see whether a period has usable imagery, or how dense the archive is for a place, before calling search_scenes or vegetation_indices.

tools.name: Scene detail
tools.description: When you need asset URLs or raster metadata for a scene id returned by search_scenes.

tools.name: Search scenes
tools.description: Start here to find scene ids and dates for a field, then pass them to vegetation_indices or render_clip. Percentages are per MGRS tile, not per field; use vegetation_indices for the field's own cloud share.

tools.name: Vegetation indices
tools.description: For a paddock, field or parcel: how green or moist is it per scene, how much of it was cloudy, and which zones lag. Pass scene_ids from search_scenes, or a window and the newest clear scenes are chosen.

tools.name: Event
tools.description: Look up one known earthquake's authoritative parameters and impact estimates: how strong the shaking was, the PAGER alert and whether fatalities or economic losses drove it, how many people reported feeling it. Use search to find event ids.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Find earthquakes (or other seismic events) in a time window, region or magnitude range: recent significant quakes, a historical sequence, quakes near a site. Use event for one event's ShakeMap, PAGER and DYFI summaries.

tools.name: Item
tools.description: You have an item number or /itm/ URL and want its current listing data without loading the HTML page.

tools.name: Item shipping
tools.description: You need the shipping service, delivery estimate, ships-to list or returns policy of a listing.

tools.name: Item variations
tools.description: The item has variations (item.has_variations) and you need per-SKU prices and availability.

tools.name: Suggest
tools.description: Expand a partial product query into the keywords eBay proposes before searching.

tools.name: City price parities
tools.description: The 'how expensive is EU city X relative to Brussels' question at half-year granularity. Omit cities for all 33; use since/until for a period range.

tools.name: Get dataset
tools.description: After search_datasets, to learn which dimensions and codes a dataset accepts before calling query_data.

tools.name: Price level indices
tools.description: The 'how expensive is country X relative to the EU' question. Pass geo codes to restrict; omit year for the whole series.

tools.name: Query data
tools.description: Any dataset code from search_datasets once get_dataset has shown its dimensions and codes. For country price level indices or city purchasing power parities the typed wrappers are simpler.

tools.name: Search datasets
tools.description: Start here to find a dataset code (for example 'price level indices' -> prc_ppp_ind_1, tec00120) before calling get_dataset or query_data.

tools.name: Fx rates
tools.description: Official ECB EUR exchange rates (e.g. EUR/USD reference rate on a date, latest EUR/JPY, a month of EUR/GBP), or a cross rate such as USD/JPY computed from ECB reference rates.

tools.name: Search dataflows
tools.description: Finding which ECB dataflow holds a statistic, or which dimension codes make up a series key, before calling series.

tools.name: Series
tools.description: Euro area statistics from the ECB: €STR (EST B.EU000A2X2A25.WT), key ECB interest rates (FM B.U2.EUR.4F.KR.MRR_FR.LEV, DFR, MLFR), HICP inflation (ICP M.U2.N.000000.4.ANR), M3 (BSI M.U2.Y.V.M30.X.1.U2.2300.Z01.E), bank lending rates (MIR), yield curves (YC), or any other ECB series key.

tools.name: Get business
tools.description: After search_businesses, with the business_id of a row, for the full registry record of one entity.

tools.name: Get filing history
tools.description: With a business_id from search_businesses, to list an entity's filings and annual registrations.

tools.name: Get name history
tools.description: With a business_id from search_businesses, to see the entity's former names.

tools.name: Search businesses
tools.description: Start here to find an entity's business_id and control number; use `get_business` for the full record.

tools.name: Search service of process
tools.description: To find lawsuits served on the Secretary of State as agent for a Georgia entity, by defendant or plaintiff name.

tools.name: Search trademarks
tools.description: To find Georgia state (not federal USPTO) trademark registrations by mark text or registrant.

tools.name: Get report
tools.description: You have a report_id and report_kind from search_reports (or a pasted /search/view/ URL) and need the filing's contents: PTR transactions, annual report parts, paper page images or the extension notice.

tools.name: Search reports
tools.description: Find Senate financial disclosure filings (PTRs, annual reports, extensions, blind trusts, paper filings) by Senator or candidate name, state, report type or date, and obtain report_id values for get_report.

tools.name: Data
tools.description: One page of observations from an EIA route (`<route>/data`) at a frequency, filtered by facet codes and a period range, sorted, with offset pagination up to 5000 rows per page. Each record carries the period, every facet as {code, name}, requested values as source strings, units copied from the source, extra source flags, and the series id when the route has one. Period formats follow the frequency (YYYY, YYYY-Qn, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH).

tools.name: Facet values
tools.description: List every value of one facet on a route (for example `sectorid` on `electricity/retail-sales`, or `series` on `petroleum/pri/spt`) with its code, readable name and alias, so `data` can be filtered by code.

tools.name: Routes
tools.description: Navigate the EIA API v2 route hierarchy. Given a route path (or none for the root) returns that route's metadata: child routes, frequencies with period formats, facet ids and data columns with units. Use it to find the route, frequency, facets and columns that `data` needs.

tools.name: Division results
tools.description: You know the EventId and the electoral division number (from `election_results`) and need results at voting-location level.

tools.name: Election results
tools.description: You have a numeric EventId (from `list_events`) and want the division-level official count. Use `division_results` for the poll-by-poll detail of one division.

tools.name: List events
tools.description: Start here to find the EventId for `election_results`, `division_results` and `search_candidates`.

tools.name: List parties
tools.description: Find the party id for `party_detail` or for the `party_id` filters of `search_candidates` and `search_contributors`.

tools.name: List third party advertisers
tools.description: Who is registered to advertise in the referendum and how much they have raised; the ids feed `third_party_advertiser_detail`.

tools.name: Party detail
tools.description: You have a party id from `list_parties` and want its filings and officers; pass `year` to get one financial year.

tools.name: Search candidates
tools.description: You want the candidate list of a general election or by-election, or a candidate's financial account identifiers. At least one of `ed`, `party_id` or `name` is required (the site's rule).

tools.name: Search contributors
tools.description: You want who gave how much to whom; `name` needs at least 3 characters. Narrow broad surnames by `year`, `party_id` or `ed`.

tools.name: Third party advertiser detail
tools.description: You have a TPAID from `list_third_party_advertisers`.

tools.name: Medicines
tools.description: Search medicines evaluated through EMA's centralised procedure (EU EPAR medicine pages): name, EMA product number, status (Authorised, Withdrawn, Refused, ...), INN, active substance, ATC code, therapeutic area, marketing authorisation holder, procedure dates and flags such as orphan, generic, biosimilar and conditional approval. Filter by words, category or status, or resolve one ema_product_number. Therapeutic indications are withheld. Every result carries EMA attribution.

tools.name: Shortages
tools.description: Search medicine supply shortages assessed by EMA: medicine, INN, status (Shortage ongoing, Shortage resolved, Medicine discontinued), pharmaceutical forms and strengths affected, availability of alternatives, expected resolution and the EMA shortage page. Filter by words, category or status, or resolve one record_id. Covers shortages EMA assessed, not every national shortage. Every result carries EMA attribution.

tools.name: Event
tools.description: Read a specific game/match after finding its event_id in scoreboard or team_schedule.

tools.name: Injuries
tools.description: Check who is out or questionable before a game, for fantasy lineups or betting research; feed athlete_id to `player`.

tools.name: Leagues
tools.description: Start here to discover `sport` and `league` slugs before calling scoreboard, teams, standings or search.

tools.name: Player
tools.description: Read a player's bio and season-by-season statistics after finding the athlete_id in roster or search.

tools.name: Roster
tools.description: Get athlete_id values and roster details for a team; feed athlete_id to `player`.

tools.name: Scoreboard
tools.description: Find schedules, live and completed scores for a league and day, and the event_id for `event`.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Resolve a team or player name to ESPN ids and the league slug to use with team, roster, player.

tools.name: Standings
tools.description: Read a league table or conference/division standings for a season.

tools.name: Team
tools.description: Read a team's record, standing and next fixture by team_id.

tools.name: Team schedule
tools.description: List a team's fixtures and results with event_ids for `event`.

tools.name: Teams
tools.description: Get team_id values for team, team_schedule, roster.

tools.name: Listing
tools.description: You have a listing id or an etsy.com/listing/{id}/ URL. Use similar_listings for discovery, listing_variations for option prices, shop_sections for the seller's sections.

tools.name: Listing variations
tools.description: A listing shows has_variation_pricing or you need the option values a buyer can pick. Needs a listing id from listing or similar_listings.

tools.name: Search suggestions
tools.description: Expand or normalize a shopping query before looking for listings elsewhere. Keyword search itself is not available from this program.

tools.name: Shop sections
tools.description: You have a shop_id from a listing and want the shop's catalog structure and active listing counts.

tools.name: Similar listings
tools.description: Fan out from one known listing to related listings. Etsy keyword search is DataDome-gated and not available; use search_suggestions for query completions.

tools.name: Availability
tools.description: Read live Expedia UK room offers and numeric GBP total stay prices for one hotel and one room. Includes rate-plan IDs, payment model and source cancellation/meal text where supplied. Does not reserve or book. A dated sold-out answer returns available:false with no rooms; ambiguous upstream availability errors remain failures.

tools.name: Locations
tools.description: Find destination region IDs on Expedia UK for use with search. Returns destination suggestions only, not hotel-name suggestions.

tools.name: Search
