tools.description: Search Expedia UK hotels for dates and guests in one room. Returns hotel IDs, source URLs and displayed GBP stay prices. Resume with next_offset and the same criteria; results may change between pages.

tools.name: Aircraft
tools.description: Look up who owns a US-registered aircraft or what a tail number is. Unassigned numbers are not_found; malformed numbers are invalid_input.

tools.name: Aircraft documents
tools.description: Check recorded liens, security agreements or bills of sale on an aircraft. Most current aircraft have none; an empty page is a valid answer. Malformed N-numbers are invalid_input.

tools.name: Aircraft search
tools.description: Find the tail numbers an operator owns or every aircraft with a given serial number, then call `aircraft` for the detail record. Owner names match as a prefix on the registry's upper-case name. For dealer certificates use `dealer_search`.

tools.name: Airport delays
tools.description: Check whether an airport has an active delay program or closure right now. Only airports with an event are listed; `found: false` for a requested airport means no active event, not an unknown airport.

tools.name: Airworthiness directive
tools.description: Read the details of an airworthiness directive (or any DRS document) found with `airworthiness_directive_search`. Unknown keys are not_found.

tools.name: Airworthiness directive search
tools.description: Find the ADs and related documents for an aircraft make or model, a part or a topic. Filter with `status: Current` for in-force documents; page with `offset`.

tools.name: Dealer search
tools.description: Find whether a company holds (or held) an FAA dealer aircraft registration certificate. Names match as a prefix on the registry's upper-case name; expired certificates are listed too.

tools.name: Make model lookup
tools.description: Fleet-size questions (`how many SR22s are registered in Florida?`), or to find the canonical registry manufacturer/model spelling and MMS code before other lookups. Manufacturer and model match as prefixes.

tools.name: N number availability
tools.description: Pick a tail number for a new registration or reservation, or check which numbers in a vanity pattern are free. Numbers listed are available at the registry's nightly refresh; confirm with `aircraft` before filing.

tools.name: Get product
tools.description: Use after search_products or list_products with a result's product_id, or when the user pastes a www.fanatics.com product URL. Inventory counts are the site's edge-cached values and may be minutes old.

tools.name: List products
tools.description: Use when the user wants a team's or league's gear or a department within it. league_id comes from a search facet (type o), team_id from list_teams, department_id from a facet option of type d. Pass url instead of ids to follow a facet or breadcrumb path returned by this function or search_products.

tools.name: List teams
tools.description: Use to turn a league into team ids for list_products. League ids come from the Leagues facet of search_products (23 = NBA, 25 = NFL, 19 = MLB, 5 = College).

tools.name: Search products
tools.description: Start here when the user names a product, player or team in free text. Follow a result's product_id into get_product for sizes and stock, or a facet option's path into list_products.

tools.name: Rankings
tools.description: This week's start/sit order or projected points for a position from FantasyData, for example half-PPR running backs or the kicker ranking.

tools.name: Adp
tools.description: Where players go in drafts for a scoring format and league size, this season or any season back to 2007.

tools.name: Rankings
tools.description: This week's start/sit order and projected points for a position in standard, PPR, half-PPR or 2-QB scoring, or long-term dynasty and rookie rankings.

tools.name: Get member
tools.description: After search_members or search_members_by_name, to read the full record (service areas, telephone, member since) for one location_id.

tools.name: Search members
tools.description: Start here to find firestop contractors, inspection agencies or suppliers by where they work and what they are accredited for; take location_id into get_member for the full record. Use search_members_by_name when you know the company name.

tools.name: Search members by name
tools.description: When you know (part of) the company name and want its location_id, accreditation badges or contacts.

tools.name: Device clearances
tools.description: Search device 510(k) submission decision records and resolve a k_number. Preserve decision_code and decision_date; do not equate every returned submission with clearance or PMA approval.

tools.name: Device recalls
tools.description: Search medical device enforcement recall records and resolve a recall_number. Preserve recall reason, status and classification; this is not the separate device recall classification dataset.

tools.name: Drug applications
tools.description: Search Drugs@FDA applications and submission histories, or resolve an application_number. Inspect submission statuses: a returned record alone is not proof of current approval or availability.

tools.name: Drug events
tools.description: FAERS drug adverse event reports: patient reactions, suspect and concomitant drugs, seriousness and reporter qualification. Search e.g. patient.drug.medicinalproduct:aspirin, patient.reaction.reactionmeddrapt:nausea or receivedate:[20250101 TO 20251231], or resolve a safetyreportid using record_id. A report is not evidence that the drug caused the reaction; FAERS lags the calendar by months.

tools.name: Drug labels
tools.description: Search structured drug labeling and resolve a source label id. Includes source warnings and indications where available. Label presence does not itself establish FDA approval.

tools.name: Drug ndc
tools.description: NDC Directory product listings: product NDC, brand and generic names, labeler, dosage form, route, active ingredients, marketing category and packages. Search e.g. brand_name:Lipitor, generic_name:atorvastatin or labeler_name:Pfizer, or resolve a product_ndc using record_id. A listing is not proof of FDA approval.

tools.name: Drug recalls
tools.description: Search drug enforcement recall records, including classification, reason and recall status. Search product_description, recalling_firm or report_date, or resolve a recall_number using record_id.

tools.name: Drug shortages
tools.description: FDA drug shortage entries: generic name, company, presentation, status (Current, Resolved, To Be Discontinued), therapeutic category and posting and update dates. Search e.g. generic_name:amoxicillin, status:Current or company_name:Pfizer, or resolve a package_ndc using record_id; one package NDC can appear in more than one entry.

tools.name: Food recalls
tools.description: Search food enforcement recall records and resolve a recall_number. Source recall status and affected product descriptions are preserved.

tools.name: Get food
tools.description: After `search_foods` or `search_foods_by_nutrient` returned an FDC id, or when the user pastes a food-details URL.

tools.name: List food categories
tools.description: To see how FoodData Central groups foods of a data type, or to resolve a category code.

tools.name: List nutrients
tools.description: To find a nutrient id or unit before `search_foods_by_nutrient`, or to see which nutrients the database tracks at all.

tools.name: Search foods
tools.description: Start here to find FDC ids by name, brand, UPC or to enumerate a data type; then call `get_food` for the full record.

tools.name: Search foods by nutrient
tools.description: To find which foods have data for a specific nutrient, or the richest sources of it; `get_food` then gives the full record.

tools.name: Candidates
tools.description: Find a federal candidate's FEC candidate ID and principal campaign committee before asking for totals, filings or independent expenditures.

tools.name: Committee totals
tools.description: How much a campaign, PAC or party committee raised, spent and has on hand in a cycle. Use the candidate's principal committee ID for a candidate.

tools.name: Committees
tools.description: Resolve a campaign, PAC or party committee to its FEC committee ID, or list the committees linked to a candidate.

tools.name: Disbursements
tools.description: See what a campaign, PAC or party committee spent money on, or which committees paid a vendor or another committee.

tools.name: Filings
tools.description: List a committee's or candidate's FEC filings, find the latest quarterly report, or get links to the filed documents.

tools.name: Independent expenditures
tools.description: Who spent independently for or against a candidate and how much, or what a super PAC spent on which races.

tools.name: Receipt aggregates
tools.description: Where a committee's individual money comes from: small versus large donors, top states or top employers.

tools.name: Calendar
tools.description: See what the Federal Reserve Board has scheduled (or held) in a given month: upcoming speeches, the next FOMC meeting, release dates.

tools.name: Data series
tools.description: Pull Federal Reserve statistical release data (H.15 interest rates, H.10 exchange rates, G.19 consumer credit, Z.1 financial accounts...) as numbers rather than scraping the release tables.

tools.name: Fomc meetings
tools.description: Find FOMC meeting dates and the statement, minutes or projections documents for a meeting; pass a statement URL's slug to `press_release`.

tools.name: Press release
tools.description: Read the text of an FOMC statement, enforcement action or other announcement whose slug came from `press_releases`, `fomc_meetings` or a pasted URL.

tools.name: Press releases
tools.description: Find recent Federal Reserve Board announcements (FOMC statements, enforcement actions, banking orders, regulatory policy) and the slug to pass to `press_release`.

tools.name: Speech
tools.description: Read the full text of a speech or testimony whose slug came from `speeches`, `calendar` or a pasted URL.

tools.name: Speeches
tools.description: List recent policy speeches or testimony by a given official or in a date range and get the slug to pass to `speech`.

tools.name: Season projections
tools.description: Season-long projected totals for drafts or rest-of-season planning.

tools.name: Weekly projections
tools.description: Projected points and stat lines for a position in one NFL week, in a specific league's scoring.

tools.name: Weekly rankings
tools.description: Weekly start/sit order for a position.

tools.name: Dividends
tools.description: Cash dividend history for one ticker over a range (default 10y): each payout's ex-dividend date and per-share amount, newest first, plus any stock splits in the range with their ratio. A stock that pays no dividend returns count 0.

tools.name: Earnings
tools.description: Earnings calendar and estimates for one ticker: the next earnings date (with an is_estimate flag and, when Yahoo gives a window, its end), consensus EPS and revenue estimates for that quarter, the last four quarters of EPS actual vs estimate with surprise, and the analyst estimate trend by period (0q, +1q, 0y, +1y).

tools.name: History
tools.description: Historical OHLCV price bars for one symbol (stock, ETF, cash index such as ^GSPC, future such as NQ=F, or exchange-suffixed listing such as 0700.HK) at 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 60m, 1d, 1wk or 1mo intervals, oldest first, with split-adjusted open/high/low/close, dividend-adjusted `adj_close` (daily and longer), volume, and the dividend and split events inside the window. Pick the span with `range` (default depends on the interval) or an inclusive `start`/`end` date window. Yahoo only keeps 1m bars for the last 30 days (at most 8 days per request), 5m/15m/30m bars for the last 60 days and 60m bars for the last 730 days; impossible interval, range and date combinations return invalid_input instead of an empty result. A valid window with no trading (a weekend) returns count 0. Bars with no trades are omitted. Output is capped at 3 MiB (about 15,000 daily bars); use `start`/`end` for longer spans.

tools.name: Quote
tools.description: Live quote and key fundamentals for one symbol (stock, ETF, cash index such as ^GSPC, future such as NQ=F, or exchange-suffixed listing such as 0700.HK): last price, change, day range, volume, pre/post-market, market cap, shares outstanding, 52-week range, valuation ratios (P/E, PEG, P/B, EV/EBITDA), margins, cash/debt, analyst targets, dividend rate/yield with ex-dividend date, the next earnings date, and company profile. Unknown values are null.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Resolve a company name or partial ticker to Yahoo Finance symbols. Returns up to `count` matches with symbol, name, quote type (EQUITY, ETF, ...), exchange, sector and industry; feed a `symbol` into quote, earnings or dividends.

tools.name: Advanced search
tools.description: Search companies by name, free-text registered-office address, dates, status, type and one SIC code. Returns one page; source limits access to 10,000 results and dissolved coverage to 2010 onward.

tools.name: Alphabetical search
tools.description: Read an alphabetical window of company names with opaque previous/next cursors. This is not a substring search.

tools.name: Charge
tools.description: Read a returned charge identifier, dates, status, entitled parties, particulars and filing links.

tools.name: Charges
tools.description: Read one company-charge page, optionally outstanding charges only.

tools.name: Company
tools.description: Read a company overview, deadlines, SICs, former names and available sections. Preserve different date/address meanings and partial profiles for special company types.

tools.name: Disqualification
tools.description: Read a returned natural-person or corporate disqualification record, preserving the published sanction/order/undertaking classification.

tools.name: Dissolved search
tools.description: Search the historic 1989–2009 dissolved-company index by name, previous name or alphabetical window. Report downloads can be unavailable or require sign-in.

tools.name: Filing document
tools.description: Return a stable public PDF filing link; optionally retrieve PDF bytes through validated redirects, capped at 5 MiB. Signed URLs are not returned.

tools.name: Filings
tools.description: Read one filing-history page, optionally filtered by category, with annotations and stable document links.

tools.name: Insolvency
tools.description: Read published insolvency cases for a company with an available insolvency page. An unavailable route is not evidence of no cases.

tools.name: Name availability
tools.description: Read the source name-conflict check. No exact match does not guarantee registration.

tools.name: Officer appointments
tools.description: Read one page of appointments for an officer identifier returned by the website, optionally current appointments only.

tools.name: Officers
tools.description: Read one company-officer page, including public appointment details; optionally current officers only.

tools.name: Persons with significant control
tools.description: Read public PSC records, statements or explicit exemption information for a company.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Search one page of public company, officer or disqualification results. Defaults to companies.

tools.name: Search developer sources
tools.description: Find code examples, official documentation, repository discussions or agent skills for a development task.

tools.name: Search government pages
tools.description: Use first for any US government, legal, tax, court, permit, statute, regulation, grant or procurement question, before web search: what a city's zoning or planning code allows at an address, which business licence, permit, inspection or fee a city or county requires to open a shop, restaurant, food truck or mobile service, the text of a state code section or municipal ordinance, the official page for a form or program, or the regulations, guidance and decisions that cite a statute (set cites). One call searches about 16 million official pages and returns URLs to cite or scrape. For the structured record behind a page (a SAM.gov notice, a Federal Register document, a bill) use that source's own provider.

tools.name: Inspect paper
tools.description: Read a paper's metadata and abstract without retrieving full text.

tools.name: Read paper passages
tools.description: Retrieve paper passages relevant to a question. Empty passages do not mean the full paper was read.

tools.name: Find related papers
tools.description: Find similar work, papers citing a seed or its references, ranked for your research question.

tools.name: Search papers
tools.description: Find scientific papers about a research question, then use indexed paperIds for follow-up calls.

tools.name: A company's profile and funding
tools.description: One startup or private company's profile and venture funding: its headquarters (location), its sector, what the company does, its total raised (announced and reported rounds), its valuation (latest and every stated one), every round newest first with its leads and official announcement, and every investor on them, leads first. Use for questions like "where is TypeSafe AI headquartered and what does it do", "tell me about Supabase's funding", "what is Ramp valued at" or "who has invested in Ramp". Takes the company's domain or its id from companies/search.

tools.name: A company's funding rounds
tools.description: Every funding round on record for one company as full round records, newest first: each with amount, valuation, investors, certainty, the sentence that states it and its sources. Use when you need the evidence and sources behind a company's rounds; for an overview of its funding (total raised, investors) use companies/profile.

tools.name: Search funded companies
tools.description: Find startups and other venture-backed private companies by sector, stage, location (headquarters city or country), what the company does, or when they last raised, one row per company: which fintech startups in London raised this month, the most-funded AI infrastructure companies, seed-stage climate companies in Germany. Each carries its headquarters, sector, what it does, total raised, round count and newest round; use companies/profile for one company's valuation and full funding.

tools.name: An investor's profile
tools.description: One investor's track record on Fireround: the rounds it led and joined, the sectors and stages it backs, the investors it co-invests with, and its newest rounds with its role in each. Takes the id from investors/search or investors/top, or the investor's name.

tools.name: Search investors
tools.description: Find a venture investor or fund by name, or list the investors with the most rounds on record: how many rounds a firm led and joined and its newest round. Use the returned id with investors/profile for its portfolio and sectors.

tools.name: Most active lead investors
tools.description: Rank the investors that led the most startup funding rounds this week, this month or this quarter, overall or in one sector or stage: which VCs led the most AI rounds this month, who is leading the most seed deals this week. Each carries the money it led and its latest led rounds.

tools.name: Latest funding news
tools.description: The latest startup funding news: articles from press and newswires about the rounds Fireround tracks, newest first, each with its publisher, date, and the rounds it reports (company, amount, stage, lead investors). Use for what's happening in startup funding today or this week, or the coverage of one company's raise.

tools.name: Search funding rounds
tools.description: Search startup funding rounds: the latest rounds, the biggest rounds, and rounds by stage, sector, investor, date or size across venture capital (VC funding) of private companies, pre-seed to growth. Who raised money in AI infrastructure this week, who raised a Series A in fintech this week, the largest AI rounds since a date, every round a named fund led or joined. Each funding round carries the company, amount, valuation when stated, lead and other investors, and its sources, so one call answers for many companies' rounds, investors and valuations.

tools.name: Trending funding rounds
tools.description: The funding rounds first seen in the last three days that are being discussed most, ranked by distinct people posting about them on X, press outlets covering them, and Hacker News points. Each row's `trending` carries rank, people_on_x, outlets and hn_points.

tools.name: Company directory
tools.description: Call to discover what is covered, or to resolve names to identifiers when you do not already have a ticker. Check the per-company dataset list before assuming a costlier capability will answer for it.

tools.name: Company profile
tools.description: Call first when starting from a company name or ticker: it returns every other identifier, so one call here makes the rest of this provider addressable. Also the only place peers and secondary listings are published.

tools.name: Segments and KPIs
tools.description: Call for the numbers a business is actually run on - segment revenue, units, subscribers - which never reach the three statements. Coverage is narrower than for financials, and varies by company.

tools.name: Shares outstanding
tools.description: Call when a per-share figure has to be computed, or when a dual-class structure means the headline share count is misleading. Point-in-time, not a series.

tools.name: Earnings calendar
tools.description: Call to answer who reports when. Omit every company identifier for the whole calendar, which is what makes this the one capability here that answers a question not about a specific company. Read `eventStatus` before relying on a date - an estimated one moves.

tools.name: IR event resources
tools.description: Call to find what exists for a quarter before asking for any of it - the deck, the release, the report, the transcript. Rows sharing a fiscal year and quarter are one event, so group on that pair rather than on the date.

tools.name: Earnings call transcript
tools.description: Call for what was said on the call, attributed and timed. The speaker mapping is what makes it worth more than the raw text: management's prepared remarks and an analyst's question can be told apart, and the Q&A boundary is given rather than guessed.

tools.name: Company filings
tools.description: Call to find out what exists and when it was filed, and to get the document links. The filing bytes themselves are not retrievable through this provider - see its page for why - so treat `pdfUrl` as a handoff.

tools.name: Adjusted metrics
tools.description: Call when comparing against analyst estimates or consensus, which are quoted on an adjusted basis rather than a GAAP one. Not a substitute for the statements: these are management's adjustments, and the exclusions are theirs.

tools.name: Balance sheet
tools.description: Call when comparing companies, screening, or computing anything that has to mean the same thing across two filers. The mapping is visible: each standardized metric names the as-reported lines behind it, so a surprising figure can be traced rather than trusted.

tools.name: Balance sheet, as reported
tools.description: Call when fidelity to the filing matters more than comparability: the labels and groupings are the company's own, so two companies cannot be lined up against each other. Use the standardized view for that. Each value carries a link back to the filing page it came from.

tools.name: Cash flow statement
tools.description: Call when comparing companies, screening, or computing anything that has to mean the same thing across two filers. The mapping is visible: each standardized metric names the as-reported lines behind it, so a surprising figure can be traced rather than trusted.

tools.name: Cash flow statement, as reported
tools.description: Call when fidelity to the filing matters more than comparability: the labels and groupings are the company's own, so two companies cannot be lined up against each other. Use the standardized view for that. Each value carries a link back to the filing page it came from.

tools.name: Income statement
tools.description: Call when comparing companies, screening, or computing anything that has to mean the same thing across two filers. The mapping is visible: each standardized metric names the as-reported lines behind it, so a surprising figure can be traced rather than trusted.

tools.name: Income statement, as reported
tools.description: Call when fidelity to the filing matters more than comparability: the labels and groupings are the company's own, so two companies cannot be lined up against each other. Use the standardized view for that. Each value carries a link back to the filing page it came from.

tools.name: Companies in fund letters
tools.description: Call to find which companies professional investors are actually writing about, and how heavily, before asking what they said.

tools.name: Theses on a company
tools.description: Call for the qualitative case on a company as professional investors put it, with the stance and conviction attached. The one capability here that answers what people think rather than what was reported.

tools.name: Fund letter
tools.description: Call for what one letter actually argued. The narrative sections are the investor's own words; the theses are the extraction, and each names what it was based on so a thin mention is not mistaken for a conviction.

tools.name: Investor profile
tools.description: Call to understand how a firm invests before weighting what it says about a company. The profile is derived from its own letters rather than from marketing material.

tools.name: Fund letter investors
tools.description: Call to find the investorId for a firm, or to pick firms by style or sector focus before reading any letters. Sorted by coverage, so the most-covered firms come first.

tools.name: Fund letters
tools.description: Call to see what was published in a quarter. Returns the letter index rather than the letters - take a letterId to fund-letters/detail for the content.

tools.name: Ratio definitions
tools.description: Call to find a ratio id before requesting a series, and to check `hasDailyData` before asking for a daily one - not every ratio has it.

tools.name: Standardized metrics
tools.description: Call to find the standardized metric id for a concept before requesting statements, rather than guessing at a name. Free, and takes no company.

tools.name: Standardized metrics by template
tools.description: Call rather than the full list when the template is already known - it is the only place the prose definition and the sub-component breakdown of each metric are published, which is what settles what a line actually includes.

tools.name: Holdings by institution
tools.description: Call to read ownership from the investor's end rather than the company's - what a fund holds and how it is weighted. The counterpart to institutional-holders, over the same 13F data.

tools.name: Institution directory
tools.description: Call to resolve an institution's name to the holder id that ownership/holder-holdings needs. Free, and takes no company.

tools.name: Insider holders
tools.description: Call for the current standing position of officers and directors, including holdings held through trusts and other vehicles. Use insider-transactions for what they have been doing rather than what they hold.

tools.name: Insider transactions
tools.description: Call to see insider activity over time. Read `transactionType` before drawing conclusions: an option exercise or a tax withholding is not a market sale, and they sit in the same series.

tools.name: Institutional holders
tools.description: Call to see who institutionally owns a company and who moved last quarter. 13F data lags: the report date is the quarter end, the filing date is up to 45 days later, and both are returned so the lag is visible.

tools.name: Daily prices
tools.description: Call for a daily close series. Prices are split-adjusted already, so no correction against prices/splits is needed; the series is per listing, so a cross-listed company answers in whichever listing the identifier denoted.

tools.name: Intraday prices
tools.description: Call when the question is about movement within a session - a reaction to an announcement, say. Rounded to two decimals, so it is not a tick feed for execution purposes.

tools.name: Stock splits
tools.description: Call to explain a discontinuity, or to reconcile against a price series from elsewhere that is not split-adjusted. The series returned by prices/daily already is, so this is not needed to correct it.

tools.name: Daily ratio series
tools.description: Call when the question is how a ratio moved between reporting dates rather than what it was at them. Each day is recomputed against that day's close and the then-current fundamentals, so it is a real series, not a step function.

tools.name: Ratios by period
tools.description: Call for valuation, margin and leverage ratios already computed against the reported statements, rather than recomputing them from financials and risking a different denominator.

tools.name: Data
tools.description: Any question that needs the actual numbers from a Fiscal Data table. Use `datasets` first when the endpoint path is unknown; use `latest` for the newest rows of a headline table.

tools.name: Datasets
tools.description: Start here to find the `endpoint` for `data` or the `dataset_id` for `release_calendar` and `published_reports`.

tools.name: Latest
tools.description: Current values without knowing the endpoint path: today's national debt, the latest cash balance, the last auctions, the current exchange rate table.

tools.name: Published reports
tools.description: To get the official PDF/XLS of a statement for a given date rather than the table rows.

tools.name: Release calendar
tools.description: When a dataset will next be updated, or whether today's release is already out.

tools.name: Search flights
tools.description: Search Google Flights one-way fares or round-trip outbound options. For matching returns, call again with a chosen selection in selected_outbound. Round-trip outbound prices are starting prices; return prices cover the selected pair. Set carry_on_bags/checked_bags to have Google reprice every fare with those bags included; each flight reports the bags its quoted price covers and the page's per-airline baggage policy links. Bounded first-page coverage, without retries or pagination. Itineraries whose data fails validation are skipped and counted in skipped_results instead of failing the search.

tools.name: Suggest places
tools.description: Find Google Flights airport and city identifiers by name or IATA code. Includes nearby airports, deduplicated; omits rail stations and regions.

tools.name: Find stores
tools.description: Find a store id for get_store, or to price and filter products by store in search_products and get_product.

tools.name: Get product
tools.description: After search_products or suggest returned a product id, or when the id is known from a product URL (the trailing -{id}.html).

tools.name: Get store
tools.description: After find_stores, or when a store id is known from a /store/... URL or a product's store pricing.

tools.name: Product questions
tools.description: Read customer Q&A for a product id from search_products or get_product.

tools.name: Search products
tools.description: Start here to find product ids (and category slugs) for get_product and product_questions. Omit `query` to browse a category.

tools.name: Suggest
tools.description: Resolve a partial or misspelled term to category slugs, product ids and canonical search phrases before search_products.

tools.name: Get food
tools.description: After `search_foods` or `search_foods_by_nutrient` returned a food code, or when the user pastes a food-nutrition.canada.ca serving-portion or nutrientReport URL.

tools.name: List food groups
tools.description: To pick a `food_group_id` before `search_foods_by_nutrient`, or to list the CNF food groups.

tools.name: List nutrients
tools.description: To pick `nutrient_ids` for `get_food` or the `nutrient_id` for `search_foods_by_nutrient`, or to decode unit, group and source codes.

tools.name: Search foods
tools.description: Start here to find CNF food codes by name, in English or French; then call `get_food` for nutrients and measures.

tools.name: Search foods by nutrient
tools.description: To compare foods on one nutrient ('protein across cheeses': nutrient 203, food group 1), or to list the foods of a food group ranked by a nutrient.

tools.name: List players
tools.description: Browse or rank players by projected or actual fantasy points in a public league. Pass stat_period explicitly (S_PW_5 = Week 5 projections, S_S_2026 = 2026 season totals, S_W_4 = Week 4 actuals, S_PN4W = next 4 weeks projected, S_PS_2026 = season projected). For rank windows use player_rankings.

tools.name: Player news
tools.description: Recent news about a player resolved by search_players (news_url / player_id). Does not use the login-gated Fantasy player-note panel.

tools.name: Player rankings
tools.description: Compare players by Yahoo's projected vs actual rank windows in a public league. Sort with PR_W, PR_N4W, PR_S (projected) or AR_LW, AR_L4W, AR_S (actual); page with offset.

tools.name: Public team roster
tools.description: Inspect a specific public team (league_id + team_id, e.g. from a /f1/{league}/{team} URL). Private leagues are refused with upstream_blocked (login required). Projected points are not on this API surface.

tools.name: Search players
tools.description: Resolve a player name to Yahoo player ids/keys before list_players, public_team_roster or player_news. Give league_id or league_url of any public league; the result lists the league's key but player ids are league-independent.

tools.name: Dungeon
tools.description: Read one instance found through `dungeons` (pass its `slug`, like `deadmines` or `the-hall-of-thanes`). An unknown slug is `not_found`.

tools.name: Dungeons
tools.description: Answer which dungeons a WoW Forever character should run at its level and what they drop for its class. Chain `slug` into `dungeon` for bosses, full loot and quests.

tools.name: Spec
tools.description: Answer what stats a WoW Forever spec wants, which race helps it, what to aim for at 60 and which consumables to bring. For gear at a lower level use `foreverdb-net` bis; for talents use `talents`. Item ids chain into `foreverdb-net` item.

tools.name: Talents
tools.description: Answer which talents a WoW Forever character can take or should consider at its level (one point per level from 10; row N needs 5*(N-1) points in its tree) and what is new or changed for a class. Pair with `spec` for the stats the spec values.

tools.name: Bis
tools.description: Answer what gear a WoW Forever character should wear or aim for at its level: pass class, spec, level and mode. Chain an item id into `item` for its full stats and sources.

tools.name: Dungeon
tools.description: Answer what drops in a WoW Forever dungeon or raid, how its bosses work, or where it is. Take the `id` from `dungeons`; an unknown id is `not_found`. Chain item ids into `item`.

tools.name: Dungeons
tools.description: Answer which dungeons or raids a WoW Forever character should run at its level, or what instances exist. Chain an `id` into `dungeon` for bosses, loot tables and quests.

tools.name: Item
tools.description: Look up an item from a `bis` pick or alternative, or any game item id (ids are shared with Wowhead). An unknown id is `not_found`.

tools.name: Sim
tools.description: Answer how much damage a WoW Forever DPS spec does, which stats are worth most for it, or what rotation and gear the sim assumes. Healer and tank specs are not simulated (`not_found`). Chain gear item ids into `item`.

tools.name: Talent builds
tools.description: Answer what talents a WoW Forever character should take: pass class, and spec and level when known. With level, only the builds for the highest build level at or below it are returned (a level 25 character gets the level 20 builds); below 20 the list is empty.

tools.name: Event detail
tools.description: After list_events gave an event_id; for the full history use event_history (paged) or event_graph (numeric series).

tools.name: Event graph
tools.description: For charting or computing over an indicator's history; event_history gives the same releases as paged strings with links.

tools.name: Event history
tools.description: To read an indicator's release history further back than the five rows event_detail returns; event_graph gives the same values as numbers for charting.

tools.name: List events
tools.description: To see what is scheduled or was released in a date window, or to find an event_id to pass to event_detail, event_history or event_graph.

tools.name: Search events
tools.description: To find an indicator series (e.g. `cpi`, `nonfarm`) before listing its releases; the result has no per-release event_id, use list_events for those.

tools.name: Category
tools.description: Discover series by topic instead of by text: start at the root, follow `children[].category_id`, then read `series[].series_id` for `series` / `series_observations`.

tools.name: Release
tools.description: Browse the series a release publishes (e.g. release 53 = Gross Domestic Product) and hand `series[].series_id` to `series` / `series_observations`.

tools.name: Releases
tools.description: Find a `release_id` for `release`; releases group the series a statistical agency publishes together.

tools.name: Series
tools.description: Confirm what a `series_id` (or a pasted fred.stlouisfed.org/series/{id} page URL) measures and which `units`/`frequency` values `series_observations` accepts for it; the data points themselves come from `series_observations`.

tools.name: Series observations
tools.description: Get the historical values of a known `series_id` or a pasted fred.stlouisfed.org/series/{id} page URL (monthly US unemployment rate = UNRATE, CPI = CPIAUCSL, real GDP = GDPC1); pick `units` and `frequency` from `series.available_units` / `series.available_frequencies`. Use `series_search` first when only the concept is known.

tools.name: Series search
tools.description: Start here to find a `series_id` (e.g. UNRATE, CPIAUCSL) for `series` and `series_observations`.

tools.name: Source
tools.description: See what an agency publishes (e.g. source 18 = U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis) and hand `releases[].release_id` to `release`.

tools.name: Sources
tools.description: Find a `source_id` for `source`.

tools.name: Tag series
tools.description: Find series by tag combination, e.g. gdp;quarterly or usa;monthly;nsa, then read them with `series` / `series_observations`.

tools.name: Tags
tools.description: Discover tag names to combine in `tag_series`.

tools.name: Category
tools.description: Call to confirm what a category id is before walking down from it, or with no argument to land on the root. The only category endpoint that takes no real-time period, so what it returns is always the current name.

tools.name: Child categories
tools.description: The rung of the walk from the root to a series list. It descends one level per call, so getting from the root to a leaf takes several. Nothing here pages: a category with many children returns all of them.

tools.name: Related categories
tools.description: Call for the cross-links the hierarchy cannot express. Most categories have none, so an empty array is the normal answer here and not a sign the call went wrong.

tools.name: Category related tags
tools.description: Call to narrow a category further once you already have one tag: it returns the tags that co-occur with `tag_names` inside this category. It narrows rather than suggesting alternatives, and unlike `categories/tags` the `tag_names` argument is mandatory.

tools.name: Category series
tools.description: The bottom of the category walk: turns a category id into series ids. `limit` defaults to its maximum of 1000, so narrow with `tag_names` or `filter_variable` rather than expecting a small first page.

tools.name: Category tags
tools.description: Call to see what the series in a category are labelled with before filtering them. `series_count` on each tag counts only series in this category, not every series carrying the tag.

tools.name: All release dates
tools.description: Call for the economic calendar across all releases at once. Not symmetric with `releases/release-dates` despite the near-identical name: this one sorts descending by default, carries `release_name`, and only reaches back to the start of the current year unless told otherwise.

tools.name: Release related tags
tools.description: Call to narrow within a release once you have one tag. Two independently required arguments here, `release_id` and `tag_names`; the second reads like an optional filter and is not.

tools.name: Release
tools.description: Call to resolve a release id into a name and link. Widening the real-time period makes this single-release call return more than one record, one per interval in which the release's attributes differed.

tools.name: Release dates
tools.description: Call for one release's publication history. It defaults to the whole span back to 1776-07-04 rather than the current year, has no `order_by`, and omits `release_name` - three ways it differs from `releases/dates`. Set `include_release_dates_with_no_data` to get the next scheduled date.

tools.name: Releases
tools.description: The entry point for every other release capability: it is where a release name becomes the `release_id` they take. There are only a few hundred releases and `limit` defaults to 1000, so one call is usually the whole list.

tools.name: Release series
tools.description: The bridge from a release to series ids: every series that arrives with this publication. A large release runs to thousands of series, so filter with `tag_names` or `filter_variable` rather than paging the whole thing.

tools.name: Release sources
tools.description: Call when the question is who publishes a release rather than what is in it. A release can have more than one source agency.

tools.name: Release table
tools.description: Call when the layout matters - which line of a published table a series sits on, and what nests under what. This is the only capability here that answers with a tree rather than a list, so a caller that walks `key` plus `paginated` has to special-case it: descend `elements`, then each element's `children`.

tools.name: Release tags
tools.description: Call to see how a release's series are labelled before filtering `releases/series` by tag. `tag_names` is optional here and required on `releases/related-tags` - same parameter, adjacent endpoints, opposite requiredness.

tools.name: Series categories
tools.description: Call to walk back up from a series you already have to the part of the tree it lives in, and from there to its peers. A series can sit in several categories.

tools.name: Series observations
tools.description: The only capability in this provider that returns numbers; everything else exists to find the id it takes. Two independent time axes: `observation_start`/`observation_end` bound when the economy did the thing, `realtime_start`/`realtime_end` bound when FRED knew it. Leaving the real-time pair alone gives today's vintage only, so a question about revisions needs 1776-07-04 to 9999-12-31 or an explicit `vintage_dates`.

tools.name: Series release
tools.description: Call to find which publication a series arrives in, then use that `release_id` for its calendar or its sibling series. Answering `when is this next updated` goes through here rather than through the series record.

tools.name: Series search
tools.description: The way in when all you have is words. Set `search_type` to series_id when the query is an id fragment rather than a description; the default full-text mode stems, so `UNRATE` under it matches on unrelated titles. Leave `order_by` and `sort_order` unset unless you mean to override the relevance ranking, because their defaults depend on each other.

tools.name: Series search related tags
tools.description: The second step of narrowing a search: given words and one tag already applied, the tags that co-occur on what is left. Two required arguments, `series_search_text` and `tag_names` - the second looks like a filter and is mandatory.

tools.name: Series search tags
tools.description: Call after a broad `series/search` to see what would narrow it, then feed a name back as `tag_names` there. Two search-text parameters on one endpoint: `series_search_text` picks the series, `tag_search_text` filters the tags that come back.

tools.name: Series metadata
tools.description: Call before charting or comparing: `units`, `seasonal_adjustment` and `frequency` are what decide whether two series are comparable, and none of them are visible from the id. Widening the real-time period returns one record per interval in which the metadata differed, so a single-series call can answer with several rows.

tools.name: Series tags
tools.description: Call to read one series' labels - its geography, frequency, publisher and subject - and to get the tag names that would find its peers through `tags/series`. Unlike every other tag capability here it has no limit, offset, search_text or tag_group_id: you get all of them.

tools.name: Series updates
tools.description: Call to find what has changed rather than what exists - the only capability here that takes no series id. FRED caps it at series updated in the last two weeks, so it cannot answer a question about last quarter, and the sort is fixed at last_updated descending with no way to change it.

tools.name: Series vintage dates
tools.description: Call to find out when a series was actually revised, then pass one or more of these dates to `series/observations` as `vintage_dates` to see the data as it stood. The path is `vintagedates` with no underscore, and unlike its siblings the real-time period defaults to the whole span rather than to today, so a bare call returns the full revision history.

tools.name: Source releases
tools.description: The middle rung of the provenance walk: agency to release to series. Call when the question starts from a publisher - everything the BEA puts out - rather than from a subject.

tools.name: Source
tools.description: Call to resolve a source id to an agency name and site. Widening the real-time period makes this single-source call return several records, one per interval in which the agency's name or link differed.

tools.name: Sources
tools.description: Where a `source_id` comes from. There are only about a hundred agencies and `limit` defaults to 1000, so one call is the whole list and paging is never needed here.

tools.name: Related tags
tools.description: Call to narrow a tag search: given tags already chosen, the tags that co-occur with them. The one required argument is the one that is optional on `tags/tags`, and `tag_group_id` does not accept `cc` here. Tag names may contain spaces, so a value like `monetary aggregates;weekly` needs the space URL-encoded and only the `;` treated as a separator.

tools.name: Series by tag
tools.description: The non-hierarchical route to series ids: every series carrying all of `tag_names` at once, without walking the category tree. Tags intersect rather than union, so each name added narrows. Unlike `categories/series` there is no `filter_variable`/`filter_value` here - narrow with more tags instead.

tools.name: Tags
tools.description: The full vocabulary - roughly 4,800 tags against a `limit` cap of 1000, so this is the one tag capability that genuinely needs paging. `series_count` here is the global count, unlike the same field on the category, release and related-tag capabilities where it is scoped to what was asked about.

tools.name: Professional detail
tools.description: Detail read after search_professionals or autocomplete, or for a pasted fresha.com/p/ link.

tools.name: Search professionals
tools.description: Find a stylist, therapist or barber near a place; then pass the slug to professional_detail.

tools.name: Autocomplete
tools.description: Resolve a treatment name to a taxonomy id before search_venues, or find a venue/professional slug by name.

tools.name: Search venues
tools.description: Discovery: find venues offering a treatment near a place, or check which venues have openings on a date; then pass a venue slug to venue_detail.

tools.name: Venue detail
tools.description: Detail read after search_venues or autocomplete, or for a pasted fresha.com/a/ link.

tools.name: Company lookup
tools.description: Resolve one company from its domain, LinkedIn company URL, or LinkedIn company ID. Returns firmographics, technologies, social profiles, and locations.

tools.name: Company match
tools.description: Match an exact LinkedIn company URL. Use companies/lookup to resolve a domain, or companies/search to build a shortlist.

tools.name: Company search
tools.description: Find companies by industry, size, location, technologies, or founding year. Combine filters and page through the results. Use companies/lookup when you already have a domain or LinkedIn identifier.

tools.name: Mobile number
tools.description: Find a person's mobile phone number from a LinkedIn URL, or from their name and employer. The most expensive line by far: ask for it only when a phone is what the task needs. To enrich multiple contacts, send up to 10 separate calls in the Firecrawl /v2/scrape alexandria array, each with its own provider, capability and options. Each call accepts one contact, runs as a separate upstream job and is billed only for a result found. Inspect each call for errors; this is not a single bulk job. Concurrent enrichments share poll capacity and can hit rate limits; spread large batches out. Do not pass a contacts array in options.

tools.name: Personal email
tools.description: Find a person's personal email from a LinkedIn URL, or from their name and employer. Schedule A bars marketing to personal addresses; use contacts/work-email for outreach. To enrich multiple contacts, send up to 10 separate calls in the Firecrawl /v2/scrape alexandria array, each with its own provider, capability and options. Each call accepts one contact, runs as a separate upstream job and is billed only for a result found. Inspect each call for errors; this is not a single bulk job. Concurrent enrichments share poll capacity and can hit rate limits; spread large batches out. Do not pass a contacts array in options.

tools.name: Reverse email lookup
tools.description: Identify the person and company behind a work or personal email address. Returns a professional profile; use people/lookup when a name or LinkedIn URL is already known. To enrich multiple contacts, send up to 10 separate calls in the Firecrawl /v2/scrape alexandria array, each with its own provider, capability and options. Each call accepts one contact, runs as a separate upstream job and is billed only for a result found. Inspect each call for errors; this is not a single bulk job. Concurrent enrichments share poll capacity and can hit rate limits; spread large batches out. Do not pass a contacts array in options.

tools.name: Work email
tools.description: Find a person's verified work email from a LinkedIn URL, or from their name and employer. Use contacts/mobile for a phone number and people/lookup when only the profile is needed. To enrich multiple contacts, send up to 10 separate calls in the Firecrawl /v2/scrape alexandria array, each with its own provider, capability and options. Each call accepts one contact, runs as a separate upstream job and is billed only for a result found. Inspect each call for errors; this is not a single bulk job. Concurrent enrichments share poll capacity and can hit rate limits; spread large batches out. Do not pass a contacts array in options.

tools.name: Person lookup
tools.description: Resolve a person from a LinkedIn URL or ID, or a full name combined with a company domain, LinkedIn URL, or ID. Returns a profile, not verified email addresses or phone numbers.

tools.name: Person match
tools.description: Match an exact LinkedIn profile URL. Use people/lookup for additional identifiers, or people/search to build a shortlist.

tools.name: People search
tools.description: Find people by role, employer, location, skills, or work history. Combine filters and page through the results. Use people/lookup when you already know a person's identifiers; contact enrichment retrieves emails and phones separately.

tools.name: Conferences list
tools.description: Find Gartner conferences by region, audience or format, or get the detail URL and event code for a conference.

tools.name: Content list
tools.description: Browse Gartner's latest articles or press releases, or list Gartner analysts for a function such as cybersecurity.

tools.name: Webinar detail
tools.description: After webinars_search, to get speakers and the complete description for one webinar, or when a Gartner webinar URL is pasted.

tools.name: Webinars search
tools.description: Find upcoming webinars on a topic or in a date range, or browse the on-demand library. Follow with webinar_detail for speakers and the full description.

tools.name: Contributors
tools.description: One page of a repository's contributors ordered by commit count on the default branch, with login, account type and contribution count. Anonymous (email-only) contributors are not listed. GitHub refuses this listing for repositories with very large histories (for example torvalds/linux), which surfaces as an error naming the reason.

tools.name: File
tools.description: The text of one file in a public GitHub repository at a branch, tag or commit, given as a raw.githubusercontent.com URL, a github.com blob URL, or repo plus path (ref defaults to HEAD, the default branch). One ranged GET to raw.githubusercontent.com, which does not use the REST API's 60/hour quota. Returns at most the first 1 MiB: size_bytes is the full size and truncated marks a cut file, reported as partial. A binary or non-UTF-8 file fails with invalid_input (not_text); a missing file, ref or repository is not_found.

tools.name: Issue counts
tools.description: Exact issue counts for a repository (pull requests excluded, unlike the repository's open_issues_count): the total for the given state plus one count per requested label, from GitHub's issue search. Makes 1 + labels.length search requests; at most 5 labels per call because GitHub allows 10 keyless searches per minute per IP.

tools.name: Issues
tools.description: One page of a repository's issues filtered by state and labels (all given labels must match), sorted by created/updated/comments. Pull requests are excluded unless include_pull_requests is true, so a page may hold fewer than per_page records; pull_requests_excluded says how many were dropped. Each record carries title, state, labels, assignees, milestone, comment and reaction counts, body and timestamps.

tools.name: Labels
tools.description: The labels defined in a repository (name, color, description, whether GitHub-default), one page of up to 100. Use the names with issues and issue_counts.

tools.name: Latest release
tools.description: The latest published, non-prerelease, non-draft release of a repository with its release notes (Markdown body), tag, publish date, author and downloadable assets. found=false with release=null when the repository exists but has no published release.

tools.name: Releases
tools.description: One page of a repository's releases, newest first, including pre-releases and drafts visible to the public, each with tag, name, notes body, publish date and assets. Paginate with page/per_page; has_next says whether another page exists.

tools.name: Repo
tools.description: One GitHub repository by owner/name or URL: stars, forks, watchers, open issue+PR count, creation/last-push dates, primary language, topics, license, default branch, homepage and flags (archived, fork, template). One request to GET /repos/{owner}/{name}; an unknown repository is an error.

tools.name: Search repos
tools.description: Search public GitHub repositories with GitHub's search syntax (free text plus qualifiers such as language:rust, stars:>1000, topic:llm, org:firecrawl, created:>2025-01-01), sorted by best match, stars, forks, help-wanted issues or last update. Returns one page of repository records with stars, forks and dates; total_count is GitHub's overall match count, capped at 1000 reachable results (page * per_page <= 1000). Keyless search is limited to 10 requests per minute per IP. A user:, org: or repo: qualifier naming an account or repository that does not exist or is not visible fails with not_found; any other query GitHub rejects (bad qualifier value, page beyond 1000 results) fails with invalid_input and GitHub's message.

tools.name: Search jobs
tools.description: Start here for job discovery and employer comparison by hiring activity. Resolve a city/state with suggest_locations first when you need a location; pass next_cursor back as cursor for the following page. Sponsored cards are mixed in and page composition varies between fetches.

tools.name: Suggest employers
tools.description: Resolve an employer name to its Glassdoor employer id, e.g. to filter search_jobs by employer_id. Returns an empty list for an unknown term.

tools.name: Suggest keywords
tools.description: Normalize a free-text role to the job titles Glassdoor knows before search_jobs. Returns an empty list when the site has no suggestion.

tools.name: Suggest locations
tools.description: Resolve a place name to a Glassdoor location id before search_jobs. Returns an empty list for an unknown term.

tools.name: Direct children
tools.description: Page through reported direct accounting-consolidated children for an LEI. This excludes unreported ownership relationships.

tools.name: Direct parent
tools.description: Retrieve the reported direct accounting-consolidating parent, or its reporting-exception record and reason. This is not a complete beneficial-ownership graph.

tools.name: Entity
tools.description: Resolve an exact 20-character LEI to source identity, registration, mapped identifiers and relationship links. Unknown LEIs fail as upstream not-found, not an empty success.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Search global registered entities by name: current legal name, previous legal and other names, and ASCII-transliterated names, with optional legal-address country. Commas in the name are folded into spaces (GLEIF reads them as OR separators). Page through matching LEIs; name matches are candidates, not guaranteed identity equivalence.

tools.name: Ultimate children
tools.description: Page through reported ultimate accounting-consolidated children for an LEI. This excludes unreported ownership relationships.

tools.name: Ultimate parent
tools.description: Retrieve the reported ultimate accounting-consolidating parent, or its reporting-exception record and reason. Preserve exceptions rather than claiming there is no parent.

tools.name: Community messages
tools.description: Sentiment and chatter around a token.

tools.name: Dev created tokens
tools.description: Developer history: what else a token's creator (token_detail.creator_address) has launched.

tools.name: New pairs
tools.description: Discover tokens launched in the last minutes or hours. Snapshot listing (no pagination).

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Find a token's address from its name or ticker before calling token_detail, token_trades or token_holders; or find tracked wallets by Twitter handle.

tools.name: Token candles
tools.description: Price or market-cap history of a token at 1s to 1d resolution.

tools.name: Token detail
tools.description: Details for a token address from search, trending_tokens or new_pairs, or a pasted gmgn.ai token page URL. Up to 20 addresses per call.

tools.name: Token holders
tools.description: Holder concentration and who holds a token.

tools.name: Token traders
tools.description: Who made (or lost) the most on a token.

tools.name: Token trades
tools.description: Trading activity and signals for a token: who is buying and selling, in what size.

tools.name: Top buyers
tools.description: Sniper/early-buyer analysis for a token.

tools.name: Trending tokens
tools.description: Token discovery: what is trading most right now on sol, bsc, base, eth, monad or tron. Take `address` into token_detail, token_trades, token_holders or token_candles.

tools.name: Wallet profile
tools.description: Profile a wallet from wallet_rank, token_holders, token_trades or a gmgn.ai address URL.

tools.name: Wallet rank
tools.description: Find top-performing wallets to inspect with wallet_profile or dev_created_tokens.

tools.name: Course detail
tools.description: Details for one `facility_id`. Two page fetches; no availability (use `facility_tee_times`).

tools.name: Course reviews
tools.description: Read what golfers wrote about a course. Only reviews left on GolfNow itself; the larger GolfPass review count on course records is a different corpus.

tools.name: Courses near
tools.description: Discover courses near a place (coordinates from `suggest_locations`); then call `facility_tee_times` with a `facility_id`.

tools.name: Facility day summaries
tools.description: Pick a day before calling `facility_tee_times`; up to 31 days per call.

tools.name: Facility tee times
tools.description: Availability and displayed prices for a known `facility_id` on one day. Discovery only: nothing is held or booked.

tools.name: Search courses
tools.description: Find a `facility_id` from a course name; every id-keyed function needs one.

tools.name: Suggest locations
tools.description: Turn a place name into latitude/longitude for `courses_near`.

tools.name: Tee time rates
tools.description: Expand `has_more_rates` on a `facility_tee_times` row. Without `tee_time_id`, the first tee time of `date` for `players` is used.

tools.name: Detail
tools.description: Full Grants.gov opportunity record by stable numeric ID: eligibility, funding amounts, deadlines, amendments, attachments. Always a live lookup.

tools.name: Facets
tools.description: Filter vocabularies with live hit counts: statuses, agency codes (with sub-agencies), eligibility codes, funding categories and instruments.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Search Grants.gov funding opportunities by keyword, agency, status, eligibility, funding category, assistance listing and posted-date window; one page of summary records (or full records with expand).

tools.name: Board
tools.description: To confirm a board token exists on Greenhouse and read the employer's name and blurb before listing its openings with jobs or search.

tools.name: Departments
tools.description: To discover department ids for search or to see how openings spread across departments.

tools.name: Job
tools.description: When you have a job post id from jobs or search, or a pasted job page URL, and need the description, departments or application questions.

tools.name: Jobs
tools.description: Start here with a board token to enumerate every opening with id, title, location, requisition id, dates and the public job URL. Pass next_page back as page. Use search for the board's own server-side keyword, department and office filters, and job for descriptions and application questions.

tools.name: Offices
tools.description: To discover office ids for search or to see where an employer is hiring.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: When you need Greenhouse's own keyword search or a department/office filter, or the department of each post. Ids for department_id and office_id come from this function's departments/offices lists or from the departments and offices functions.

tools.name: Check availability
tools.description: After search_inventory, to confirm a vehicle is still available before pointing a user at it, or to get a payment estimate.

tools.name: Get vehicle
tools.description: After search_inventory or suggest_inventory, or when the user pastes a hertzcarsales.com/used/... or /rent2buy/... URL or a VIN.

tools.name: List facets
tools.description: To discover what exists before searching (which makes, which states have stores, the price range), or to narrow a large result set.

tools.name: Search inventory
tools.description: Start here to find vehicles; pass next_cursor back as cursor for the following page. Use list_facets to see which makes, models, states and ranges exist.

tools.name: Suggest inventory
tools.description: To turn a user's phrase into make/model facets for search_inventory, or for a quick first look at matching cars.

tools.name: Auction
tools.description: After `search_auctions` or `search_lots`, or when given a hibid.com/catalog/{id} URL. Use `search_lots` with auction_id for the lots.

tools.name: Auctioneers
tools.description: To find an auctioneer_id for `search_auctions`, or to resolve an auctioneer subdomain (its site id) to the company record.

tools.name: Lot
tools.description: After `search_lots`, or when given a hibid.com/lot/{id} URL.

tools.name: Lot bids
tools.description: To see how a lot is being bid on. Bidder names are masked by HiBid; this function does not place bids.

tools.name: Search auctions
tools.description: To find auction ids for `auction` and `search_lots` (catalog listing), to list one auctioneer's auctions (auctioneer_id, e.g. 87212 for citadelgalleryauctions.hibid.com), or to find past auctions (archived=true with date_start/date_end).

tools.name: Search lots
tools.description: Start here to find lot ids (for `lot` and `lot_bids`) and auction ids, or to list one auction's catalog (auction_id, sort LOT_NUMBER). For sold prices of a past auction pass archived=true with its auction_id.

tools.name: Autocomplete
tools.description: Turn a place name into coordinates for search_lands, or find a land or public campground by name.

tools.name: Land
tools.description: After search_lands or a pasted hipcamp.com/land URL. For dated availability and full quotes call land_sites.

tools.name: Land calendar
tools.description: Calendar view of what is already booked or closed for a land or a single site.

tools.name: Land reviews
tools.description: Read reviews for a land from search_lands or land; pass next_cursor to continue.

tools.name: Land sites
tools.description: Dated availability check and price breakdown for a land found by search_lands or land.

tools.name: Public campground availability
tools.description: After autocomplete returns a campground_public result; pass its numeric id.

tools.name: Search lands
tools.description: Start here to find lands near a place; use autocomplete first to turn a place name into coordinates. Feed masked_id into land, land_sites, land_calendar and land_reviews.

tools.name: Profile
tools.description: Read a public Houzz professional profile, source review aggregate, advertised services and service areas. No review text, contact actions or licensing verification.

tools.name: Projects
tools.description: Read the initial portfolio project summaries embedded in a public professional profile, with photo counts and source location. This is a partial subset, not complete project detail.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Read one page of Houzz professionals from an explicit location directory URL. Results may include sponsored or nonlocal providers. Follow next_url (15-step offsets, maximum 735).

tools.name: Get image vulnerability summary
tools.description: Check how many known vulnerabilities a specific image digest carries before pulling it; pair with `get_tag` to go from a tag name to its per-architecture digests.

tools.name: Get namespace
tools.description: Identify who publishes an image (organization vs. individual, company, website) from the namespace in a repository name.

tools.name: Get repository
tools.description: Read one image's metadata and README after finding it with `search_images`, or when the user gives a Docker Hub repository name or URL.

tools.name: Get tag
tools.description: Resolve a tag such as `latest` to its digests and supported architectures, or check when a specific tag was last pushed.

tools.name: List categories
tools.description: Look up the category slug to filter a search by, or show the available categories.

tools.name: List namespace repositories
tools.description: Enumerate everything a publisher ships (e.g. all `grafana/*` images or all official images) before reading individual repositories.

tools.name: List tags
tools.description: List or filter the tags of an image, see which architectures each tag supports and when it was last pushed, and pick a tag or digest for `get_tag` or `get_image_vulnerability_summary`.

tools.name: Search images
tools.description: Find container images by name or words before reading a repository or its tags; filter to official images, a CPU architecture or a category.

tools.name: Card
tools.description: The README model or dataset card of one repository at a revision: raw YAML front matter, markdown body, section headings, word count and the Hub's parsed card data, plus license and gating. Works for gated repositories; `has_card` is false when the repository has no README.

tools.name: Dataset
tools.description: One dataset repository: canonical id, author, license(s), task categories, languages, size categories, 30-day and all-time downloads, likes, gating, tags, description, citation, file list, configs, dataset_info (features and splits) and the parsed dataset-card front matter.

tools.name: Datasets
tools.description: Search and list datasets by free text, author, task category, language, license, size category and tags, sorted by downloads, likes, trending, last modified or created; up to 100 per page with an opaque cursor. Each result carries license, downloads, likes, task categories, size and gating.

tools.name: Model
tools.description: One model repository: canonical id, author, license(s), pipeline tag, library, 30-day and all-time downloads, likes, trending score, gating, tags, languages, base models, training datasets, file list, safetensors parameter counts, config architecture, inference providers and the parsed model-card front matter.

tools.name: Models
tools.description: Search and list models by free text, author, task (pipeline tag), library, language, license and tags, sorted by downloads, likes, trending, last modified or created; up to 100 per page with an opaque cursor for the next page. Each result carries license, downloads, likes, gating and tags.

tools.name: Account
tools.description: Positions and liquidation prices for a trader, sub-account or vault address (from recent_trades users, account_fills or a vault). An address the chain has never seen is not_found; an empty account is a success with no positions.

tools.name: Account fills
tools.description: Trade and liquidation history for an address. Give start_time (unix ms) and optionally end_time; follow next_cursor as cursor. This is the only per-event liquidation record in the public API.

tools.name: Account funding
tools.description: Realized funding for a trader or vault. Give start_time and optionally end_time; follow next_cursor as cursor.

tools.name: Account ledger
tools.description: Money movements and liquidation ledger entries for an address. Give start_time and optionally end_time; follow next_cursor as cursor.

tools.name: Candles
tools.description: Price history for a coin from markets. Intervals: 1m 3m 5m 15m 30m 1h 2h 4h 8h 12h 1d 3d 1w 1M. Follow next_cursor as cursor for more.

tools.name: Exchange stats
tools.description: A quick health and size read of the exchange; the at-cap list tells which markets cannot take new open interest right now.

tools.name: Funding history
tools.description: Historical funding for a coin from markets. Give start_time (unix ms) and optionally end_time; follow next_cursor as cursor until page.continuation is exhausted.

tools.name: Markets
tools.description: Start here to discover coin identifiers and read live funding and open interest. Pass dex for a HIP-3 builder dex (from a dex-prefixed coin such as xyz:TSLA). Pass coin to get one market. History is in funding_history and candles.

tools.name: Order book
tools.description: Current liquidity for a coin from markets. n_sig_figs (2-5) aggregates levels to fewer significant figures.

tools.name: Predicted fundings
tools.description: Compare upcoming funding across venues or fetch the next Hyperliquid funding for all coins in one call. Pass coin to filter to one market.

tools.name: Recent trades
tools.description: Latest prints for a coin from markets. For a user's own fills use account_fills.

tools.name: Vault
tools.description: Look up a vault such as HLP by its address. Set include_followers for the depositor list.

tools.name: Job
tools.description: When you have a posting id from search or a pasted https://<portal>.icims.com/jobs/<id>/... URL.

tools.name: Portal
tools.description: To discover filter ids for search or to check that a portal exists and still serves listings on icims.com.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Start here with a portal subdomain (or a pasted .icims.com/jobs/search URL). Pass next_page back as page to paginate; use job for the full posting.

tools.name: Icon collection
tools.description: Get the collection's icon count, available categories and platforms with counts, methodology and rights notice. Each call costs 5 credits.

tools.name: Icon details
tools.description: Read one icon using its ID from search, including image dimensions, source links and an agent-ready Markdown reference. Each call costs 5 credits.

tools.name: Search icons
tools.description: Find app icons by app name or a description such as purple icons or animal icon. Filter by category or platform. Default sort ranks query matches first. Each call costs 5 credits.

tools.name: Countries
tools.description: IEA country name to ISO3 crosswalk (from api.iea.org/countries) with aggregates flagged: World, OECD Total/Europe/Americas/Asia Oceania, IEA Total, EU27, Africa, Asia, China including Hong Kong, Eurasia. Each entry lists the stats code, the Monthly Electricity Statistics display name and the prices code it maps to, plus every alias `data` accepts.

tools.name: Data
tools.description: Observations from one free IEA dataset for the given countries (ISO3 or IEA names, required, up to 50), optionally filtered by products, flows (balance flows or price sectors), indicators (data-browser indicators such as TFCbySource, ElecGenByFuel, CO2BySector) and year range; paged with an opaque cursor over a deterministic ordering. Values are decimal strings with the source unit; null values stay null. Paid and non-CC dataset ids fail with license_restricted and the product/purchase page.

tools.name: Dataset
tools.description: One dataset's metadata with a live probe of api.iea.org: year_min/year_max actually served, last_updated (MES latest published month or prices updated_at), coverage count, license, endpoint and cadence. Refused datasets are described but flagged.

tools.name: Datasets
tools.description: Catalog of IEA datasets: every free CC BY 4.0 dataset served by api.iea.org (energy balances, electricity and heat, oil, gas, CO2 from fuel combustion, monthly electricity statistics, energy prices, monthly oil prices) plus the paid and account-gated products that `data` refuses, each with its license. No network call; `last_updated` is null here and probed live by `dataset`.

tools.name: Hierarchy children
tools.description: Traverse one level down a hierarchy: the direct children of a cause, location or rei node (e.g. GBD region Western Europe to its 24 countries), plus the parent node and its ancestors.

tools.name: Entity lookup
tools.description: Resolve one entity (cause, location, age, sex, measure, metric or rei) by GBD id in a GBD round: its hierarchy_node record plus ancestors (root first) and direct children.

tools.name: Hierarchy page
tools.description: One page of hierarchy_node records for an entity type (cause, location, age, sex, measure, metric, rei) in a GBD round: id, name, parent_id, level, tree placement and the raw source entry. Tree types come in depth-first hierarchy order; page with cursor until next_cursor is null.

tools.name: Release versions
tools.description: List the GBD Results tool release versions (version id, GBD round, release stamp, model description, exposed measure ids) for one or both supported rounds. Use it to pin gbd_round/version_id and read the tool's stated release date.

tools.name: Discover
tools.description: Discover product cards on the first page of an IKEA category in any IKEA market on www.ikea.com (/{country}/{language}/ storefronts such as /us/en/, /gb/en/, /de/de/, /ae/ar/ or /jp/ja/), with prices in that market's currency. Partial collection only; no filtering or pagination. Follow a returned product URL for detail.

tools.name: Materials care
tools.description: Read component materials and care instructions of an IKEA product in any IKEA market on www.ikea.com (/{country}/{language}/ storefronts such as /us/en/, /gb/en/, /de/de/, /ae/ar/ or /jp/ja/), in the storefront's language.

tools.name: Product
tools.description: Read an IKEA product article in any IKEA market on www.ikea.com (/{country}/{language}/ storefronts such as /us/en/, /gb/en/, /de/de/, /ae/ar/ or /jp/ja/): advertised price and the currency the page publishes, dimensions, color and aggregate rating. Store stock and delivery availability remain unknown.

tools.name: Reviews
tools.description: Read review excerpts embedded on an IKEA product page in any IKEA market on www.ikea.com (/{country}/{language}/ storefronts such as /us/en/, /gb/en/, /de/de/, /ae/ar/ or /jp/ja/). These may cover a product family rather than only the selected color; no pagination or exhaustive review history.

tools.name: Safety documents
tools.description: Read IKEA product safety warnings and links to assembly or care PDFs in any IKEA market on www.ikea.com (/{country}/{language}/ storefronts such as /us/en/, /gb/en/, /de/de/, /ae/ar/ or /jp/ja/). Document contents are not fetched.

tools.name: Variants
tools.description: Read source-linked color/style alternatives of an IKEA product in any IKEA market on www.ikea.com (/{country}/{language}/ storefronts such as /us/en/, /gb/en/, /de/de/, /ae/ar/ or /jp/ja/). Links stay in the same market; partial alternatives only, so fetch each returned URL for its own article and price.

tools.name: Employer
tools.description: Employer research after search or job returned an employer key or url. Prefer employer_key (solver-free, one GraphQL call); unknown keys and slugs return not_found.

tools.name: Job
tools.description: After search, or when you hold a viewjob?jk= or rc/clk?jk= URL. Removed postings return not_found.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Start here to find job_key values; pass the same filters plus next_cursor to page. No total count is exposed by Indeed; next_cursor=null is the end.

tools.name: Get equipment preview
tools.description: Fetch what the site exposes anonymously for an item found with `list_equipment` or `list_auction_lots`.

tools.name: List auction lots
tools.description: List the lots of an auction found with `list_upcoming_auctions`.

tools.name: List equipment
