tools.description: Browse or filter equipment for sale by category or make; discover filter values via `include_facets`; paginate with `continuation`.

tools.name: List upcoming auctions
tools.description: Find the sale group ids of upcoming online auctions before listing their lots.

tools.name: Suggest
tools.description: Turn a free-text equipment keyword into the category slug / make filter that `list_equipment` needs.

tools.name: Get part
tools.description: After search_parts, or when the caller already has a C-number, MPN or a JLCPCB part URL.

tools.name: List categories
tools.description: Discover category names and ids before a category search.

tools.name: Search parts
tools.description: Find candidate parts for a keyword, part number or category; page through a category; then call get_part with a returned component_code for the full detail.

tools.name: Suggest parts
tools.description: Expand a partial part number or keyword before a search.

tools.name: Categories
tools.description: To find category ids for jobs, or to name the category ids in jobs aggregations.

tools.name: Company
tools.description: To resolve an employer slug (the segment after join.com/companies/) to its numeric company id and city ids before listing jobs, or to read the employer's benefits and offices.

tools.name: Job
tools.description: When you have a job id or last_id from jobs, or a pasted ad URL (join.com/companies/<slug>/<id_param> or join.com/jobs/<last_id>), and need the description, salary, hours, vacation or contract terms.

tools.name: Jobs
tools.description: Start here with an employer slug (or company_id from company) to enumerate its openings; pass next_page back as page. Use category_ids from categories or this function's aggregations, city_id from company offices or aggregations. There is no keyword search on JOIN.

tools.name: Browse titles
tools.description: Catalog questions such as 'top Netflix movies in Germany' or 'what is streaming free in the UK'. Provider short names come from `providers`.

tools.name: New titles
tools.description: 'What came to Netflix in the US today', 'what arrives on Apple TV next week'. Dates are the catalog dates JustWatch publishes; page through with `cursor`.

tools.name: Providers
tools.description: To pick provider short names for browse_titles and new_titles, or to list a country's streaming services.

tools.name: Search titles
tools.description: Start here to find a title id (tm…/ts…) or to check IMDb/TMDB ids; use title_offers for several countries at once and title_detail for the full record.

tools.name: Season episodes
tools.description: With a tss… season id from title_detail `seasons`. Paginate with `offset` when a season has more than `limit` episodes.

tools.name: Title detail
tools.description: After search_titles, or with a pasted justwatch.com URL. For offers in several countries use title_offers; for episodes use season_episodes with a season id from `seasons`.

tools.name: Title offers
tools.description: The issue's core question: where can this movie or show be watched, per country. Pass `countries` for a multi-market comparison; one request serves every market.

tools.name: Book value
tools.description: Kelley Blue Book value for one vehicle: make, model, year, trim (slug from `trims`, or KBB vehicle_id), mileage and condition. Returns the selected trade-in or private-party value with its KBB range, all four condition values for both price types, typical mileage and the ZIP/edition the values are valid for.

tools.name: Listing
tools.description: One kbb.com listing by its numeric listing id (from `listings`): full description, features, every photo URL, seller address and rating, warranties, price history and KBB Fair Purchase Price. Expired or unknown ids are an error.

tools.name: Listings
tools.description: Search kbb.com dealer and private-seller inventory for a make (optionally model and trim) within a radius of a US ZIP code, optionally filtered by year, price, maximum mileage, exterior colour and drivetrain. Returns one page of 25 listings with price, KBB Fair Purchase Price and deal rating, mileage, VIN, seller and distance, plus the total match count for pagination.

tools.name: Trims
tools.description: Every trim kbb.com prices for a model year (make, model, year): KBB vehicle id, trim slug for `book_value`, Fair Purchase Price, typical-mileage trade-in and private-party values, engine, drivetrain and EPA figures, plus the model year's depreciation history and forecast.

tools.name: Get project
tools.description: Full detail, reward tiers and add-ons for a project found with search_projects or suggest_projects, or from a pasted kickstarter.com/projects URL.

tools.name: Get project stats
tools.description: Refresh backers and pledged totals for a known project without re-reading the full page.

tools.name: List categories
tools.description: Find category ids and tag slugs for search_projects.

tools.name: Search locations
tools.description: Turn a city or region name into a `woe_id` before filtering search_projects by location.

tools.name: Search projects
tools.description: Discover projects before fetching one with get_project. Use list_categories for category ids and search_locations for woe_ids.

tools.name: Suggest projects
tools.description: Resolve a project name to its id, creator and slug quickly; prefer search_projects for filtered, paginated discovery.

tools.name: Get gazette issue
tools.description: After list_gazette_issues. Part 2 is the fastest signal of regulations filed after a consolidation date: compare the AR numbers with get_legislation's consolidated_up_to.

tools.name: Get legislation
tools.description: After search_legislation. Use the ISBN of a '(Download Version)' record. Pass `section` (e.g. '25' or '23.1') for a single section; without it every section of the title is returned (acts can run to hundreds of sections).

tools.name: List gazette issues
tools.description: To find which Gazette issues exist for a year and their ordinals before get_gazette_issue, or to get the Index of Regulations URL for the year.

tools.name: Search legislation
tools.description: Start here to find the ISBN of an act or regulation. Pass `query` for title words (POST keyword search; the site matches title words, not full text) or `citation` for an exact chapter/regulation number such as '14/1997' (regulation) or 'E-9 RSA 2000' (act).

tools.name: Browse catalog
tools.description: Browsing the catalogue top-down when no search term is known; traversing to the article groups of a branch.

tools.name: Get article
tools.description: Full details for an article number returned by search_articles or list_group_articles, or for a pasted landefeld.de article URL.

tools.name: List group articles
tools.description: Listing or filtering the variants of a group id from search_groups, browse_catalog or get_article (e.g. `KH14BE`), e.g. all ball valves of this series with thread `Rp 1/2"`.

tools.name: Search articles
tools.description: Finding a concrete article from a part number or number fragment, e.g. `KH 14 B E` or `KH 14`. Also works for designation words but the full-text search (search_groups) is the better entry for those.

tools.name: Search groups
tools.description: Finding where a kind of part lives in the catalogue from a German description, e.g. `Kugelhahn`, `Steckverschraubung`. For part numbers use search_articles.

tools.name: Suggest
tools.description: Autocomplete, or discovering the shop's vocabulary before a search_groups call.

tools.name: Get client
tools.description: You have a client_id and need that client record and its registrant.

tools.name: Get contribution report
tools.description: You have an LD-203 report UUID or link and need its itemized contributions.

tools.name: Get filing
tools.description: You have a filing UUID or an lda.gov filing link and need its full contents.

tools.name: Get registrant
tools.description: You have a registrant_id and need the registrant's record.

tools.name: Search clients
tools.description: Find which firms lobby for a company, or resolve a client to client_id values for search_filings.

tools.name: Search contributions
tools.description: Which members of Congress a lobbyist or firm gave to, contributions to a campaign committee by registered lobbyists, a firm's PAC giving.

tools.name: Search filings
tools.description: Who lobbies for a company or on an issue, how much a client paid a firm in a year, which firms or lobbyists worked a bill topic.

tools.name: Search registrants
tools.description: Resolve a lobbying firm or in-house organization to its registrant_id before searching filings or contributions.

tools.name: Bill
tools.description: You have a bill_id (from bill_search or the site) and need what the bill says.

tools.name: Bill history
tools.description: You have a bill_id and need the full procedural history rather than the last five actions bill_status returns.

tools.name: Bill search
tools.description: You need bills about a topic in a given session; take bill_id from a result into bill, bill_status, bill_history or bill_votes.

tools.name: Bill status
tools.description: You have a bill_id and need where the bill is now, who carries it, and how it is classified.

tools.name: Bill votes
tools.description: You have a bill_id and need who voted how. A bill with no recorded votes returns an empty list.

tools.name: Code article
tools.description: You have a hierarchy node from code_toc (or the hierarchy of a code_section) and need all sections under it.

tools.name: Code section
tools.description: You know the statute citation (e.g. Code of Civil Procedure section 2031.310) and need its current text.

tools.name: Code toc
tools.description: You need to browse or enumerate a code, or find the article that holds a section range before calling code_article.

tools.name: Get contents
tools.description: To navigate an Act before `get_provision`: find the section numbers under a heading (e.g. the thresholds in Part 3 of the Planning Act 2008).

tools.name: Get provision
tools.description: To read statute text: e.g. Planning Act 2008 s.14 (nationally significant infrastructure project definitions) or ss.15-30 (thresholds), or Part 3 in one call.

tools.name: List changes
tools.description: To see amendments, repeals and commencements touching an Act (e.g. what the Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025 changed in the Planning Act 2008) and whether they are applied in the current text yet.

tools.name: Lookup identifier
tools.description: When you have an exact or near-exact title and need the `type`/`year`/`number` key; use `search_legislation` for word searches and paging.

tools.name: Search legislation
tools.description: Start here to find the `type`/`year`/`number` of an Act or instrument by title or subject words before calling `get_contents`, `get_provision` or `list_changes`.

tools.name: Browse films
tools.description: Discover films and collect many average ratings without a fixed URL list. `page` continues where the previous call stopped (`next_page`). Only the popular sort is supported.

tools.name: Film
tools.description: Pass a Letterboxd film URL or boxd.it link (`url`), a slug (`slug`), a boxd.it id (`lid`), a TMDB id (`tmdb_id`) or an IMDb id (`imdb_id`); exactly one. For many films at once use ratings_bulk; for the histogram and watched/list/like counts use film_ratings; for member reviews use reviews (sort `popular` is the film page's Popular reviews strip); for lists use lists.

tools.name: Film ratings
tools.description: Pass `film` as a slug (parasite-2019), a Letterboxd film URL or a boxd.it link. Lighter than `film` (two small fragments instead of the full page); use `film` for identity, credits and metadata.

tools.name: List entries
tools.description: Pass a list `url` (as returned by lists[].url, /detail/ and /page/n/ suffixes tolerated) or `owner` + `slug`. Page with `page`.

tools.name: Lists
tools.description: Which curated lists a film appears in: pass `film` (slug, Letterboxd URL or boxd.it link), `tmdb_id` or `imdb_id`, pick a `sort` and page through with `page`.

tools.name: Ratings bulk
tools.description: Bulk extraction of Letterboxd average ratings from a list of film URLs, boxd.it links or slugs. Items are fetched concurrently on one proxy session.

tools.name: Review comments
tools.description: Pass `review_id` (the viewing id returned by reviews) or the review page `url` (https://letterboxd.com/<member>/film/<slug>/). Page with `start` and `limit` (max 100).

tools.name: Reviews
tools.description: What members think of a film, beyond the average: pass `film` (slug, Letterboxd URL or boxd.it link), `tmdb_id` or `imdb_id`, pick a `sort` and page through with `page`. For the thread under one review use review_comments.

tools.name: Search films
tools.description: Find the Letterboxd slug or URL for a title before calling film, film_ratings or ratings_bulk. Pass `cursor` from the previous page to continue.

tools.name: Get custom pizza options
tools.description: Build-your-own pricing and the complete topping catalogue for a store. Pass `crust_id` to keep the answer small; the whole menu is about 100 KB upstream.

tools.name: Get deals
tools.description: Deals and promo codes; combine with `dma_code` from `search_stores`/`get_store` or pass `zip`. Not store-scoped menu prices: use `get_menu` for those.

tools.name: Get menu
tools.description: Menu listing for a store from `search_stores`. Prices and the item set differ per store and per service method; there is no national menu. Follow with `get_menu_item` for modifiers and toppings.

tools.name: Get menu item
tools.description: Modifiers for an `item_id` from `get_menu` (items with `has_customizations` true carry options or toppings).

tools.name: Get ordering hours
tools.description: Availability of a store for a service method; an empty day list for an existing store means it is not taking orders.

tools.name: Get store
tools.description: After `search_stores`, or when the caller already knows the store number from a littlecaesars.com/en-us/store/{n}/ URL.

tools.name: Search stores
tools.description: Start here to get a `location_number`; every menu function needs one.

tools.name: Directions
tools.description: Routes between two addresses, place names, or coordinate pairs. Modes: driving (default), walking, bicycling, transit. Returns route alternatives with distances, estimated durations and ordered instructions. Transit includes walking connections, line and stop details, transfers, service alerts, scheduled times and estimates when supplied. Uses the current departure time; no date/time selection, intermediate waypoints, fares, or live navigation. Availability depends on coverage. An explicit no-route response returns routes: [].

tools.name: Rating trend
tools.description: Monthly rating trend for one business from its newest 60 reviews (one request): per calendar month the review count, average rating and owner responses, plus the same summary as reviews. Months are UTC; the sample never goes beyond 60 reviews.

tools.name: Reviews
tools.description: Public reviews for one business identified by its Maps feature_id (0x..:0x.., from search or a Maps URL). One request returns 1 to 60 reviews in the chosen order with rating, timestamp, text, images and the owner's response, plus a summary with the owner response rate over the returned sample.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Find businesses on Maps by free-text query (name and/or 'category in city'). Returns up to 20 places with feature_id (input for reviews/rating_trend), place_id, categories, address, coordinates, aggregate rating, review count, phone and website.

tools.name: Deals
tools.description: For the Hot Deals / Value Menu / Catering Bundles categories, which menu lists without items. Defaults to the public, currently valid coupons.

tools.name: Item
tools.description: After menu, with an item_id from it, when the caller needs toppings and customization prices for one product.

tools.name: Menu
tools.description: After stores. Omit category for the whole menu (about 100 items), or pass a category id or name for a slice. Deal categories hold coupons, not items: read them with deals.

tools.name: Store
tools.description: One Marco's Pizza store by store key: identity, address, coordinates, weekly hours, order types with delivery charge and minimum, delivery ZIPs and cities, delivery zones and holiday schedule, from the store's published data file.

tools.name: Stores
tools.description: Start here to find a store_key; menu, item, deals, store and wait_times need one. The source publishes the whole location list in one page, so filtering, sorting by distance and paging happen in this program.

tools.name: Wait times
tools.description: Live availability for one store_key; the menu itself does not change with it.

tools.name: Address transactions
tools.description: Listing payments into or out of an address, finding when it first or last moved funds, or paging through its full history. Use `get_transaction` for one transaction's full inputs and outputs.

tools.name: Address utxos
tools.description: Seeing which coins an address can still spend, their sizes and ages. Use `get_address` for just the balance (it works for addresses of any size).

tools.name: Block transactions
tools.description: Listing what a block contains or finding its coinbase transaction. Use `get_transaction` for a row's full inputs and outputs.

tools.name: Blocks
tools.description: Seeing the latest blocks and current chain height, who mined recent blocks, or scanning a height range. Use `get_block` for one block's full header.

tools.name: Fees
tools.description: Choosing a fee rate for a new transaction or judging whether a pending transaction's fee rate will confirm soon.

tools.name: Get address
tools.description: Checking an address's balance or whether it has received or spent anything. Use `address_transactions` for its history and `address_utxos` for its spendable outputs.

tools.name: Get block
tools.description: Looking up a block's time, miner pool, fees or confirmations, or resolving a height to its hash. Use `block_transactions` for the transactions in it and `blocks` for recent blocks.

tools.name: Get transaction
tools.description: Checking whether a payment confirmed and how deeply, who paid whom and how much, or the fee a transaction paid. Use `transaction_outspends` to see which outputs were later spent and by which transaction.

tools.name: Mempool
tools.description: Gauging congestion: how many vbytes are queued above a given fee rate, or how large the backlog is.

tools.name: Transaction outspends
tools.description: Following funds forward: which transaction spent a given output, whether a payment's coins have moved, or which outputs of a transaction are still unspent.

tools.name: Get product
tools.description: One known product id (from search results, a SKU lookup or a microcenter.com/product/ URL). Pass store_id to get that store's price and inventory.

tools.name: Get reviews
tools.description: After search_products or get_product, when the review text, ratings or recommendation counts for a product id are needed.

tools.name: List stores
tools.description: To find the store_id for a city before calling search_products, lookup_by_sku or get_product.

tools.name: Lookup by sku
tools.description: You know the 6-digit SKU and need the current price/stock at a specific store. Use get_product for specs and reviews, search_products for discovery.

tools.name: Search products
tools.description: Discovery: find products by keyword or browse a category (e.g. "Graphics Cards|518") for a given store_id. Use lookup_by_sku for a known SKU and get_product for full details.

tools.name: Eu first port arrivals
tools.description: EU customs pre-arrival work: which MSC vessel/voyage enters the EU where and when, and the customs office code.

tools.name: List advisories
tools.description: Surcharges, service changes, port congestion notices and rate announcements MSC has published; paginate with `page` while `next_page` is not null.

tools.name: List ports
tools.description: Before search_sailing_schedule or port_arrivals_departures when you have a port name and need its MSC port id or UN/LOCODE.

tools.name: List vessels
tools.description: Find the IMO number for vessel_schedule from a vessel name, or check that a vessel is in MSC's schedule system.

tools.name: Port arrivals departures
tools.description: What MSC vessels are due at a port in the coming days; port codes come from list_ports or tracking events.

tools.name: Search sailing schedule
tools.description: Planning a shipment: which MSC sailings connect two ports from a date, how long they take and when cargo must be at the terminal.

tools.name: Track shipment
tools.description: Any 'where is my container / B/L' question. A container lookup returns its bill of lading number; look that up to get every sibling container on the same B/L.

tools.name: Vessel schedule
tools.description: Where a vessel is and where it calls next; IMO numbers come from list_vessels, tracking events or sailing schedules.

tools.name: Get record
tools.description: You have an id from search_records or list_folder and need the record's full header metadata, its reference number or its place in the hierarchy.

tools.name: List folder
tools.description: Enumerate the archive top-down (root -> collection -> sub-folders -> items) or list what sits inside a folder found by search_records or get_record; take child ids to get_record (items) or back to list_folder (folders).

tools.name: Search records
tools.description: Find archive records (magazines, photographs, reports, adverts, catalogues) by keyword, or list everything of one file format or reference number; take the returned `id` to get_record or, for folders, to list_folder.

tools.name: Get license complaints
tools.description: With a detail_id from search_licenses, to check for published complaints or discipline before the licensee detail.

tools.name: Get license detail
tools.description: After search_licenses, with a row's detail_id, for the full license record and current status.

tools.name: Get license relations
tools.description: With a detail_id from search_licenses, to see which business a contractor qualifies or who qualifies a business.

tools.name: Search licenses
tools.description: Start here to find a licensee and its detail_id; then call get_license_detail for the full record. Use license_number when you have it (fastest, usually 1-2 rows).

tools.name: Get job
tools.description: With a pasted Workday posting URL, or career_site plus an external_path from search_jobs.

tools.name: Search jobs
tools.description: Start here with any Workday career-site URL. Read `facets` to filter by location, job category, time type or remote type (parameters differ per employer), page with next_offset, then call get_job with a result's external_path or url for the full description.

tools.name: Auctions
tools.description: List currently running Namecheap Market auctions; optionally filter by TLD.

tools.name: Check domains
tools.description: You already know the exact names to check. For a keyword plus a set of extensions use search_domains.

tools.name: Marketplace listings
tools.description: See which registered names on a keyword are for sale and at what asking price. An empty list is a valid answer.

tools.name: Search domains
tools.description: Start here with a brand or keyword to see which extensions are free and what Namecheap displays for them.

tools.name: Tld pricing
tools.description: Compare extension prices or look up renewal/transfer cost for a TLD.

tools.name: Article
tools.description: Full text and the exact publish time of a story listed by any feed function. Costs one ~180 KB page fetch.

tools.name: Feed
tools.description: Publish times for the newest stories on a ticker or topic in one request. For older stories or more than 15 rows use `ticker_news` / `topic_news` and `article`.

tools.name: Latest headlines
tools.description: What is being published right now across the market, with no ticker or topic filter.

tools.name: Press releases
tools.description: Company announcements for one ticker (earnings dates, product launches, filings) rather than third-party coverage.

tools.name: Ticker news
tools.description: Latest third-party coverage of one stock or ETF. Official company announcements (deals, partnerships, earnings, launches) are press releases, which this feed omits: pass `include_press_releases: true` or call `press_releases`. For the exact publish time of any row pass its `url` to `article`; for only the 15 newest with times in one request use `feed`.

tools.name: Topic news
tools.description: Coverage of a theme (Markets, Stocks, Technology, Investing) rather than a ticker.

tools.name: Compare foods
tools.description: To compare a few nutrients across foods whose NEVO codes are known.

tools.name: Get food
tools.description: After search_foods returned a NEVO code, or when the code is known.

tools.name: List food groups
tools.description: To find the exact food_group value for search_foods.

tools.name: List nutrients
tools.description: To find nutrient tags for search_foods or compare_foods.

tools.name: Search foods
tools.description: Start here to find a NEVO code by food name or to list the foods of a group; pass the code to get_food for the full nutrient table or several codes to compare_foods.

tools.name: Open box
tools.description: Open-box availability on Newegg US for a model number or product keywords: the retailer's Open Box facet, only listings flagged open-box, each with price, in-stock flag and seller. An empty results list means no open-box units are listed right now.

tools.name: Product
tools.description: Live price and stock for one Newegg US item number (N82E16814932771, 14-932-771, open-box variant 14-932-771R, or marketplace 9SIB0GJKJ60641): displayed price, list price, instant savings, shipping, 30-day low, in-stock flag and quantity indicator, purchase limit, condition, seller, warranty and rating. Item numbers come from search or open_box.

tools.name: Reviews
tools.description: Every written customer review for a Newegg US item, 100 per page: rating, title, text, pros, cons, public display name, ISO submission time, purchased-from-Newegg flag, helpful votes and photo count, plus the item's review total and star distribution. Sort newest, helpful, highest_rating or lowest_rating; page with next_cursor until it is null. For incremental sync use sort newest and stop at the first known review_id, or pass since.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Search Newegg US by model number, SKU-like keyword or product name. Returns one page of listings with displayed price, in-stock flag, condition (new/open-box/refurbished), seller and model number. Filter by condition or in-stock, and follow next_page for more.

tools.name: Get license
tools.description: To verify a New Jersey license number: status, dates, status change reason and whether a public board action is on file.

tools.name: List professions
tools.description: Before a filtered search, to discover the exact profession and license-type names (for example which 15 license types the Nursing board issues).

tools.name: Search licenses
tools.description: To find a New Jersey licensee's license number and status by name, or to list the licensees of a profession / license type in a city; follow with get_license for the full record.

tools.name: Get arbitration award
tools.description: Read an award returned by list_arbitration_awards.

tools.name: Get fcm financials
tools.description: Track an FCM's adjusted net capital or customer segregated/secured/swap funds over time.

tools.name: Get profile
tools.description: Get the registration record behind an NFA ID returned by a search or lookup.

tools.name: Get regulatory action
tools.description: Read the detail of an action returned by list_regulatory_actions (nfa_id + case_ref + contributor).

tools.name: List arbitration awards
tools.description: List arbitration awards for a firm before reading one with get_arbitration_award.

tools.name: List pools
tools.description: List the pools a CPO found via search or profile operates.

tools.name: List regulatory actions
tools.description: List NFA, CFTC, exchange and foreign-regulator disciplinary actions against a firm or individual.

tools.name: List reparations
tools.description: List CFTC reparations cases naming a firm or individual.

tools.name: Lookup id
tools.description: You already have an NFA ID or pool id and want the name, status summary and profile URL, or need the encrypted id for a BASIC page link.

tools.name: Search firms
tools.description: Find a futures firm's NFA ID from its name, optionally narrowed by membership status, registration type or whether it has regulatory actions.

tools.name: Search individuals
tools.description: Find an associated person, principal or other registered individual and their NFA ID by name.

tools.name: Search pools
tools.description: Find a commodity pool and its CPO; optionally only current or only ceased pools.

tools.name: Game
tools.description: Follow up on a game id from `schedule`.

tools.name: Injury report
tools.description: The user wants the official practice participation or injury designations for a week (e.g. '2026 Week 3 injury report', 'Falcons practice report'). Defaults to the current league week.

tools.name: News
tools.description: The user wants recent official articles about a club or the league (e.g. dated team injury articles).

tools.name: Player
tools.description: Follow up on a player id from injury_report or team_roster.

tools.name: Schedule
tools.description: The user asks what games are on in a week, when a club plays, or the scores of a past week.

tools.name: Standings
tools.description: The user asks who leads a division, a club's record, or playoff clinches for a given week.

tools.name: Team roster
tools.description: The user asks for a team's roster, depth or who plays a position for a club.

tools.name: Teams
tools.description: Resolve a club name or abbreviation to its UUID before calling team_roster or injury_report, or list the league.

tools.name: Active storms
tools.description: Which hurricanes or tropical storms are active right now, where they are and how strong; the starting point for a storm's advisories (storm_advisory) or track (best_track).

tools.name: Best track
tools.description: Where did a storm go and how strong was it over time; track points for mapping or analysing a hurricane.

tools.name: Season storms
tools.description: Find a storm's ATCF id from its name and year (Helene 2024 is al092024), or list a season's storms.

tools.name: Storm advisory
tools.description: Read what NHC says about a storm: its current or a past public advisory, the forecaster's discussion, the forecast/advisory with forecast positions and wind radii, or wind speed probabilities for coastal locations.

tools.name: Storm products
tools.description: See which advisories exist for a storm before reading one with storm_advisory, or get links to its full advisory history.

tools.name: Tropical outlook
tools.description: Will a tropical cyclone form in the next 2 or 7 days? Which areas is NHC watching, and with what chance?

tools.name: Car seat inspection stations
tools.description: Find where a parent can have a child seat installation checked near a ZIP, or list a state's stations.

tools.name: Complaint
tools.description: You have an odi_number from vehicle_complaints and need that single record.

tools.name: Decode vin
tools.description: You have a VIN and need the NHTSA vehicle_id(s) to pull recalls or complaints, or the decoded year/make/model.

tools.name: Recall campaign
tools.description: You have a campaign number (e.g. from vehicle_recalls) and need the affected product list or the documents.

tools.name: Safety ratings
tools.description: Crash-test ratings for a year/make/model, or for the ncap_id returned by search_vehicles or decode_vin.

tools.name: Search vehicles
tools.description: Find the NHTSA vehicle_id for a year/make/model when you do not have a VIN, or list every trim/series variant.

tools.name: Vehicle complaints
tools.description: Review owner-reported problems for a year/make/model; pass next_offset to continue.

tools.name: Vehicle options
tools.description: Build a valid model_year/make/model before calling the recall or complaint functions.

tools.name: Vehicle recalls
tools.description: Dealer service or compliance lookups of recall campaigns for a year/make/model or a vehicle_id from decode_vin or search_vehicles.

tools.name: Availability
tools.description: Stock bands per size for one style/color or a product family; no exact inventory counts.

tools.name: Product
tools.description: One known style/color or a nike.com/t/ product URL. Use search for discovery, availability for stock only.

tools.name: Review summary
tools.description: Rating histogram and fit/comfort summary for a style; cheaper than paging reviews.

tools.name: Reviews
tools.description: One page of recent public reviews; use review_summary for the histogram, review_photos for images.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Search Nike US products with query or browse path. For the first page, provide query or path and optionally count (24, 50 or 100; default 24). For the next page, send next_cursor as cursor without query, path or count. Use product for one known style.

tools.name: Suggestions
tools.description: Autocomplete or popular searches; call before search when the query is uncertain.

tools.name: Get dealer
tools.description: You have a dealer_id from search_dealers, nearby_dealers or a nissanusa.com dealer URL.

tools.name: Get inventory vehicle
tools.description: You have a VIN from list_dealer_inventory (condition new). Certified pre-owned VINs are not served by this call.

tools.name: List dealer inventory
tools.description: Browse a dealer's public inventory. Pass dealer_id from search_dealers/nearby_dealers plus the dealer's coordinates; omit dealer_id to list inventory around the coordinates instead. Page with next_offset.

tools.name: Nearby dealers
tools.description: You already have coordinates and want the locator's own record (including hours) in one call. The source caps a call at 100 dealers; there is no paging.

tools.name: Search dealers
tools.description: The user supplies a place name or ZIP code. Returns dealer_id values for get_dealer and list_dealer_inventory. Sales hours are not in this feed; call get_dealer for them.

tools.name: Locations
tools.description: Practice locations for one 10-digit NPI: the primary practice location plus every secondary practice location NPPES lists, with phone/fax, and the mailing address separately. Same source record as provider, shaped for where-does-this-provider-practise questions.

tools.name: Provider
tools.description: Full NPPES record for one 10-digit NPI: entity type, name, credential, status, enumeration and update dates, all taxonomies (specialties) with the primary flagged, mailing and practice addresses, secondary practice locations, other/DBA names, Medicaid and payer identifiers, and health-information-exchange endpoints. An unknown NPI is a not_found error.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Search the CMS NPPES NPI Registry for healthcare providers (individuals or organizations) by name, organization, taxonomy/specialty, city, state, postal code or country. Returns one page (limit 1–200, skip up to 1200) of full provider records: NPI, taxonomies with licenses, mailing and practice addresses, other names, payer identifiers and endpoints. Requires at least one of first_name, last_name, organization_name, taxonomy_description or postal_code.

tools.name: Get download range
tools.description: Chart or trend a package's downloads day by day; periods up to 18 months per request.

tools.name: Get downloads
tools.description: Compare popularity of a few packages or get the weekly/monthly/yearly download total of one; use `get_download_range` for a daily series.

tools.name: Get package
tools.description: Look up an npm package by name or pasted npmjs.com URL: what it is, who maintains it, which versions exist and which tag points where. Use `get_package_version` for one version's dependencies and tarball.

tools.name: Get package version
tools.description: Resolve exactly what `name@version` (or `name@latest`, `name@next`) installs: its dependencies, engines, tarball and integrity hash.

tools.name: Get version downloads
tools.description: See which versions of a package are actually installed this week (major-version adoption, whether a deprecated line is still in use).

tools.name: List dependents
tools.description: Find who uses a package (recent adopters, plugins, wrappers); the total dependents count is in `search_packages` results.

tools.name: List owner packages
tools.description: List everything a maintainer or an organization publishes; provide exactly one of `user` or `org`.

tools.name: Search packages
tools.description: Find npm packages by words, keyword, author or scope before looking one up by name; the registry returns up to 250 hits per page and reports the total.

tools.name: Suggest packages
tools.description: Resolve a partial or misspelled package name to real package names quickly; use `search_packages` for full result pages.

tools.name: Cve
tools.description: You have a CVE id (CVE-2021-44228) or an nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail URL and need its severity, weakness, affected products, exploitation status or advisories.

tools.name: Recent
tools.description: Monitoring: what NVD published or changed recently, e.g. critical CVEs modified in the last day. Use `search` for fixed date ranges combined with product or weakness filters.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Find CVEs affecting a product or version (cpe_match cpe:2.3:a:apache:log4j:2.14.1), with a weakness (CWE-79), that are actively exploited (in_kev), or matching words. Use `cve` for a known id and its full CPE list and references.

tools.name: Layer metadata
tools.description: Compare embedding models on true context length and vector dimension, or inspect quantisation per tensor; the `layer_digest` is a model layer's `short_digest` from tag.

tools.name: Library models
tools.description: Enumerate official models (about 240) or filter them by a substring such as `embed`; community models are only reachable through search_models or namespace_models.

tools.name: Model
tools.description: Read a model found by search_models or library_models; use model_tags for every tag and tag for one tag's layers and exact byte sizes.

tools.name: Model tags
tools.description: Compare a model's variants (quantisations, parameter sizes) or pick the tag to pass to tag / layer_metadata.

tools.name: Namespace models
tools.description: List what a publisher has uploaded; the namespace comes from a search card's `namespace`.

tools.name: Search models
tools.description: Start here to find official and community models; take `namespace` and `model` from a card into model, model_tags and tag.

tools.name: Tag
tools.description: Get exact download bytes and layer digests for a tag; pass a model layer's `short_digest` to layer_metadata for GGUF metadata such as context_length and embedding_length.

tools.name: Get venue
tools.description: Resolve a venue id from list_venues or a `venue_id` from search results into its name, dates and public-submission policy, or check which venue ids to filter search results by. An unknown group id is `not_found`.

tools.name: List venues
tools.description: Discover the venue group id to pass as `venue` to the search functions or to get_venue, e.g. every ICLR venue with filter `ICLR.cc`. Titles and dates come from get_venue.

tools.name: Search replies
tools.description: Find public reviews or discussion that mention a topic, or read how a venue's reviewers rated papers on a subject. Review visibility is venue policy (ICLR publishes reviews; many venues keep them private). Replies cannot be filtered to one paper on this surface: the per-forum thread sits behind the Turnstile gate; group results client-side by `forum` instead.

tools.name: Search submissions
tools.description: Find papers by topic, title, author or keyword, or find the forum id and venue id behind a paper. Matching is full-text term matching, not exact phrase matching; a wildcard `*` matches nothing, so a venue's complete submission list cannot be browsed here. One paper by id and its review thread are behind the Turnstile gate and are not offered.

tools.name: Get docs page
tools.description: To read the typed Decisions API contract, confidence interpretation or any other OpenRouter guide without an API key. The index of all pages is `llms.txt`.

tools.name: Get model
tools.description: Verify that a model exists and see which providers serve it at what price; take `canonical_slug` from here into the permaslug-keyed functions.

tools.name: Get model endpoints
tools.description: After get_model, when you need endpoint UUIDs, rate limits, data policy or latency percentiles per provider.

tools.name: Get model pricing
tools.description: To answer 'what does this model cost today and has it changed' for a permaslug from search_models/get_model.

tools.name: Get model stats
tools.description: To judge whether a model is actively used and reliably available before building on it.

tools.name: List author models
tools.description: To enumerate a vendor's whole lineup (e.g. everything by `typesafe` or `openai`) with permaslugs for the stats functions.

tools.name: List providers
tools.description: To resolve a provider slug for search_models `providers=` or to review data policies across providers.

tools.name: Search models
tools.description: Start here to find a model slug and permaslug, e.g. `q=jev, output_modalities=decisions` to check whether the TypeSafe Jev decision model is listed; then call get_model / get_model_endpoints / get_model_pricing.

tools.name: Get dataset
tools.description: With a dataset name from list_datasets, search facets or an entity's data sources.

tools.name: Get entity
tools.description: After search_entities, with an entity_id. Accepts canonical ids (Q7747, NK-..., addr-...) and source identifiers (ofac-35096), which the site redirects to the canonical entity.

tools.name: List datasets
tools.description: To discover dataset names for search_entities (datasets / scope) and get_dataset.

tools.name: Search entities
tools.description: Start here to find an entity_id for get_entity, or to browse a dataset or program with filters only (no q).

tools.name: Changesets
tools.description: See who edited an area recently and with which tools; auditing a local copy.

tools.name: Element history
tools.description: Audit how an element changed over time, or find who last edited it.

tools.name: Geocode
tools.description: Start here to turn a place name (city, neighbourhood, street, POI) into OSM ids, coordinates, a bbox or a boundary polygon.

tools.name: Get element
tools.description: Detail for an id returned by `search_elements`, `geocode` or `map_bbox`; `full` for a way or boundary geometry.

tools.name: Get elements
tools.description: Refresh or deduplicate a batch of known ids (e.g. from a local database) in one call.

tools.name: Map bbox
tools.description: A complete dump of a block or plaza for a local database; for category queries over a larger area use `search_elements`.

tools.name: Notes
tools.description: Find open data-quality reports in an area before or after importing it.

tools.name: Reverse geocode
tools.description: You have a lat/lon and need the OSM object and address there.

tools.name: Search elements
tools.description: Category queries: all restaurants in a bbox, pharmacies inside a municipality relation, cafes within 500 m of a point, POIs inside a neighbourhood polygon from `geocode`.

tools.name: Get bid
tools.description: After search_bids or list_open_bids, to read a solicitation in full or to get its attachment download URLs. An unknown bid number is `not_found`; supplier-only pages (bid holder list, quotes) are not fetched.

tools.name: List open bids
tools.description: Enumerate everything currently open for responses without choosing a filter; follow `next_cursor` for later pages and pass a row's `bid_number` to get_bid.

tools.name: Search bids
tools.description: Find solicitations by keyword (description, item description, bid number, alternate id), organization, buyer, type code, status, category or opening-date window; pass a row's `bid_number` to get_bid. Use list_open_bids instead for the site's curated list of currently open solicitations. At least one criterion is required; a legitimate zero-row answer sets `total_count` to 0.

tools.name: Look up Instagram post or reel
tools.description: Resolve a canonical Instagram post/video URL against Oriane's index. Instagram uses the post shortcode; TikTok uses the numeric video ID. Empty results do not trigger ingestion. Choose projection: basic 20 credits, default 30 credits, full 40 credits per nonempty call. Search limit is at most 100; URL lookup targets one record. Empty results cost zero.

tools.name: Search Instagram posts and reels
tools.description: Search Oriane's indexed Instagram posts, captions and engagement. Platform is fixed to Instagram. Coverage and freshness depend on the existing index; this is not a complete live feed. Results include profileUrl; an empty result does not trigger ingestion. Choose projection: basic 20 credits, default 30 credits, full 40 credits per nonempty call. Search limit is at most 100; URL lookup targets one record. Empty results cost zero.

tools.name: Look up Instagram profile
tools.description: Pass a canonical Instagram profile URL to look up account details in Oriane's index. Returns profileUrl with each match. Short links and post URLs are unsupported; empty results do not trigger ingestion. Choose projection: basic 20 credits, default 30 credits, full 40 credits per nonempty call. Search limit is at most 100; URL lookup targets one record. Empty results cost zero.

tools.name: Search Instagram profiles
tools.description: Search Oriane's indexed Instagram profiles, bios and follower counts. Platform is fixed to Instagram. Coverage and freshness depend on the existing index; this is not a complete live feed. Results include profileUrl; an empty result does not trigger ingestion. Choose projection: basic 20 credits, default 30 credits, full 40 credits per nonempty call. Search limit is at most 100; URL lookup targets one record. Empty results cost zero.

tools.name: Search TikTok videos
tools.description: Search Oriane's indexed TikTok posts, captions and engagement. Platform is fixed to TikTok. Coverage and freshness depend on the existing index; this is not a complete live feed. Results include profileUrl; an empty result does not trigger ingestion. Choose projection: basic 20 credits, default 30 credits, full 40 credits per nonempty call. Search limit is at most 100; URL lookup targets one record. Empty results cost zero.

tools.name: Look up TikTok profile
tools.description: Pass a canonical TikTok profile URL to look up account details in Oriane's index. Returns profileUrl with each match. Short links and post URLs are unsupported; empty results do not trigger ingestion. Choose projection: basic 20 credits, default 30 credits, full 40 credits per nonempty call. Search limit is at most 100; URL lookup targets one record. Empty results cost zero.

tools.name: Search TikTok profiles
tools.description: Search Oriane's indexed TikTok profiles, bios and follower counts. Platform is fixed to TikTok. Coverage and freshness depend on the existing index; this is not a complete live feed. Results include profileUrl; an empty result does not trigger ingestion. Choose projection: basic 20 credits, default 30 credits, full 40 credits per nonempty call. Search limit is at most 100; URL lookup targets one record. Empty results cost zero.

tools.name: Look up TikTok video
tools.description: Resolve a canonical TikTok post/video URL against Oriane's index. Instagram uses the post shortcode; TikTok uses the numeric video ID. Empty results do not trigger ingestion. Choose projection: basic 20 credits, default 30 credits, full 40 credits per nonempty call. Search limit is at most 100; URL lookup targets one record. Empty results cost zero.

tools.name: Query
tools.description: "Is lodash 4.17.15 vulnerable?", "what should I upgrade to": one package at a time. Use query_batch for a dependency list and vuln for the full record of one id.

tools.name: Query batch
tools.description: Auditing a dependency list or lockfile: which of these packages at these versions have known vulnerabilities.

tools.name: Vuln
tools.description: Details of one vulnerability id from query or query_batch, or a CVE/GHSA someone mentions.

tools.name: Dependents
tools.description: How many packages depend on one version of a package (deps.dev total/direct/indirect; the default version unless one is named). For crates also crates.io's package-wide reverse-dependency count and a named sample.

tools.name: Daily downloads
tools.description: Daily download counts for one npm, PyPI or crates.io package as a series with 1/7/30-day sums; last-week, last-month or last-year (capped by what the source keeps). Maven Central has no download statistics.

tools.name: Package record
tools.description: One package's current record: latest version and publish time, description, license, homepage/repository/issues links, keywords, version count, a download summary (npm and PyPI last week/month; crates.io last week/month/90 days/total; Maven Central publishes none) and a dependent count.

tools.name: Version history
tools.description: A package's version history from deps.dev, newest first, with publish time, default flag and deprecation; paged with offset and limit. All four registries.

tools.name: Sponsors that appear together
tools.description: Use for who a sponsor shares ad breaks with: the advertisers that buy the same inventory.

tools.name: Company profile
tools.description: Use for the company record behind a sponsor, an entity or a companies/search hit. For its podcast advertising footprint use advertising/company/overview; for firmographics or funding, a company data provider is the better source.

tools.name: Company advertising profile
tools.description: Use for a company's podcast advertising footprint in one call, across all its brands. For the show list use advertising/company/shows.

tools.name: Company ad placements
tools.description: Use for the feed of a company's actual ad reads, episode by episode, to read or audit them.

tools.name: Shows a company could advertise on
tools.description: Use as a buy-side prospect list: where an advertiser could go next, with the shows it already buys as the reason.

tools.name: Shows carrying a company's ads
tools.description: Use for where a company advertises, ranked by volume, with the reads to sample. Pages are at most 24 rows.

tools.name: Ads in an episode
tools.description: Use for exactly who advertised in one episode, with the offer and where in the episode the read sits.

tools.name: Sponsor leaderboard
tools.description: Use for the biggest podcast advertisers overall, in a period, or on one network. For the top-ten snapshot use advertising/leaderboard/preview.

tools.name: Sponsor leaderboard, top ten
tools.description: Use for a quick read of who is spending most on podcasts this week and who is climbing. For deeper pages, other windows or filters use advertising/leaderboard.

tools.name: Publisher advertising profile
tools.description: Use for how a network is monetised and who buys across it. For its shows ranked by ad volume use advertising/publisher/shows.

tools.name: Shows of a publisher by ad volume
tools.description: Use for which of a network's shows carry the advertising. For the same catalogue by popularity use podcasts/publisher/shows.

tools.name: Sponsors of a publisher
tools.description: Use for who buys a network, and which of them buy it as a bundle: sort by podcast_coverage with a minimum.

tools.name: Publisher advertising leaderboard
tools.description: Use for which networks carry the most advertising, or monetise their catalogue most densely.

tools.name: Show advertising profile
tools.description: Use for who sponsors a show and how heavily it is monetised. For the full per-sponsor list use advertising/show/sponsors.

tools.name: Sponsors a show could pitch
tools.description: Use as a prospecting list for a show selling its own inventory: who buys shows like mine and has not bought me.

tools.name: Sponsors of a show
tools.description: Use for every advertiser on one show with counts and recency, or one company's brands on it. Set since and until on shows with extensive ad history to keep the query bounded.

tools.name: Sponsor profile
tools.description: Use to find who is buying advertising, or to go from a sponsor back to the company paying for it. For where it runs use advertising/sponsor/shows.

tools.name: Publishers a sponsor buys across
tools.description: Use to tell network buys from per-show buys: a sponsor at 60 to 100 percent coverage of several publishers is buying bundles.

tools.name: Ad reads of a sponsor
tools.description: Use to read the actual ad reads for a sponsor, then podcasts/segment/transcript for the words of one.

tools.name: Shows a sponsor buys
tools.description: Use for where an advertiser buys: the canonical footprint of one sponsor, or of a whole company across its brands.

tools.name: Sponsor directory
tools.description: Use to find a sponsor by name or by company and pick up its id. For the biggest spenders use advertising/leaderboard.

tools.name: Trending sponsors
tools.description: Use for which advertisers are ramping podcast spend right now, by airdate.

tools.name: Ad placements over time
tools.description: Use for how an advertiser's podcast spend trends by week or month, optionally on one show or network, and its host-read mix.

tools.name: Publisher bias profile
tools.description: Use for a network's political profile as a whole: how political its catalogue is and which way it leans.

tools.name: Analysed shows of a publisher
tools.description: Use to list a network's shows by political lean, or only the ones in a bucket.

tools.name: Publishers with shows in a bias bucket
tools.description: Use for which publishers carry the most shows of one lean: the flip of a publisher's own bias profile.

tools.name: Publisher bias leaderboard
tools.description: Use for which networks lean furthest left or right, are most political, or most ideologically diverse.

tools.name: Show bias analysis
tools.description: Use for where a show sits politically and why, with the evidence to quote. The bucket alone rides on every show record as bias.

tools.name: Entity chart edition
tools.description: Use for what podcasts are talking about most this week in one domain: the most-mentioned shows, films, games, teams or players, or the most-booked guests, with movement since last edition.

tools.name: Entity charts
tools.description: Use to see which charts exist (all, tv-series, movies, video-games, nfl, nba, guests and so on) and who leads each, before fetching one with charts/chart.

tools.name: Company competitors
tools.description: Use for a company's competitive set with the reason each one is on it, before comparing their podcast presence or advertising.

tools.name: Company profile links
tools.description: Use to get a company's handles, domain, CIK or ticker. The reverse, identifier to company, is entities/lookup.

tools.name: People at a company
tools.description: Use to find executives and role holders at a company, or the marketing, brand and partnerships contacts a sponsorship conversation would go to.

tools.name: Company products
tools.description: Use to see what a company sells, structured by segment and product line, for example to match an ad read's offer to a product.

tools.name: Company directory
tools.description: Use to resolve a company by name, ticker, domain, CIK or Wikidata QID to the slug every company capability takes. The record itself is advertising/company.

tools.name: Entity directory
tools.description: Use for the most-discussed entities overall, in one show, or of one kind, or to fetch several entities by slug at once. Takes no free text; for a name use entities/search.

tools.name: Entity lookup by external identifier
tools.description: Use when you hold a LinkedIn slug, a handle, a domain, a ticker or a CIK and need the Particle person or company: the reverse of the external-links capabilities.

tools.name: Entity record
tools.description: Use to resolve an entity slug to its record and its linked company or person. For where it was mentioned use podcasts/mentions (dialogue lines) or podcasts/episodes/list with entity_id (episodes).

tools.name: Entity search
tools.description: Use to turn what someone typed into a specific person, company or entity and its slug, before asking what was said about it with podcasts/mentions or filtering episodes by it. Searching episodes directly is better when the topic, not a name, is the question.

tools.name: Topic profile
tools.description: Use to place a topic in the taxonomy and see its neighbours. For the shows in it use podcasts/list with topic_id; for episodes, podcasts/episodes/list. This returns classification, not passages.

tools.name: Topics
tools.description: Use to find the topic_id that podcasts/search, podcasts/list and the guest capabilities filter on. Walk down from the roots by passing parent_id.

tools.name: Types
tools.description: Use to see what the type filter on entities/list can take. Skip it when listing without a filter.

tools.name: Person profile links
tools.description: Use to get a person's LinkedIn or social handles. The reverse, handle to person, is entities/lookup.

tools.name: Guest profile
tools.description: Use when the question is about someone as a podcast guest: how often they appear, where, and since when. For the episode list use people/guest/appearances.

tools.name: Guest appearances
tools.description: Use for where someone has appeared, episode by episode, to read what they said: take episode.id to podcasts/transcript with speaker set to their name.

tools.name: Shows a guest could appear on
tools.description: Use to build a pitch list for a guest: the shows most like the ones that already booked them, with the venues to cite.

tools.name: Shows a guest has appeared on
tools.description: Use for the set of shows behind a guest rather than the episodes: which shows book them and how often.

tools.name: Guest directory
tools.description: Use to find guests by name, by show, by topic or by how often they appear, and pick up the person slug. For who is currently making the rounds use people/guests/trending.

tools.name: Trending guests
tools.description: Use for who is doing the podcast circuit right now: a book launch, a product unveil, a news moment, or someone new. For a steady-state directory use people/guests.

tools.name: Person profile
tools.description: Use to go from a name on an episode to the person: who they are, where they work and worked, and their profile links. For their podcast appearances use people/guest.

tools.name: Guest roster of a show
tools.description: Use for who has been on a show and how often. For who it could book next use people/show-recommended-guests.

tools.name: Guests a show could book
tools.description: Use as a booking pipeline for a show: guests its peers chose that it has not had yet.

tools.name: Episode clip
tools.description: Use when a segment needs to be cited as a playable range rather than as text. For its words call podcasts/clip/transcript.

tools.name: Clip transcript
tools.description: Use to quote a clip verbatim with speaker labels, or export it as subtitles with format srt.

tools.name: Clip directory
tools.description: Use to browse quotable moments by show, speaker or kind. For clips about a subject, search episodes: matching clips ride inside each search result.

tools.name: Podcast episode
tools.description: Use episode.id from a search match to get the full record and, when available, its web URL or direct audio stream. Neither link is guaranteed. For what was said, fetch podcasts/transcript.

tools.name: Episode clips
tools.description: Use for the quotable moments of an episode as bounded, playable ranges with a kind and a speaker.

tools.name: Entities in an episode
tools.description: Use for what an episode was about in named things: the companies, people and products it discussed, ranked by salience. For where each one came up in the dialogue use podcasts/transcript/mentions.

tools.name: Related episodes
tools.description: Use for who else covered this: the same story or subject on other shows, optionally within a week of the episode.

tools.name: Episode segments
tools.description: Use to see the structure of an episode and pick the section to read: which time ranges are ads to skip, where the interview starts, what each discussion covers. Then podcasts/segment/transcript for the words.

tools.name: Episode speakers
tools.description: Use to find who was on an episode and in what role, with the person slug to follow into people/profile or people/guest. Ask for the advertiser role to see who voiced the sponsor reads.

tools.name: Episode topics
tools.description: Use to classify an episode by subject area, or to pick up a topic_id for filtering shows and episodes.

tools.name: Episode feed
tools.description: Use to poll for new episodes of a set of shows or topics as they are transcribed: a resumable, strictly ordered pull. A filter is required. For a one-off list by date use podcasts/episodes/list.

tools.name: Episode directory
tools.description: Use for episode-level filtering without dialogue: every episode a person spoke on, every episode featuring a company, a show's episodes in a date range, episodes in a language. When the question is about what was said, search episodes instead.

tools.name: Episode lookup by platform id
tools.description: Use when you hold a Spotify, Apple Podcasts or YouTube episode link, a platform episode id, or an RSS guid and need the Particle episode id to read its transcript. A transcript_status of transcribed means the transcript can be read now; requestable means it has not been transcribed yet. Guids match exactly as supplied.

tools.name: Episode search
tools.description: Use to find episodes that discussed something. This is the entry point: it returns ids the other podcast capabilities take. For every line about one person or company use podcasts/mentions instead.

tools.name: Episode counts over time
tools.description: Use for a trend rather than a list: how often a person appeared by month, how a show's output changed, how many episodes discussed a term each week. One call replaces paging the episode list per period.

tools.name: Show directory
tools.description: Use to browse shows by attribute rather than by name: a topic, a language, a brand-suitability tier, a length band, a cadence, an ad-free or interview format. For a name, podcasts/search is the canonical search.

tools.name: Show lookup by platform id
tools.description: Use when you already hold an Apple collection id, Spotify show id, YouTube channel id or RSS feed URL and need the Particle podcast deterministically. For a name, use podcasts/search.

tools.name: Dialogue mentions of an entity
tools.description: Use for every line of dialogue about one person or company across podcasts: the read-everything-about-X call. Resolve the subject with entities/search first. For dialogue by topic or exact phrase use podcasts/episodes/search.

tools.name: Mention counts over time
tools.description: Use for how mentions of a person or company trend by day, week or month, optionally within one show or network. One call instead of paging podcasts/mentions per period.

tools.name: Publisher profile
tools.description: Use to go from a show's publisher reference to the network record. For the network's shows call podcasts/publisher/shows; for its advertising, bias or suitability roll-ups use the capabilities under those concepts.

tools.name: Shows of a publisher
tools.description: Use to walk a network's catalogue by audience. For the same catalogue ranked by ad volume use advertising/publisher/shows.

tools.name: Publisher directory
tools.description: Use to find a network's slug by name before asking about its shows, advertising, bias or suitability.

tools.name: Show search
tools.description: Use to turn a show name into its slug and record. To find what was said inside one, search episodes instead: this matches show metadata, not transcripts. For an Apple, Spotify or YouTube id use podcasts/lookup.

tools.name: Episode segment
tools.description: Use to see what a matched segment is (an interview, a topic discussion, an ad) and its time range. For its text call podcasts/segment/transcript.

tools.name: Segment transcript
tools.description: Use to read the words of one segment in full and in order, at the price of a segment rather than an episode.

tools.name: Segment directory
tools.description: Use to pull one kind of section across a show: every interview, every ad read, every topic discussion in a date range. For one episode's structure use podcasts/episode/segments.

tools.name: Show profile
tools.description: Use when a search or an episode record gave you a podcast id and the full show record is needed, including the publisher to go up to and the slug every other show capability takes.

tools.name: Episodes of a show
tools.description: Use to get from a show to its episodes and their ids: the latest episode, an episode by title, or the run of episodes in a date range. A podcast slug is never an episode id; this is how you get one.

tools.name: Show platform links
tools.description: Use to get a show's Apple, Spotify or YouTube ids and links, its social handles, or its website. The reverse direction, platform id to show, is podcasts/lookup.

tools.name: Show format profile
tools.description: Use for the exact rates and distributions behind a show's format: how often it has guests, how long episodes run, how often it publishes and on which days. The compact form rides on every show record as format.

tools.name: Entity mentions in a show
tools.description: Use for how much one show talks about a person or company: an episode-level roll-up inside one podcast. For the dialogue lines themselves, across shows, use podcasts/mentions.

tools.name: Show ratings
tools.description: Use to read what listeners wrote about a show. For the averages and histogram use podcasts/show/ratings-summary.

tools.name: Show ratings summary
tools.description: Use for a show's average rating and count per storefront, plus the combined figure and what recent reviews say in aggregate.

tools.name: Related shows
tools.description: Use for shows like this one: competitive sets, a listener's next show, or the peer set a sponsor or guest pitch cites. Branch on band rather than on the raw score.

tools.name: Top-level topics by show count
tools.description: Use to see which subject areas have the most shows. For the full taxonomy tree use entities/topics; for the shows in one topic use podcasts/list with topic_id.

tools.name: Episode transcript
tools.description: Use to read a whole episode rather than the excerpt a search returned. For one passage, podcasts/segment/transcript is smaller and cheaper; for a moment, podcasts/transcript/preview.

tools.name: Entity mentions in a transcript
tools.description: Use to see exactly where and how a company, person or product was discussed within one episode, with the dialogue around each mention. Across episodes, use podcasts/mentions.

tools.name: Transcript excerpt at a moment
tools.description: Use to read what was being said at a timestamp, or the opening of an episode, at a fifth of the full transcript's price. For a whole episode use podcasts/transcript.

tools.name: Ranking categories
tools.description: Use to find the category_slug the chart capabilities take.

tools.name: Chart entries
tools.description: Use for today's chart: the US Apple overall top podcasts with no arguments, or a country and category. Use rankings/categories and rankings/countries for the valid slugs.

tools.name: Ranking countries
tools.description: Use to find the country codes the chart capabilities take.

tools.name: Chart slot history
tools.description: Use for how a chart looked on past days, or how one show moved within it. For one show across every chart use rankings/show/history.

tools.name: Chart movers
tools.description: Use for what debuted, climbed, fell or dropped off a chart since yesterday or over a window.

tools.name: Current rankings of a show
tools.description: Use for where a show charts today, everywhere it charts. For a one-number summary use rankings/show/summary.

tools.name: Ranking history of a show
tools.description: Use for a show's chart trajectory over time.

tools.name: Chart presence summary
tools.description: Use for how big a show is on the charts in one call: its best rank and how widely it charts.

tools.name: Ranking sources
tools.description: Use to check which chart sources exist and how fresh the snapshot is.

tools.name: Publishers by exposure to a category
tools.description: Use to pivot on one category for a regulated or family brand: which networks carry the most, or least, alcohol, weapons, adult or hate-speech exposure.

tools.name: Guest suitability exposure
tools.description: Use for what kind of shows a guest tends to appear on, in brand-safety terms.

tools.name: Publisher suitability profile
tools.description: Use for how brand-safe a network's catalogue is as a whole and where its exposure sits.

tools.name: Assessed shows of a publisher
tools.description: Use to build an inclusion or exclusion list inside one network: its shows by tier, or the ones exposed in a category.

tools.name: Publisher suitability leaderboard
tools.description: Use for the safest or riskiest networks to buy, or the most broadly placeable.

tools.name: Show suitability assessment
tools.description: Use for whether a show is safe to advertise on and in which categories it is exposed, with the evidence. The tier alone rides on every show record as suitability_tier.

tools.name: Patent
tools.description: You have a PATENTSCOPE doc_id (WO2024001234, CN190116616) and need the full bibliographic data.

tools.name: Reference
tools.description: Before composing a `search` query: to find the right field code, office code or IPC symbol.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: You need patent documents matching keywords, a title, an applicant or inventor, a publication or application number, or a date range, optionally limited to one office's collection.

tools.name: Compare
tools.description: PeerSpot head-to-head comparison of two products: category ranking, average rating (out of 10), reviews sentiment and review count per product, category mindshare, and per-theme sentiment scores with editorial summaries and reviewer quotes (ROI, customer service, scalability, stability, room for improvement, setup cost, valuable features). Order of the two slugs does not matter.

tools.name: Product
tools.description: One PeerSpot product page: average rating and review count, willingness to recommend, category ranking and mindshare, editorial review-theme summaries (valuable features, room for improvement, ROI, pricing, use cases, support, deployment, scalability, stability) with representative quotes, one-line summaries of individual reviews, reviewer company-size and industry breakdowns, and the comparison pages that link competitors.

tools.name: Reviews
tools.description: One page (10 reviews) of full-text PeerSpot reviews for a product: star rating, title, date, reviewer role and labels, company size, industry, pros, cons, every interview section (use case, valuable features, room for improvement, pricing/licensing, setup, support, ROI, ...) and the review permalink. Pass next_page to continue.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Find PeerSpot product pages for a vendor or product name. Returns up to 10 matching products with the slug needed by product, reviews and compare. PeerSpot's search is approximate (Rimini lists Gemini products), so each product carries match: exact (same words as the query), partial (every query word is a word or word prefix of the name) or fuzzy (PeerSpot's guess), and exact_match says whether any product matches exactly. A result with exact_match false and only fuzzy products means the vendor most likely has no PeerSpot page. Empty when nothing matches.

tools.name: Get opportunity

tools.name: List past opportunities
tools.description: Look up closed PennBid solicitations by keyword, closing window or public-award flag, for example to find awarded projects of an agency; pass `project_id` to `get_opportunity` for the detail.

tools.name: Company enrichment
tools.description: Use when you have one company and want its firmographics, funding and headcount. Give it a domain, ticker or social profile if you possibly can - a bare name is the identifier most likely to miss.

tools.name: Company search
tools.description: Use to find companies by attribute - industry, headcount, funding stage, location - rather than to look one up you can already name. Each returned company costs 50 credits. Smaller pages reduce payload size.

tools.name: Deal bundles
tools.description: Read deal bundles, optionally selected by code.

tools.name: Product options

tools.name: Promotions

tools.name: Store details

tools.name: Directory

tools.name: Modifiers

tools.name: Store

tools.name: Stores
tools.description: Discover nearby Pizza Hut stores and their store numbers, addresses, hours and supported occasions.

tools.name: Audiobook

tools.name: Author
tools.description: Bio and works with ratings for a Play author id (`authors[].id` of `book`, or type `author` in `search`).

tools.name: Book

tools.name: Show

tools.name: Sports list

tools.name: Market types
tools.description: List the valid sports market type names.

tools.name: Tags get

tools.name: Tags list
tools.description: Find topic tags and their IDs before filtering markets or events by tag_id.

tools.description: Find the code for a quantity (soil wetness, dew point, growing degree days) before asking for its history.

tools.name: Get price history

tools.name: Get product
tools.description: Comparing retailer offers and prices for a product found with search_products or suggest.

tools.name: Get product reviews
tools.description: Reading what Swedish buyers say about a product; combine with get_product for prices.

tools.name: Get store
tools.description: Checking a retailer seen in get_product offers before buying.

tools.name: List category
tools.description: Browsing a category's products ranked by popularity or price instead of searching by keyword.

tools.name: Search products
tools.description: Finding Swedish products and their lowest prices by keyword; take `product_id` from `product` items into get_product, get_price_history and get_product_reviews.

tools.name: Suggest

tools.name: Categories

tools.name: List auctions
tools.description: Discovering which auctions (bankruptcy estates, divestments, surplus sales) are open or recently closed on psauction.se before drilling into one with list_auction_items.

tools.name: Search items
tools.description: Finding lots by keyword or category on psauction.se, e.g. welding machines, tractors, lots in Skåne, or everything in item type 88 (Verktyg) sorted by highest bid. Use get_filters for item type ids and location slugs, get_item for one lot's full detail.

tools.name: Suggest
tools.description: Turning a vague or misspelled product word into better search_items queries and categories, or a quick 'what is on offer for X' glance.

tools.name: Get agency
tools.description: Resolve an agency id (or a pasted agency page URL) to the agency's identity and links.

tools.name: List agencies
tools.description: Find an agency's `agency_id` for `list_agency_open_bids` or `get_agency`, or enumerate the agencies of a state or province.

tools.name: List agency open bids
tools.description: Get the currently open solicitations of one agency found through `list_agencies`.

tools.name: List regions

tools.name: Article
tools.description: After `search` or `resolve_ids`, to read the abstract, MeSH indexing, affiliations, funding or references of one article.

tools.name: Full text
tools.description: Read the body of an open-access paper once you have its PMCID (from `search` with `db=pmc`, `summaries`, `article` identifiers or `resolve_ids`). Publisher-restricted articles only expose the abstract through `article`.

tools.name: Summaries

tools.name: Get posting
tools.description: After search_postings, or when a user pastes a https://purchasing.alberta.ca/posting/AB-YYYY-NNNNN link.

tools.name: List codes
tools.description: Translate a code seen in a posting (e.g. TA-01, RFQual, OPEN-COMPETITIVE) or find valid filter values for search_postings.

tools.name: List organizations

tools.name: Search unspsc codes

tools.name: Provenance
tools.description: Verify where a specific wheel or sdist was built and published from (GitHub/GitLab Trusted Publishing) before trusting it.

tools.name: Recent releases

tools.name: Release
tools.description: Check a specific version: dependency pins, Python compatibility, wheels/sdist available with hashes, whether it was yanked, and advisories for that exact version.

tools.name: Stats
tools.description: Size PyPI as a whole or see which projects dominate its storage.

tools.name: User projects

tools.name: Venue
tools.description: You have a venue id (from `search`, `events[].venue.id`, or a pasted `https://ra.co/clubs/{id}` URL) and need the venue's details or its upcoming events.

tools.name: Monthly climate history
tools.description: Long-range context for a parcel: how wet or warm each month was compared with other years, seasonal rainfall by month.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Search SAM.gov contract opportunities by keyword, agency, notice status, publication date, NAICS, set-aside, notice type and response deadline. Returns one page (default 20, max 100) with an opaque cursor for the next page. By default each hit is enriched with its full notice detail (NAICS, set-aside, place of performance, full description).

tools.name: Entity
tools.description: You have an OFAC entity id (from `search`, `record` or elsewhere) and want the structured, machine-readable record instead of the HTML details page.

tools.name: Publications
tools.description: Track when OFAC published list changes, or find the publication id of a change to fetch its delta.

tools.name: Record
tools.description: You have an entity_id from `search` (or an SLS entity id) and want the human-readable record as OFAC's search tool shows it.

tools.name: Reference lists
tools.description: Before filtering by program, or to map a program code or list name seen in a record.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Screen a name, ID number, digital currency address or address against OFAC's lists, or list the records of a program / country / type, and get entity ids for `record` or `entity`.

tools.name: Get trademark
tools.description: After a search returned a trade mark number, or with a pasted /trademarks/search/view/{number} URL.

tools.name: Search trademarks
