tools.description: Start here with a word, brand, owner name or trade mark number. Use search_trademarks_advanced for class, status, date, kind or party filters. Follow up with get_trademark for the full record.

tools.name: Search trademarks advanced
tools.description: When the search needs filters beyond a free-text term. Pass the returned search_record with page to page through the same result set without re-running the search.

tools.name: Entity
tools.description: Look up a Florida corporate registration by document number. Returns filing attributes, source-labelled officer and registered-agent sections, annual report history and PDF links. Unsupported registration layouts fail explicitly.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Browse the official alphabetical entity name list from a query. Results can include nearby names, historical registrations and trademarks, not exact matches. Follow next_cursor for the next source page.

tools.name: Event
tools.description: Detail for an event id from search_events, suggest or a pasted seatgeek.com event URL.

tools.name: Performer
tools.description: Detail for a performer id or slug from search_performers, search_events or suggest.

tools.name: Search events
tools.description: Discovery: find events for a team, artist, venue, place or date range, then pass an event id to event.

tools.name: Search performers
tools.description: Resolve a team, artist or show name to a SeatGeek performer id/slug before listing its events.

tools.name: Search venues
tools.description: Find a venue id by name or list venues in a city before listing events at a venue.

tools.name: Suggest
tools.description: Quickly resolve a partial name to SeatGeek ids across events, performers and venues in one call.

tools.name: Venue
tools.description: Detail for a venue id from search_venues, search_events or suggest.

tools.name: Council news
tools.description: Recent statements and news releases from the council or one councilmember.

tools.name: Council roster
tools.description: Who currently sits on the Seattle City Council, how to reach each office, and when each term ends. Use `councilmember` for one member's full contact card and provenance.

tools.name: Councilmember
tools.description: Full published contact details and freshness evidence for a specific councilmember after `council_roster` identified the seat.

tools.name: Find district
tools.description: Map an address's coordinates to its council district and representative. Geocoding is not provided; supply lon/lat.

tools.name: Page content
tools.description: Read a page found by `search_pages`, or a component id from `council_roster` / `councilmember`, when the specialised functions do not cover it.

tools.name: Search pages
tools.description: Find seattle.gov pages or documents about a topic, person or program, then read one with `page_content`.

tools.name: Terms of office
tools.description: Term dates for Seattle's elected officials, including those outside the council (mayor, city attorney, judges).

tools.name: Companies get
tools.description: A single filer's profile or its complete filing history page by page.

tools.name: Companies list
tools.description: Bulk collection of every listed filer's profile. Use companies_get for one CIK.

tools.name: Companies status
tools.description: Before a bulk run of companies_list, or to detect that the ticker index changed.

tools.name: Company
tools.description: Resolve a ticker, CIK or company name to its EDGAR filer profile: CIK, name, tickers, exchanges, SIC, filer category, state of incorporation, fiscal year end, addresses, former names and filing counts. Start here to get the CIK the other functions accept.

tools.name: Concept
tools.description: Every reported value of one XBRL concept for a filer (Revenues, NetIncomeLoss, Assets, EarningsPerShareDiluted ...) straight from the SEC's companyconcept API (or the same concept in companyfacts when companyconcept serves an empty placeholder; `source_url` names which): value, period, unit, fiscal year and period, the form and accession it came from. Newest period first.

tools.name: Daily index changes
tools.description: Incremental collection of new filings since a date; filter forms and 8-K items for M&A events.

tools.name: Daily index get
tools.description: Details of one accession seen in daily_index_list or daily_index_changes.

tools.name: Daily index list
tools.description: Collect every filing of a business day, or the day's 8-Ks with given items.

tools.name: Daily index status
tools.description: To learn which day's index exists before daily_index_list, or to pin a publication.

tools.name: Facts list
tools.description: Bulk collection of a filer's financial facts. Use concept for one tag.

tools.name: Facts status
tools.description: Before paging facts_list for a CIK, or to detect that a filer's facts changed.

tools.name: Filing
tools.description: One filing by accession number: its submission metadata (form, dates, 8-K items) and every document in the filing folder with size and direct URL (primary document, exhibits, XBRL instance, full submission text).

tools.name: Filings
tools.description: List a filer's EDGAR filings newest first, filtered by form type (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, S-1, 13F-HR, 4, DEF 14A ...) and filing date. Each record carries accession number, dates, 8-K item codes with captions, XBRL flags and direct document URLs. Reaches into older submission pages when `from` predates the recent window.

tools.name: Holdings 13f
tools.description: Form 13F-HR holdings of an institutional investment manager: every position from the XML information table (issuer, class, CUSIP, value, shares or principal, put/call, discretion, voting authority). Defaults to the latest 13F-HR; pick a quarter with report_date or a filing with accession_number. Values are whole USD for filings since 2023-01-03 and thousands before.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: EDGAR full-text search across every filer since 2001: filter by phrase, form types, filing-date range and CIK. Returns 100 hits per page with accession number, form, filer names and CIKs, 8-K item codes, period and direct document URLs. Use it for cross-company questions such as 8-K Item 2.02 filings this quarter. Pass `snippets` to also fetch the matched document of the first hits and return the sentences containing the query (EDGAR's index returns no highlights itself).

tools.name: Sections
tools.description: Item sections of a 10-K or 10-Q as plain text: Item 1 Business, 1A Risk Factors, 7 MD&A, 8 Financial Statements and so on (10-Q items carry their Part). Defaults to the filer's latest 10-K; pass form=10-Q or an accession number for another report, and items to keep only some sections.

tools.name: Get author
tools.description: Author metrics for an author id from a paper's author list or search_authors.

tools.name: Get author papers
tools.description: List what an author published; follow with get_paper or get_citations per paper.

tools.name: Get citations
tools.description: Forward citation expansion: who built on this paper. Newest citing papers come first.

tools.name: Get paper
tools.description: Details for a paper found through search_papers, match_paper, citations, references, recommendations or an author's list; or to resolve a DOI/arXiv id to a Semantic Scholar id.

tools.name: Get papers
tools.description: Hydrate a list of paper ids, DOIs or arXiv ids (for example the references of several papers) in one request.

tools.name: Get recommendations
tools.description: Related-work expansion beyond the citation graph. Give `paper_id` for one seed or `positive_paper_ids` (with optional `negative_paper_ids`) for several.

tools.name: Get references
tools.description: Backward expansion: the bibliography of a paper with the sentences that cite each entry.

tools.name: Match paper
tools.description: Resolve a citation string or a title to a Semantic Scholar paper id.

tools.name: Search authors
tools.description: Find an author id by name before get_author or get_author_papers. Names are ambiguous: check affiliations and counts.

tools.name: Search papers
tools.description: Discover papers on a topic before calling get_paper, get_citations or get_references. For one known title use match_paper instead.

tools.name: Get case by cnr
tools.description: You know a case's CNR (e.g. DLND010000012024, printed on court notices, orders and cause lists) and need its current status, parties, hearing history or order list.

tools.name: List court complexes
tools.description: You have state_code and dist_code and need a court_complex_code for list_establishments or to scope a case.

tools.name: List districts
tools.description: You have a state_code from list_states and need a dist_code for list_court_complexes.

tools.name: List establishments
tools.description: You have state_code, dist_code and court_complex_code and need the establishments in the complex.

tools.name: List states
tools.description: You need a state_code for list_districts, or want to know which states/UTs the portal serves.

tools.name: Agregado dados
tools.description: Official population or household count of a Brazilian municipality, state or the country (Census 2022: 4709/93 population, 4712/381 occupied households, 4712/382 residents in households; estimates: 6579/9324), IPCA (1737/63), PNAD unemployment (4099/4099), municipal GDP (5938/37), IPCA by group (7060/63 + classificacao 315) or any other table after agregado_metadados told you the ids. Resolve the municipality code first with localidades (e.g. São Bernardo do Campo = 3548708). Unknown agregado or variable ids are not_found; a level the table does not offer is invalid_input.

tools.name: Agregado metadados
tools.description: Pick the variavel ids, classificacao/categoria ids, nivel and periods to pass to agregado_dados. Unknown table ids are not_found.

tools.name: Agregados
tools.description: Find the agregado id (and then, with agregado_metadados, the variable and classification ids) before calling agregado_dados. Pass a query or at least one filter: the unfiltered catalog has ~8,000 tables. Rows carry only id and name (no period), and a query like `domicilios` with nivel N6 matches hundreds of Census tables ordered by id, so for the headline municipal population / household counts skip the search and call agregado_dados directly with 4709 (Census 2022 population), 4712 (Census 2022 occupied households and residents) or 6579 (yearly population estimates).

tools.name: Calendario
tools.description: When the next IPCA / PNAD / PIB release is scheduled, or the release history of a product.

tools.name: Cnae
tools.description: Decode a CNAE code from a company registry (7-digit subclasse 0111301, 5-digit classe 01113) or browse the hierarchy.

tools.name: Localidade
tools.description: Turn a municipality or state code into its name and hierarchy (microrregiao, mesorregiao, regiao imediata/intermediaria, UF, regiao), e.g. to label agregados results or join with other Brazilian sources.

tools.name: Localidades
tools.description: Resolve IBGE codes before querying agregados (N3 = estado id, N6 = municipio id), enumerate the municipalities of a state, or find a municipality by (partial, accent-insensitive) name. municipios, distritos and subdistritos require a parent so one call never fetches the 5,570-row national list.

tools.name: Malha
tools.description: Draw or geo-join a Brazilian state, municipality or region; get its centroid and area in km2. Use qualidade=minima unless you need detailed geometry (maxima meshes are megabytes).

tools.name: Nomes
tools.description: How common a Brazilian first name is, how its popularity changed by decade, or where in Brazil it concentrates.

tools.name: Nomes ranking
tools.description: Most common names in Brazil or a state, by decade or sex.

tools.name: Noticias
tools.description: Recent IBGE releases (IPCA, PNAD, PIB...), news about a product or matching a keyword. Follow next_page until null.

tools.name: Paises
tools.description: A country fact sheet or a UN-sourced indicator series (GDP per capita, population, life expectancy...) as IBGE republishes them, for Brazil or any of 193 countries.

tools.name: Availability
tools.description: Observe bookable SevenRooms slots for one local service date and party size. Excludes request-only placeholders. Optional exact local time filter. Not a reservation or hold; no restaurant-wide sold-out claim.

tools.name: Venue
tools.description: Look up public venue identity, address, phone and IANA timezone by known venue URL key. Australia validated; other countries unverified.

tools.name: Product details
tools.description: Get details, variants and availability for a product_id returned by search or lookup. Optional selected options refine the variant. Does not create a cart or place an order.

tools.name: Look up products
tools.description: Look up 1–50 products using product_ids returned by search, or product URLs. Inspect messages for unmatched identifiers.

tools.name: Search products
tools.description: Search products across Shopify merchants by query, such as trail running shoes under $150. Narrow results by country and use limit and cursor to page through them. Results are estimates, not an exhaustive merchant inventory.

tools.name: Storefront: Product details
tools.description: Get details and availability for a product_id from the selected store's search or lookup. Keep the same store_domain. Optional selected options refine the variant without executing checkout.

tools.name: Storefront: Look up products
tools.description: Look up 1–10 product_ids within store_domain. Use IDs returned by that store's search, not Global Catalog IDs. Inspect messages for unmatched identifiers.

tools.name: Storefront: Search products
tools.description: Search products in a Shopify store by store_domain and query, or leave query empty to browse. Use limit and cursor for pagination. The store must expose Shopify's Storefront Catalog endpoint.

tools.name: Marketing channel shares
tools.description: Use for marketing channel shares for one complete month. Subscription availability applies. The Similarweb-only monthly credit allowance applies.

tools.name: Marketing channel traffic
tools.description: Use for marketing channel traffic for one complete month. Subscription availability applies. The Similarweb-only monthly credit allowance applies.

tools.name: Traffic geography
tools.description: Use for traffic geography for one complete month. Subscription availability applies. The Similarweb-only monthly credit allowance applies.

tools.name: Incoming referral domains
tools.description: Use for incoming referral domains for one complete month. Subscription availability applies. The Similarweb-only monthly credit allowance applies.

tools.name: Paid search spend
tools.description: Use for paid search spend for one complete month. Subscription availability applies. The Similarweb-only monthly credit allowance applies.

tools.name: Referral traffic
tools.description: Use for referral traffic for one complete month. Subscription availability applies. The Similarweb-only monthly credit allowance applies.

tools.name: Traffic and engagement
tools.description: Use for traffic and engagement for one complete month. Subscription availability applies. The Similarweb-only monthly credit allowance applies.

tools.name: Outgoing referrals
tools.description: Outgoing referrals. Subscription availability applies. The Similarweb-only monthly credit allowance applies. Reference: https://docs.similarweb.com/api-v5/api-reference/website-analysis-api/website-referrals/outgoing-referrals

tools.name: Monthly prices
tools.description: Find the cheapest month for a route; then price_calendar for days and search_flights for a live quote. When a direct_only calendar comes back empty, retry without direct_only or use search_flights with max_stops 0 on concrete dates.

tools.name: Price calendar
tools.description: Find cheap dates for a route before running a live search_flights for a specific day.

tools.name: Search flights
tools.description: Compare fares and itineraries for concrete dates. Resolve places with suggest_places first; use price_calendar or monthly_prices for cheap-date discovery instead of many live searches.

tools.name: Suggest places
tools.description: Start here to resolve a city or airport name into the identifiers the other functions take.

tools.name: Describe dataset
tools.description: Before query_dataset, to learn the exact field names and types for select/where/order, and to size a dataset. Also answers 'how current is this data' and 'who publishes it'.

tools.name: Query dataset
tools.description: Any question that needs actual records or aggregates from an open-data dataset (permit lookups by address or number, inspection results, 311 requests by type, counts by category). Get the portal and 4x4 from search_datasets and field names from describe_dataset first.

tools.name: Search datasets
tools.description: Start here for city, county or state open data (permits, inspections, 311, code violations, business licenses, crime, property) when the dataset id is unknown. Then describe_dataset for the full column list and row count, and query_dataset for rows.

tools.name: Entity
tools.description: You have an entity_id from `search` (or a Colorado SOS ID number) and need the current record.

tools.name: Filings
tools.description: You need due dates, filed documents or the event timeline for an entity_id from `search` or `entity`.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Start here to find the 11-digit entity_id for `entity` and `filings`.

tools.name: Auction
tools.description: Use after search (an Auction hit's id, or a Lot hit's auction URL) or when the user pastes https://www.sothebys.com/en/buy/auction/{year}/{slug}. Then call auction_lots with the auction_id for the lots.

tools.name: Auction lots
tools.description: Use with an auction_id from auction or from a search Auction hit to list what is or was offered and what it fetched. Page with offset (next_offset is null when exhausted). Follow a lot_id into lot for the full catalogue entry.

tools.name: Buy now item
tools.description: Use when a search hit has type Buy Now (its url is https://www.sothebys.com/en/buy/_{slug}) or when the user pastes such a URL. Not for auction lots: use lot.

tools.name: Lot
tools.description: Use with a lot_id from auction_lots or a search Lot hit's id, or when the user pastes https://www.sothebys.com/en/buy/auction/{year}/{auction-slug}/{lot-slug}. Realized prices appear once the sale closes and the site publishes results.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Start here for any free-text question (artist, title, sale number, auction name). Filter with type (Lot, Auction, Buy Now, Artist, Article, Private Sale), location, department or available. Follow a Lot hit's id into lot, an Auction hit's id into auction / auction_lots, a Buy Now hit's url into buy_now_item. Algolia serves at most 1000 hits per query: narrow with filters for deep history.

tools.name: Airports
tools.description: Look up an airport's IATA code or destination id before search_airport_parking or destination.

tools.name: Cities
tools.description: Check whether SpotHero covers a city and get a starting coordinate for search_parking or search_monthly_parking.

tools.name: Destination
tools.description: Resolve a destination id to coordinates before search_parking, or show a venue's typical price ranges.

tools.name: Destination events
tools.description: Find event dates and SpotHero's event parking windows at a venue before pricing with search_parking.

tools.name: Facility quote
tools.description: Re-price a facility found by a search for a different window, or read its full details.

tools.name: Facility reviews
tools.description: Read what customers say about a facility found by a search.

tools.name: Search airport parking
tools.description: Compare off-airport and on-airport parking prices for a trip; airports and their codes come from `airports`.

tools.name: Search destinations
tools.description: Turn a venue name into a SpotHero destination_id and coordinates, then follow it into destination_events (that venue's event parking windows), destination (price ranges) or search_parking (`destination_id`). Use search_events for a team, artist or event title.

tools.name: Search events
tools.description: Turn a team, artist or event title into destination coordinates and an event parking window for search_parking. Not for venue names: use search_destinations then destination_events.

tools.name: Search monthly parking
tools.description: Find commuter or resident monthly parking near an address; coordinates come from `cities`, `destination` or `airports`.

tools.name: Search parking
tools.description: Find parking near a place or venue for a specific arrival and departure time and compare quoted prices; follow `facility_id` into facility_quote or facility_reviews.

tools.name: Accepted answers
tools.description: Accepted answers by topic: the top questions on one site carrying every tag in `tagged` (optionally narrowed by `q`), each paired with its accepted answer. One search call plus one batched answers call; `has_more` + `page` paginate.

tools.name: Answer
tools.description: One answer by `answer_id`, or up to 100 answers by `answer_ids`, on one site. Returns the full answer records (bodies, score, is_accepted, owner). Ids that do not exist are simply absent from the result.

tools.name: Answers
tools.description: Answers to one question (by `question_id` + `site` or URL), one page per call, sorted by votes, activity or creation. Each answer carries is_accepted, score, bodies, owner and its canonical URL.

tools.name: Question
tools.description: One question identified by `question_id` + `site` or by its URL, with its answers (default: by votes) and the accepted answer surfaced separately. Two API calls. Unknown or deleted questions are an error.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Questions on one Stack Exchange site matching free text (`q`: one term or up to 5 searched together), tags, or title/body text, optionally inside a creation-date window (`fromdate`/`todate`) and score/date bounds (`min`/`max`); `accepted: true` keeps only questions with an accepted answer. Returns question records (bodies only with `include_body: true`) plus per-term counts, total, has_more and quota; `question_id` and `accepted_answer_id` feed `question` and `answer`.

tools.name: Sites
tools.description: Sites in the Stack Exchange network with the `site` parameter every other function takes. Input: page and page size. Returns site name, URL, audience and API parameter.

tools.name: Injury report
tools.description: Who is hurt before setting a lineup.

tools.name: Projections
tools.description: Start/sit decisions from betting lines: this week's projected points and the props behind them.

tools.name: Ros projections
tools.description: In-season rankings for trades and waivers.

tools.name: Season projections
tools.description: Season-long rankings for drafts or trades.

tools.name: Weekly results
tools.description: Checking how projections held up, or a week's actual fantasy scores.

tools.name: Get product
tools.description: After search_products, list_category or list_group_breaks with a result's `slug`, or when the user pastes a www.steelcitycollectibles.com/i/... URL.

tools.name: List category
tools.description: Browse a department instead of searching: 'all 2025 baseball boxes and cases, cheapest first'. Take the category slug from a site URL or the categories sitemap; take filter keys and option codes from a previous page's `filters`.

tools.name: List group breaks
tools.description: For live or upcoming group breaks rather than sealed product. Each result is a product; get_product with its `slug` has the full description.

tools.name: Related products
tools.description: After get_product or a listing, with the numeric product `id`, to find the case/box/pack siblings and similar products.

tools.name: Search products
tools.description: Start here for a product or set name ('2025 topps chrome baseball', 'pokemon prismatic evolutions'). Follow with get_product using a result's `slug`.

tools.name: Browse options
tools.description: Look up valid sort ids and brand aliases before calling search_products or browse_products.

tools.name: Browse products
tools.description: Walk a catalogue slice by category, brand, size, price range or gender instead of free text. Filter ids and values come from the `filters` of a previous call made with include_filters true (for example brand -> 'Jordan', mens-shoe-size -> 'US M 10', lowest-ask-range -> 'range(100|300)').

tools.name: Get price levels
tools.description: Market depth for a product or one size variant. transaction_type ASK lists sell offers, BID lists buy offers. Paginate with page while next_page is set.

tools.name: Get product
tools.description: Price and market check for one known product. Use search_products or browse_products to find the url_key; use the variant ids here for size-level get_sales / get_price_levels.

tools.name: Get sales
tools.description: Recent sale prices for a product or one size. The site exposes only the most recent `first` sales; there is no older-page cursor through the public operations.

tools.name: Search products
tools.description: Find products and their url_key by keyword. Then call get_product for market data per size, get_sales for recent sales or get_price_levels for the order book. The site caps a query at 1000 results; use browse_products with filters to go deeper.

tools.name: Event
tools.description: Read event identity, venue, source status, performers and current inventory counts. Unconfirmed times are null; utc_offset_ms is the source offset, not an IANA timezone.

tools.name: Listings
tools.description: Read one page of public resale offers for an event and ticket quantity. Numeric price is per ticket; display_total_for_quantity is the source-rendered group total. Fee disclosures and allowed quantities are preserved. No checkout or reservations.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Search public StubHub events by keywords such as an artist, team, venue or city. Returns one relevance-ranked page; pass next_page as page. No structured date or location filters.

tools.name: Archive
tools.description: One page of a Substack publication's archive, newest, top or pinned first. Each entry carries title, subtitle, URL, publish time, audience (free or paid), word count, engagement counts, section, tags and bylines. Page with offset and limit.

tools.name: Post
tools.description: One Substack post by URL, or by publication and slug: metadata plus body_html and body_text. Free posts (audience everyone) are complete; paid posts return the publicly served preview with paywalled true, full_text_available false and text_coverage showing how much of the author's word count is visible.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Search a Substack publication's archive for posts matching a query, using Substack's own archive search. Returns the same post entries as archive, with the query echoed.

tools.name: Get job
tools.description: With a pasted SuccessFactors posting URL (https://{site}/[...]/job/{slug}/{id}/), or career_site plus a search_jobs job_id.

tools.name: Search jobs
tools.description: Start here with any career-site URL running on SAP SuccessFactors / jobs2web (rmkcdn.successfactors.com assets, /job/{slug}/{id}/ posting URLs). Read `facets` for filterable fields, page with next_offset, then call get_job with a row's url (or career_site + job_id) for the full description.

tools.name: Builds
tools.description: Answer which talent build a WoW Forever class or spec should take at 60 or at the level 30 cap. Pass a row's `calculator_url` to `talents` as `build` for every rank.

tools.name: Leveling
tools.description: Answer which talents a leveling WoW Forever character should have at its level ("level 20 Arms warrior"): pass class, spec and level and read `points_at_level`.

tools.name: Talents
tools.description: Answer what a WoW Forever talent does, what a class's trees hold, or exactly which talents a shared build link takes. Pass `calculator_url` from `builds` or `leveling` as `build` to decode it.

tools.name: Featured
tools.description: Discover the limited set of product links featured on the Target US homepage; not a searchable or exhaustive catalog.

tools.name: Product
tools.description: Read a known Target product URL: brand, descriptive specifications, highlights, image and published return-policy text. Price and availability are unknown.

tools.name: Reviews
tools.description: Use for review text and ratings of a known Target product (url or tcin from featured or variants). To sync incrementally, call with sort=newest and since set to the latest submitted_at you already hold, or stop paging at a known review_id. A query exposes at most 2550 reviews; larger products are read per star rating, and the output warns where a rating bucket is cut short.

tools.name: Variants
tools.description: List child product identifiers, option combinations and images from a Target parent product page. Follow child URLs for specifications. Catalog variants do not imply purchasable inventory.

tools.name: Get tender
tools.description: After search_tenders, to read one tender's full public notice.

tools.name: List lookups
tools.description: To get valid ids for search_tenders, search_announcements, search_prequalifications and search_future_projects filters, or to map an id back to its label.

tools.name: Search announcements
tools.description: To list direct-purchase / limited-tender notices, which are not in search_tenders.

tools.name: Search future projects
tools.description: To see procurement an agency plans to tender, before a tender is published.

tools.name: Search prequalifications
tools.description: To list pre-qualification invitations (a separate surface from tenders and announcements).

tools.name: Search tenders
tools.description: To find tenders by keyword/filters or to resolve a 12-digit reference number to its tender_id_string before calling get_tender.

tools.name: Atm detail
tools.description: Pass `guid` or `url` from an atm_search row, or an `atm_id` such as `NS1333` (resolved through the list's id filter, so only open ATMs resolve by id; closed ones need their GUID). Closed notices redirect to /Atm/ShowClosed/{guid} and come back with `status: closed`. Briefing requirements are free text in the instructions/conditions fields; `briefing_mentioned` and `briefing_excerpts` flag them, they do not structure them. An unknown id or GUID is not_found.

tools.name: Atm search
tools.description: Start here to find open procurement opportunities by keyword (e.g. `cleaning`); pass a row's `guid` or `atm_id` to atm_detail for the full notice, contact officer and briefing instructions. Only currently open ATMs are listed (closed ATMs are not exposed by the list); zero rows is a normal answer since only ~100 ATMs are open at any time.

tools.name: Contract detail
tools.description: Pass a `cn_id` such as `CN4279555` (amendments like `CN4111658-A1` are their own ids). An unknown id is not_found (the API answers 400 errorCode 100).

tools.name: Contracts by date
tools.description: Use for 'what was published/started/ends between X and Y'. The API pages 100 releases at a time behind an opaque cursor; `limit` trims a page and the continuation cursor resumes exactly where the previous call stopped. Dates must be full UTC timestamps `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`. An empty window is a normal empty result; a reversed or malformed window is invalid_input.

tools.name: Get contract
tools.description: After list_contracts, search_contracts or get_tender (awarded), to read who won, for how much and for how long.

tools.name: Get tender
tools.description: After list_tenders or search_tenders, to read one notice in full: closing time, briefing requirement, documents, description.

tools.name: List contracts
tools.description: To see recently awarded WA government contracts without a keyword. Use search_contracts for filters and get_contract for the full record.

tools.name: List tenders
tools.description: To see what is currently open, new, recently closed or awarded across all WA agencies without a keyword. Use search_tenders for keyword, agency, region or date filters and get_tender for the full notice.

tools.name: Lookups
tools.description: To resolve an agency or region name to the id search_tenders / search_contracts expect.

tools.name: Search contracts
tools.description: To find awarded contracts by keyword (e.g. cleaning), agency, region, value or award date. Ids come from lookups.

tools.name: Search tenders
tools.description: To find tenders by keyword (e.g. cleaning), agency, region, state or date range. Ids for public_authority_id, issuing_business_id, region_id and pre_qualification_level_id come from lookups.

tools.name: Get credits
tools.description: Who is in a film or show and who made it, beyond the top-billed strip get_title returns.

tools.name: Get person
tools.description: Who someone is and what they have been in or worked on.

tools.name: Get release dates
tools.description: Is a film out yet, where and when it was or will be released, and with which rating.

tools.name: Get season
tools.description: Episode list and air dates of a season; is a new episode out yet.

tools.name: Get title
tools.description: Details of a known movie or show: when it came out, what it is about, who is in it, how it is rated, and whether TMDB shows it as streaming.

tools.name: Get watch providers
tools.description: Streaming availability: where to stream, rent or buy a title in a given country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, default US).

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Resolve a title or person name to a TMDB id and media type before calling get_title, get_credits, get_watch_providers, get_release_dates, get_person or get_season.

tools.name: Categories
tools.description: Browse without a query: list leagues, teams, genres and shows and get performer slugs. Cached daily by the site.

tools.name: Event
tools.description: After search, performer_events or venue_events returned an event_id, or when the user pastes a tickpick.com/buy-... URL.

tools.name: Event price history
tools.description: To see how the cheapest ticket and the listing count moved over time for an event_id from search, performer_events or venue_events.

tools.name: Nearby events
tools.description: Location-first discovery: 'what is happening in Chicago'. Pass latitude/longitude; add the TickPick market slug (dma, for example washington-dc-md or chicago-il) for venues and just-announced lists.

tools.name: Performer events
tools.description: Events for a performer whose slug and url_category came from search (performers[]) or categories (items[]).

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Start here to resolve a team, artist, show, venue or event name to TickPick identifiers. For a full event list use performer_events or venue_events; for one event use event.

tools.name: Venue events
tools.description: Everything at a venue whose slug came from search or an event's venue. Page with offset = next_offset until it is null.

tools.name: Get product
tools.description: Details, variants (sizes/colours) and per-variant price or stock of one product in a Tiendanube / Nuvemshop store, e.g. from a pasted product URL (/productos/<slug>/ or /produtos/<slug>/).

tools.name: List categories
tools.description: Navigate a Tiendanube store's catalogue and find the category path to pass to list_products.

tools.name: List products
tools.description: Catalogue, new products (sort created-descending), prices or stock of a store on Tiendanube / Nuvemshop (*.mitiendanube.com, *.lojavirtualnuvem.com.br or a custom domain). Get category paths from list_categories and product details from get_product.

tools.name: Locations
tools.description: First hop of discovery: resolve a city name to a TodayTix location id, timezone and currency.

tools.name: Search shows
tools.description: Find shows by city, keyword or date, then pass a show id to show or showtimes.

tools.name: Show
tools.description: Detail for a show id from search_shows, or for a pasted todaytix.com show URL.

tools.name: Showtimes
tools.description: Availability and prices per performance for a show id; filter by date window to keep pages small.

tools.name: Venue
tools.description: Where a show plays: pass venue.slug from a show card, or a todaytix.com venue URL.

tools.name: Get trade mark
tools.description: When you have a trade mark number (UK000..., or UK009... for a comparable mark derived from an EU trade mark, domain 23). An unknown number is a not_found failure.

tools.name: Get trade mark history
tools.description: For assignment, ownership-change and status timelines of a known trade mark number.

tools.name: List owner marks
tools.description: After search_owners returned a client_id, or from the owner link on a case detail. Follow up with get_trade_mark for the full record.

tools.name: Search owners
tools.description: Start here when you know a company or person name but not a trade mark number. An owner name that matches nothing returns zero owners, not an error.

tools.name: Product
tools.description: One Trader Joe's product by SKU as published for a store: price, size, availability, description, category path, images, full nutrition facts panels (serving size, calories, per-nutrient amount and % daily value), ingredients, allergens and related products. An unknown SKU is an error.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Search Trader Joe's products available at one store by keyword: SKU, title, shelf price (USD), pack size, availability flag, category path and image. Paginated; total_count and next_page are returned. store_code defaults to 701 (Los Angeles - Hyperion).

tools.name: Stores
tools.description: Trader Joe's stores near a US ZIP code: store code (used by search and product), address, coordinates, distance, phone, weekly hours and alcohol availability. Zero results for a ZIP with no store in range is a success with count 0.

tools.name: Advisories
tools.description: Which destinations are Level 4 Do Not Travel, or what the U.S. government currently advises about travel to a country found by name. For one destination by code or advisory URL use advisory; for entry requirements, laws, health and embassy contacts use country_information.

tools.name: Advisory
tools.description: Look up the level and advice for one destination when you know its State Department code (GM, UK, MX) or have its travel.state.gov advisory link. Use advisories to find a destination by name.

tools.name: Country information
tools.description: Passport, visa and vaccination requirements, emergency numbers, local-law warnings or U.S. embassy addresses for a destination. Use advisory or advisories for the advisory level.

tools.name: Auction results
tools.description: How an auction went: filter `security_type:eq:Note,security_term:eq:10-Year` and sort `-auction_date` for the last ten-year, then read `high_yield` and `bid_to_cover_ratio`. Bidder takedown comes as amounts, not shares: `indirect_bidder_accepted`, `direct_bidder_accepted` and `primary_dealer_accepted` in dollars, beside the `_tendered` amounts; an indirect share is `indirect_bidder_accepted` divided by `total_accepted`. `cusip:eq:` reaches one security. Bills report discount rates, notes and bonds yields, TIPS real yields, FRNs discount margins.

tools.name: Upcoming auctions
tools.description: What the Treasury is about to sell: the auction calendar for the coming days with sizes. No history here - once an auction settles it moves to auctions/results.

tools.name: Buyback operations
tools.description: How much the Treasury bought back and when: sort `-operation_date` for the latest operation or the one just announced. Filter by program with `operation_type:eq:Liquidity Support` or `operation_type:eq:Cash Management`, by `security_type:eq:Nominal Coupons` or `security_type:eq:TIPS`, or by `maturity_bucket:eq:20Y to 30Y`. Demand is `total_par_amt_offered` against `max_par_amt_redeemed`; the take is `total_par_amt_accepted`. Which CUSIPs it bought, and at what price, is buybacks/securities.

tools.name: Buyback securities
tools.description: Which securities a buyback took and at what price: filter `operation_date:eq:<date>` for one operation's CUSIPs, adding `par_amt_accepted:gt:0` to keep only the ones bought, or `cusip_nbr:eq:<CUSIP>` for every operation one security was eligible in. A price under 100 is a discount to par.

tools.name: Deposits and withdrawals
tools.description: Where the government's cash came from and went each day: withheld income taxes, corporate taxes, Social Security benefits, Medicare, defence vendor payments, interest on the debt. The daily tax-receipt categories are the real-time read on the economy that the monthly statement only confirms later.

tools.name: Operating cash balance
tools.description: The Treasury General Account balance - the government's cash on hand - which is what debt-ceiling coverage tracks day by day. For the current figure filter `account_type:eq:Treasury General Account (TGA) Closing Balance`, sort `-record_date` and read `open_today_bal`; `close_today_bal` is `null` on every row since 2022-04-18. The same balance is `close_today_bal` on `account_type:eq:Federal Reserve Account` rows through 2021-09-30 and on `account_type:eq:Treasury General Account (TGA)` rows for the six months between, so a series across the 2022 relabelling is those three filters stitched together.

tools.name: Public debt transactions
tools.description: Gross issuance and redemption of Treasury securities by day: how much in bills was issued and how much rolled off. Net issuance is issues minus redemptions across the same security type.

tools.name: Average interest rates
tools.description: What the government is paying on its debt, by kind of security: the average coupon on outstanding notes, the rate on bills, the blended rate on everything marketable. Filter `security_desc:eq:Treasury Notes` for one class, sort `-record_date` for the latest month.

tools.name: Historical debt outstanding
tools.description: The long series: one figure per year from the first Treasury report in 1790. Use it for anything before 1993 or for a year-end comparison, filtering `record_fiscal_year:eq:<year>` rather than `record_date`; debt/to-the-penny is the daily figure.

tools.name: Interest expense
tools.description: How much interest the debt costs in dollars, monthly, by kind of security. The fiscal-year-to-date column is the one quoted when interest is compared to other outlays; filter `record_calendar_month:eq:09` for fiscal-year totals.

tools.name: Debt to the penny
tools.description: The headline national debt figure: total public debt outstanding on a given day, to the cent. Sort `-record_date` with `page[size]=1` for today's number, or filter a date range for the series. For the figure before 1993 use debt/historical-outstanding.

tools.name: Receipts, outlays and deficit
tools.description: The monthly deficit: filter `record_date:eq:2026-07-31,classification_desc:eq:July` and read `current_month_dfct_sur_amt` on the row with the higher `line_code_nbr` - the current fiscal year's July; the other row is the prior year's July for comparison. `classification_desc:eq:Year-to-Date` on the same record date gives the fiscal-year running total the same way. Published around the eighth business day of the following month.

tools.name: Treasury reporting rates of exchange
tools.description: The official rate a US agency reports a foreign balance at, per quarter. Filter `country_currency_desc:eq:Euro Zone-Euro` or `country:eq:Japan`, add `effective_date:lte:<date>` for the date being reported, and sort `-record_date,-effective_date`, so the first row is the rate in force on that date rather than an amendment that came after it. For a market rate on a given day this is the wrong source.

tools.name: Gold reserve
tools.description: How much gold the Treasury holds and where. The book value is the statutory price, not the market price, so a market valuation is the ounces times a spot price from elsewhere. Sort `-record_date` for the current holding.

tools.name: Interest by region
tools.description: Where a term is most popular: top states, countries, metros or cities.

tools.name: Interest over time
tools.description: Trend lines, seasonality, or comparing popularity of terms over a period.

tools.name: Related queries
tools.description: Keyword research: what else people search alongside a term, and what is newly rising.

tools.name: Suggestions
tools.description: Disambiguate a term (Apple the company vs the fruit) before comparing interest.

tools.name: Trending now
tools.description: What people are searching for right now in a country; news and breakout topics.

tools.name: Amenities
tools.description: Read published popular hotel amenities with source charge labels. Partial amenity coverage; no unlisted amenity is inferred absent.

tools.name: Destinations
tools.description: List linked hotel city directories from the public hotels landing page. Not a complete destination catalog.

tools.name: Hotel
tools.description: Read hotel identity, street address, description and published property facts. Does not quote a stay.

tools.name: Hotels
tools.description: List featured hotel profiles from a known city directory. Curated directory content, not dated availability search; marketing prices are omitted.

tools.name: Policies
tools.description: Read published property policy sections including check-in/out, children, pets and fees when present. Policies may vary by room and do not represent a booking contract.

tools.name: Rooms
tools.description: Read published room types, bed descriptions and room features. Room types do not establish availability; price and availability are unknown.

tools.name: Filters
tools.description: Read Turo's public US vehicle-type, sort and fuel labels. vehicle_types and sort_options supply values accepted by search. Fuel labels are descriptive; this version does not expose a fuel filter.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Search US Turo rentals around coordinates with optional make, vehicle type and sort. Dates use pickup-local time; omitted dates default to a three-day trip starting 21 days ahead at 10:00. Returns up to 50 vehicles from Turo's bounded source window (observed cap: 200), explicit truncation and no invented pagination cursor. Dated anonymous estimates come from the separate public pricing endpoint, with currency, source tax notice and included/excluded line items. quote=null means Turo supplied no estimate for that vehicle. Indicative daily prices are separate and must not be multiplied into trip totals. Estimates are not final booking prices.

tools.name: Vehicle
tools.description: Read one public US Turo vehicle URL: identity, listing status, location, specifications, rating and indicative daily price. Optional paired start/end times request a separate dated home-pickup estimate for driver_age (default 30); without dates, include_quote=true uses a three-day trip starting 21 days ahead at 10:00 pickup-local time; otherwise quote and pricing_query are null. A null quote with dates means the source supplied no estimate. Taxes, protection and other costs may be excluded; inspect the source tax notice and line items. No final checkout price or availability guarantee.

tools.name: Get award
tools.description: Reading a purchase-order award returned by search_awards.

tools.name: Get grant
tools.description: Reading a grant opportunity returned by search_grants.

tools.name: Get solicitation
tools.description: Reading the full notice and attachment links for an id returned by search_solicitations or found in an ESBD URL.

tools.name: List agencies
tools.description: Resolving an agency name to the agency_number search_solicitations and search_awards take.

tools.name: List nigp codes
tools.description: Validating or completing a NIGP code for the nigp_code filter.

tools.name: Search awards
tools.description: Finding Texas agency purchase-order awards and vendors; follow with get_award for notes and attachments.

tools.name: Search grants
tools.description: Finding Texas state grant opportunities and their grant numbers before calling get_grant; the facets in the output give the ids the filters take.

tools.name: Search solicitations
tools.description: Finding Texas state procurement opportunities and their public ids before calling get_solicitation. Pass notice_type 'presolicitation' for advance notices.

tools.name: Get location
tools.description: You have an `entity_id` from `list_locations` (or a pasted uhaul.com/Locations/.../{id}/ URL) and need the location's profile.

tools.name: Get location reviews
tools.description: You have a location `entity_id` and want its customer feedback.

tools.name: List locations
tools.description: Find location `entity_id`s in a place before `get_location` / `get_location_reviews`.

tools.name: Search truck rates
tools.description: The caller wants truck sizes, prices or availability for a move between two places or around one place on a date. Use `suggest_locations` first when the place name is ambiguous.

tools.name: Suggest locations
tools.description: Normalise a free-text place into the exact `pickup_location` / `dropoff_location` string before calling `search_truck_rates`.

tools.name: Get contract award
tools.description: After search_contract_awards, with a row's `contract_award_id`, or when given a `https://www.ungm.org/Public/ContractAward/<id>` URL. An unknown id is not_found.

tools.name: Get notice
tools.description: After search_notices, with a row's `notice_id`, or when given a `https://www.ungm.org/Public/Notice/<id>` URL. An unknown id is not_found.

tools.name: Search contract awards
tools.description: To find who won UN contracts, by supplier name, agency, country or award window; pass a row's `contract_award_id` to get_contract_award for the full award with contract value, description, suppliers, contacts and UNSPSC codes.

tools.name: Search notices
tools.description: Start here to find open UN tenders by keyword, agency (e.g. `UNDP`), country or deadline window; pass a row's `notice_id` to get_notice for the full notice with description, contacts, links and UNSPSC codes. Use search_unspsc to find UNSPSC node ids for the `unspsc_ids` filter.

tools.name: Search unspsc
tools.description: To turn a product or service keyword (`solar`, `vaccines`, `consulting`) into UNSPSC node ids before filtering search_notices. Only rows with `selectable: true` (family level and below) can be used as filters.

tools.name: Data
tools.description: Country-year observations for up to 10 indicator codes (from `indicators`), parsed live from the official Excel files: value as source text (null for blank/suppressed cells with the reason in series_note), unit copied from the file, SDMX flag and label, provisional marker, country as ISO3 + M49 + label, file edition and publication date. Filter by ISO3 `countries`, `year_from`/`year_to` and, for arrivals-by-region, `partner` (total | all | UN Tourism region code). Cursor-paginated, deterministic order.

tools.name: Files
tools.description: The official UN Tourism Key Tourism Statistics Excel files (13 files: inbound arrivals/expenditure/by region/by purpose/by transport/accommodation, outbound departures/expenditure, domestic trips/accommodation, hotel capacity and occupancy, employment SDG 8.9.2, tourism GDP SDG 8.9.1). One live HEAD per file returns Last-Modified as source_updated_at, ETag and S3 version id, and changed_since_catalog flags a re-publication since the embedded catalogue.

tools.name: Indicators
tools.description: Search the 148 free indicators (code, name, series group, unit, source file). `query` matches words in the code, name, previous Compendium code, unit, file id or common synonyms (receipts -> inbound expenditure, occupancy -> hotel room/bed rates); `series_group` narrows to inbound, outbound, domestic, industries, employment or macro. Cursor-paginated; each page carries the live publication date of its source files.

tools.name: Creative breakdown
tools.description: Use for how a market advertises: the share of hooks, personas, offers or formats across a vertical, brand or filter. Run it twice, once with min_impressions=4, to see what the winning ads over-index on.

tools.name: Browse ads
tools.description: Use to list a brand's or a vertical's ads by filter: what an advertiser is running now (advertiser_id + is_active=true), or the winners in a category (order_by=best, min_impressions=4).

tools.name: Ad detail
tools.description: Use for everything about one ad: the hook, offer, landing page and whether the page delivers what the ad promises. Add include=full for scenes, transcript, overlays and narrative.

tools.name: Search ads
tools.description: Use to find Meta ads matching a free-text idea, relevance-ranked across Upspring's competitor ad corpus. Re-rank the page by strength.impressions, then open the finalists with ads/detail. For the newest or best-performing ads without a query use ads/browse.

tools.name: Similar ads
tools.description: Use to find ads creatively like one ad, from the same brand and from its competitors.

tools.name: Advertiser brief
tools.description: Use for a brand's ad strategy at a glance: size grades, Facebook and Instagram followers, Reddit sentiment, its creative fingerprint (personas, mechanisms, hooks, media mix, funnel), hook themes and its top ads.

tools.name: Advertiser by domain
tools.description: Use when all you have is a company's website: resolves it to one advertiser and returns the same brief as advertisers/brief. Never 404s; a domain Upspring cannot source answers status unavailable and is not charged.

tools.name: Compare advertisers
tools.description: Use to put two brands' ad strategies side by side: where they overlap, where they differ, and what each leaves open.

tools.name: Peer advertisers
tools.description: Use for brands like this one: same category, vertical, geography or size band. For creative similarity instead use advertisers/similar.

tools.name: Request an advertiser
tools.description: Use when advertisers/brief answers not found or status unavailable for an advertiser id you know exists: asks Upspring to source it, then poll advertisers/brief. Idempotent; each new advertiser counts against a daily limit.

tools.name: Find advertisers
tools.description: Use to find a brand's advertiser id by name, website or Facebook page, or to list the advertisers in a vertical, category or size tier. For one brand from its domain with the full brief in one call use advertisers/by-domain.

tools.name: Similar advertisers
tools.description: Use for a brand's closest competitors: advertisers going after the same audience with comparable creative strategies.

tools.name: Vertical vocabulary
tools.description: Use, free, before filtering ads by persona, hook or another dimension: lists the valid ids in one vertical.

tools.name: Verticals and categories
tools.description: Use first, free, to learn the vertical and category ids the ads and advertiser filters accept.

tools.name: Get post
tools.description: Fetch a single post found through search_posts, latest_posts or a user's activity.

tools.name: Get topic
tools.description: Read a discussion found through list_topics or search_posts; page through long threads with `page` (and a smaller `page_size` when only the first replies matter).

tools.name: Get user
tools.description: Who is behind a post, and what else they wrote on this forum.

tools.name: Latest posts
tools.description: A firehose of what is being said right now on a forum (news-style monitoring); filter by category_id or topic on the caller's side.

tools.name: List categories
tools.description: Discovery: find the category ids to pass to list_topics (for example the WoW: Forever categories on en/wow) or to read a site's structure.

tools.name: List topics
tools.description: Browse or monitor a forum or category, e.g. WoW: Forever discussions (en/wow category 347) newest first, or the week's top topics.

tools.name: Search posts
tools.description: Find discussions about a subject (e.g. `WoW Forever` newest first, or posts in #housing after a date). Pair with get_topic for the full thread.

tools.name: Agency
tools.description: Toptier agency overview for a fiscal year by CGAC/FREC code (097 Department of Defense, 075 Health and Human Services, 036 Veterans Affairs): name, mission, website, subtier count, DEF codes in use and the fiscal year's award obligations and transaction count.

tools.name: Award
tools.description: One USAspending prime award by generated_unique_award_id (CONT_AWD_…, CONT_IDV_…, ASST_NON_…, ASST_AGG_…) or numeric internal id: identifiers, type, agencies, recipient with location, obligations and outlays, options, period of performance, place of performance, NAICS/PSC or CFDA, parent IDV, subaward totals and last modified date.

tools.name: Award search
tools.description: Search USAspending prime awards by keyword, awarding/funding agency, recipient name or UEI, action-date window, place of performance, NAICS, PSC and award amount within one award family (contracts, IDVs, grants, loans, direct payments or other). One page (default 20, max 100) of summary award records with an opaque cursor for the next page; add `award` for the full record.

tools.name: Idv children
tools.description: Awards issued under an indefinite delivery vehicle: child awards (orders), child IDVs or grandchild awards, newest period start first, with obligated amount and period of performance. Paged with a cursor.

tools.name: Subawards
tools.description: Subawards reported under one prime award (FSRS data), newest first: subaward number, sub-recipient name, amount, action date and description. Paged with a cursor; an award with no subawards answers an empty page with a warning.

tools.name: Transactions
tools.description: Transactions (individual actions and modifications) of one award, newest action first: obligation per action (negative for de-obligations), action type, modification number and description. Paged with a cursor.

tools.name: Recipient
tools.description: Recipient profile by USAspending recipient_id (hash with -C/-P/-R level) or 12-character UEI: names, identifiers, parent, business types, location and transaction obligations for the latest 12 months or a fiscal year, plus per-fiscal-year obligations for the years requested.

tools.name: Assignments
tools.description: You need who owns or has a security interest in a patent or trademark, or the reel/frame of a recorded assignment.

tools.name: Patent document
tools.description: You have a patent number, publication number or ppubs guid and need the record itself.

tools.name: Patent search
tools.description: Start here to find patents or publications by title, number, assignee, inventor or classification; pass `patents[].guid` to `patent_document`.

tools.name: Trademark search
tools.description: Find trademark serial numbers by mark text; pass `hits[].serial_number` to `trademark_status` or `assignments`.

tools.name: Trademark status
tools.description: You have a serial or registration number and need the current status and parties of the mark.

tools.name: Get deal
tools.description: You have a deal_id from search_deals and want the complete record. Fails with not_found for an unknown or expired deal_id.

tools.name: Get provider reviews
tools.description: You have a provider id (from list_providers or a deal) and want its public rating and recent review text. Fixed latest-10 reviews; no pagination. Fails with not_found for an unknown provider id.

tools.name: List providers
tools.description: Resolve a provider name to the id that search_deals.provider_ids and get_provider_reviews need.

tools.name: Lookup addresses
tools.description: You have a UK postcode and need the uprn of a specific address before searching deals. Fails with not_found for a postcode Royal Mail does not know.

tools.name: Search deals
tools.description: Compare home broadband deals for a UK address (postcode + uprn from lookup_addresses) or nationally. One page per call (limit, default 20, max 50); pass next_cursor back as cursor with the same filters for the next page. Fails with not_found when Uswitch does not recognise the postcode/uprn pair.

tools.name: Countries
tools.description: V-Dem country crosswalk (183 countries served by the graphing API): country_id, country_text_id, name, ISO3 or null with historical/non-ISO entities flagged, coded year span and V-Dem region; optional name/code/region filter. Embedded snapshot; no live request.

tools.name: Data
tools.description: Country-year observations for up to 5 variables and 50 countries (ISO3 or V-Dem country_text_id) from v-dem.net's official graphing API for the pinned release (v16, 1789-2025), optionally year-bounded, with codelow/codehigh bounds. Sorted by variable, country_id, year; paginated with next_cursor.

tools.name: Datasets
tools.description: Current V-Dem dataset releases read live from v-dem.net (Country-Year Core, Country-Year Full+Others, Country-Date, Coder-Level: version, published month, download landing page) plus the ERT and V-Party companion datasets, each with codebook URL, citation, CC BY-SA 4.0 license and terms URL.

tools.name: Ert
tools.description: Episodes of Regime Transformation (ERT v16) country-year records for up to 20 countries from the V-Dem Institute's official GitHub csv: regime (v2x_regime), polyarchy with bounds, democratization/autocratization episode ids, start/end years and outcomes. Default returns episode years only; rows=all returns every country-year.

tools.name: Variable
tools.description: Live codebook entry for one V-Dem variable tag (question, clarification, scale, aggregation, source variables, data-release line) from v-dem.net, checked against the pinned release; a tag absent from that release is an input error naming the release that introduced or dropped it.

tools.name: Variables
tools.description: Search the V-Dem codebook (404 variables served by v-dem.net's graphing API) by tag, name or question text, filtered by thematic section, index level (high, mid, indicator, other) and the release a variable belongs to. Returns codebook metadata from a dated embedded snapshot of the official codebook entries; no live request.

tools.name: Decode vin
tools.description: Dealer inventory intake, title or listing checks: turn a 17-character VIN into structured vehicle identity. Pass model_year for partial VINs or when the 10th character is ambiguous.

tools.name: Decode vin batch
tools.description: Bulk inventory or fleet intake. NHTSA asks that large batches run at night US Eastern time or on weekends.

tools.name: Decode wmi
tools.description: Identify who built a vehicle from a VIN prefix without a full VIN, or check whether a WMI is registered with NHTSA.

tools.name: Get manufacturer
tools.description: After decode_vin (manufacturer_id) or list_manufacturers, to see who a registrant is and where they are; or to search the registry by name.

tools.name: List makes
tools.description: Discovery before list_models: find the make ID or exact make name vPIC uses. Search mode is client-side filtering of GetAllMakes and returns at most `limit` rows.

tools.name: List manufacturers
tools.description: Enumerate the registry page by page; use get_manufacturer to search by name instead.

tools.name: List models
tools.description: Enumerate what a make sold in a model year (1981+), or resolve a model ID.

tools.name: List variables
tools.description: Interpret decode_vin attributes and error codes, or enumerate the allowed values of a lookup variable.

tools.name: List wmis
tools.description: Map a manufacturer to the VIN prefixes it uses, or check which vehicle types a WMI covers.

tools.name: Details
tools.description: Read a Vrbo listing's public details by Expedia property id: name, description, bedrooms/bathrooms/sleeps, popular amenities, house rules, important info, neighborhood editorial with nearby places, map pin coordinates and the listing URL. Pass listing_id from search when known. Dates only shape date-dependent policy text.

tools.name: Locations
tools.description: Find Vrbo destination region IDs (Expedia gaia ids) for use with search. Returns regions (cities, neighborhoods, POIs, airports) with coordinates, not property-name suggestions.

tools.name: Offers
tools.description: Quote one Vrbo listing for a stay: the single-unit rate plan with numeric USD total, displayed nightly price, base/tax components, payment model, instant-book flag and cancellation text. Does not reserve or book. Dates the site reports as unavailable return available false with a null offer; unknown ids and other quote failures end in an upstream_unavailable failure with the site's message.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Search Vrbo vacation rentals in a destination for dates and guests. Returns Expedia property ids, Vrbo listing ids, listing URLs, headline, type/bedroom summary, guest rating and displayed USD nightly and stay prices. Resume with next_offset and the same criteria; results may shift between pages.

tools.name: Browse
tools.description: Enumerate a category page by page, or follow a breadcrumb id returned by an earlier call.

tools.name: Product
tools.description: Get the full record for an item found by `search`, `browse` or pasted as a walmart.com/ip/ URL.

tools.name: Reviews
tools.description: Read what buyers say about an item found by `search` or `product`.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Find Walmart products by keyword and pick a `us_item_id` for `product` or `reviews`.

tools.name: Store
tools.description: Look up a store seen in `product.location.store_id` or a walmart.com/store/ URL, or hop to nearby stores.

tools.name: Suggest
tools.description: Expand a vague shopping term into the queries Walmart itself proposes, then call `search`.

tools.name: Get job
tools.description: You have a job_id (`2-16958`), a bare eid (`16958`) or a wayfair.com/careers/job/ URL and want the complete posting text. Use search_jobs to find ids.

tools.name: List filters
tools.description: Before a filtered search_jobs call, to translate a team, category, country, state, city or job type name into its id.

tools.name: Reviews
tools.description: Collect every review of a Wayfair product (loop on next_cursor until it is null) or keep a copy current: poll with sort=newest and stop at the last review_id or date you already hold. Use the product SKU (W110562316) or a wayfair.com /pdp/ product URL.

tools.name: Search jobs
tools.description: Discovery: find Wayfair jobs by title words or filters and get their job_id for get_job. Keywords match the job title only (not the description). Use list_filters for the id vocabularies.

tools.name: Content
tools.description: Retrieve readable static text and title from an exact archived HTML capture, or the verbatim text of a plain-text, XML/RSS or JSON capture, in any declared charset. PDFs and other binary captures are rejected as invalid input. Use a timestamp from history. Reports the actual timestamp and URL after archive-only redirects. Does not execute JavaScript or load assets; maximum response 2 MiB.

tools.name: History
tools.description: Oldest indexed snapshots (default 5, maximum 20), or the snapshot closest to midnight UTC on date YYYYMMDD; earlier wins ties. One page, not a domain crawl. Replay may redirect.

tools.name: Oldest
tools.description: Find when a website first appeared in the Internet Archive, or get its oldest archived page.

tools.name: Award detail
tools.description: After search_awards, to read one award or failed-to-award notice by its base64 pk and kind (or a pasted QueryAtmAwardDetail / urlSelector atm or nonAtm URL).

tools.name: Lookup agency
tools.description: To find the org_id for search_tenders / search_awards when you know an agency's name, or to list the subordinate units of a parent code.

tools.name: Search awards
tools.description: Finding who won Taiwan public contracts, by keyword, agency, vendor tax id or date window; then call award_detail with a result's pk and kind.

tools.name: Search tenders
tools.description: Finding Taiwan public tenders by keyword, agency or case number, or listing notices published in a date window; then call tender_detail with a result's pk.

tools.name: Tender detail
tools.description: After search_tenders, to read one tender notice by its base64 pk (or a pasted searchTenderDetail / urlSelector tpam URL).

tools.name: Data
tools.description: Fetch one page of observations for a GHO indicator, filtered by spatial type (COUNTRY, REGION, WORLDBANKINCOMEGROUP, GLOBAL), ISO3/region codes, year range and Dim1/Dim2/Dim3 codes (sex, age group, ...). Each record keeps the source Id, numeric value with low/high bounds as decimal strings, the display string, comments, data source and modification date; source_updated_at is the indicator's newest modification date. Unknown indicator codes fail with not_found.

tools.name: Dimensions
tools.description: List the values of one GHO dimension (COUNTRY, REGION, WORLDBANKINCOMEGROUP, SEX, AGEGROUP, ...): code, title and parent (countries carry their WHO region). Omit dimension_code to list the dimensions themselves. Unknown dimension codes fail with not_found.

tools.name: Indicators
tools.description: Search the GHO indicator catalogue by words in the indicator name or code (case-insensitive substring; empty query lists everything). Returns one page of indicator records (code, official name, language, unit as written in the name, data URL) with a cursor for the next page.

tools.name: Article
tools.description: Read the current revision of a Wikipedia (or sister-project) article by exact title: full wikitext (or HTML with body), abstract, categories, redirects, connected Wikidata QID, license, and revision credibility signals. Use structured-contents instead when you want infobox fields, sections or references already parsed. From https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Berlin pass name `Berlin` and project `dewiki`. Not a search: titles must match exactly.

tools.name: Structured article
tools.description: Read a Wikipedia article pre-parsed into JSON: one-line description, abstract, infobox fields, sections as paragraphs and lists with links, references and tables. Best for extracting facts such as a person's birth date or a city's population without parsing HTML. Beta upstream, with the most complete coverage on en, de, fr, es, pt, it, nl, cy and id Wikipedia. Exact title, as for articles/lookup.

tools.name: Languages
tools.description: List the language codes Wikimedia projects use, with names and writing direction, to choose the language option or build a project identifier. Codes are two or three letters, sometimes with a suffix (zh-yue). Free.

tools.name: Projects
tools.description: List the Wikimedia projects available for lookup, to find the project identifier for a language and project type, such as `ptwiki` for Portuguese Wikipedia or `frwiktionary`. Free.

tools.name: Wikidata item
tools.description: Read a Wikidata item by QID: labels, descriptions and aliases in every language, all statements (property values with qualifiers and references) and links to its article on each wiki. Use for structured facts such as dates, identifiers and relationships, or to find an entity's article title in another language through sitelinks. Beta upstream; a very large item can fail.

tools.name: Wikidata labels
tools.description: Get the name of a Wikidata item or property in every language, keyed by language code. Cheaper than wikidata/item when only names are needed, for example to label the property and value IDs in a statement. Beta upstream.

tools.name: Wikidata property
tools.description: Read a Wikidata property by PID: its labels, descriptions, datatype and statements. Use to learn what a statement key in an item, such as P569, means. Beta upstream.

tools.name: Compare within parent
tools.description: 'How does this county compare with the rest of the state/nation' or 'which communities in this county are most at risk'.

tools.name: Place summary
tools.description: After search_places or wildfire_risk_for_geometry returned an id, for the published classes and ranks of that place.

tools.name: Search places
tools.description: To find the WRC id of a named town, county or tribal area before place_summary or compare_within_parent.

tools.name: Wildfire risk for geometry
tools.description: Any 'what is the wildfire risk of this parcel / paddock / lot' question. Follow with place_summary on a returned county or community id for the Explore app's risk classes.

tools.name: Get product
tools.description: Details, variants (sizes/colours) and per-variant price or stock of one product in a WooCommerce store, e.g. from a pasted product URL.

tools.name: List attributes
tools.description: Find attribute taxonomies and term slugs for search_products attribute filters, or list a store's brands/sizes/colours.

tools.name: List categories
tools.description: Navigate a WooCommerce store's catalogue and find the category id or slug to pass to search_products.

tools.name: Search products
tools.description: Product catalogue, prices or stock from a store running WooCommerce (WordPress shops on their own domain). Start here; get ids or slugs for get_product, category slugs from list_categories, attribute taxonomies and term slugs from list_attributes.

tools.name: Product
tools.description: You have a barcode (or a world.openfoodfacts.org product URL) and want its nutrition facts, ingredients, allergens or scores. Use `search` first when you only know a name or brand.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Find products by name, brand or category, e.g. 'oat milk' sold in France, then call `product` with a hit's barcode for the full record. Use `suggest` to turn a typed category or brand into the taxonomy id the filters expect.

tools.name: Suggest
tools.description: Resolve a category, brand, label or country name the user typed into the taxonomy id before filtering with `search`.

tools.name: Countries
tools.description: List the dashboard's geographies as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes with display names (164 entries incl. XKX Kosovo, TWN Taiwan Province of China, HKG Hong Kong SAR of China). Use it to resolve names before calling rankings or panel.

tools.name: Editions
tools.description: List every World Happiness Report edition (2012 onwards) with its appendix and data file downloads, the citation string and the licence note, read live from worldhappiness.report/data-sharing.

tools.name: Panel
tools.description: Gallup World Poll country-year panel for up to 10 countries (ISO3) from the dashboard country view: annual life ladder, three-year average, GDP per capita, social support, healthy life expectancy, freedom, generosity, corruption, positive/negative affect, benevolence and inequality, 2005 onwards. Only the current vintage is served; edition, if given, must match it.

tools.name: Rankings
tools.description: One page of a World Happiness Report edition's ranking table (three-year average Cantril ladder score and rank) with the six explanatory-factor shares and raw factor levels from the dashboard country view. edition N reads dashboard data year N-1. Paginate with next_cursor; filter to ISO3 codes with countries.

tools.name: Event results
tools.description: Official match results for one completed WTT/ITTF event, identified by its numeric event id (from `events`). Returns every official match with round, start time and, by default, the full match card (competitors, game scores, winner). Filter by sub-event (MS, WS, MD, WD, XD, MT, WT, XT) and round (FNL, SFNL, QFNL, 8FNL, R32, R64, RND1.., GP). Events still in progress or not yet archived return an upstream not-found error.

tools.name: Events
tools.description: Search the WTT/ITTF tournament calendar (2022 to date, including scheduled events). Input optionally narrows by season year, free-text name/city/country and three-letter association code; returns event ids (needed by event_results and match), names, tier, dates, venue and sub-events, latest first.

tools.name: Match
tools.description: One match card by event id and WTT document code (as listed by `event_results`): competitors with ITTF ids and associations, best-of, per-game points, overall score, status, venue, table, local/UTC start and duration. Unknown document codes return an upstream not-found error.

tools.name: Ranking weeks
tools.description: Published ITTF senior ranking weeks (year, week number, publication date), newest first. Input is just an optional limit; useful to learn which week the `rankings` list reflects and how often it updates.

tools.name: Rankings
tools.description: Current ITTF world ranking list. Input selects senior (SEN, default) or youth (YOU) category, the list (MS/WS singles, MD/WD/XD doubles pairs, MDI/WDI/XDI doubles individual; default MS), an optional youth age group (U19, U17, U15, U13, U11) and an optional association filter. Returns rank, previous rank, points, player or pair identity and the publication date of the week in force.

tools.name: Blue tracker
tools.description: Official Blizzard community communication (hotfixes, dev notes, forum replies). Chain `id` and `region` of a `topic` entry into `blue_tracker_topic`.

tools.name: Blue tracker news
tools.description: Read a Blizzard news article mirrored by Wowhead Blue Tracker. Accepts kind=news identifiers from blue_tracker. Returns full body HTML and original Blizzard source URL; source-relative posting text is preserved without inventing an absolute timestamp.

tools.name: Blue tracker topic
tools.description: Read the full Blizzard replies of a topic listed by `blue_tracker` (kind `topic`).

tools.name: Comment replies
tools.description: Retrieve the complete public reply array for a comment from comments_list, including replies omitted from the page preview. Supply the original page URL to preserve its game branch, and the returned comment id.

tools.name: Comments list
tools.description: Read public comments from a Wowhead guide, news article or database page. Offset pagination preserves all embedded comments, sorted by id. Retains data_tree because pages may include comments from other game versions. When replies_complete is false, call comment_replies with this URL and comment id. Null means the page does not declare a reply total. Does not assert coverage beyond the embedded public list.

tools.name: Forum topic
tools.description: Read a thread found through forum_topics, a pasted topic URL or a last_post link.

tools.name: Forum topics
tools.description: Browse or collect community discussion on a board, then read threads with forum_topic.

tools.name: Guide get
tools.description: Read a public Wowhead guide (class, build, leveling or any other category) with its complete authored body markup, author, publication/update timestamps and game version. `pages` lists the guide's own navigation (the other pages of a multi-page class guide: talent builds, rotation, stats, gear, ...), and `builds` extracts every talent build the guide references with its Blizzard import string and talent calculator link. Legacy guide links (`/guides/{slug}`) are followed to the canonical guide. Use comments_list for discussion.

tools.name: Guides search
