tools.description: Discover public WoW guides by branch, category, title query, class and specialization. Filters and offset pagination apply to the embedded guide index, sorted by id. Use branch forever for WoW Forever. Search is title substring matching, not full-text search.

tools.name: News article
tools.description: Read a news post found through `news_feed`, `news_list` or `search_suggest` (type 162) in full.

tools.name: News feed
tools.description: The quickest way to get recent Wowhead news for a game branch with exact timestamps and source links (for example WoW Forever news). Use `news_list` for paging further back or filtering by type id.

tools.name: News list
tools.description: Browse or page through Wowhead news beyond the RSS window, or filter by news type. Chain the returned `id` into `news_article`.

tools.name: Search suggest
tools.description: Resolve a name to Wowhead ids before `tooltip` or `news_article`, or discover related news and guides. An unknown term returns empty arrays, not an error.

tools.name: Tooltip
tools.description: Look up a game entity's name and tooltip by id (ids come from `search_suggest`). An id the site does not know is `not_found`.

tools.name: Bis
tools.description: Answer what gear, enchants, consumables and talents a WoW Forever character should use, e.g. a level 20 warrior: pass class, list slug (from `lists`) and level. Chain item ids into `item`.

tools.name: Item
tools.description: Look up an item from a BiS list or a user's question; ids are the game's ids, shared with Wowhead and ForeverDB.

tools.name: Lists
tools.description: Find the right list slug for `bis`, e.g. which warrior list is Arms or Fury at a level.

tools.name: Talents
tools.description: Explain a WoW Forever class's talents or what changed from Classic; pair with the builds from `bis`.

tools.name: Inspect a post
tools.description: Analyze a known public post with X Search thread fetch; exact retrieval must be live verified.

tools.name: Search posts
tools.description: Research public X posts with a sourced summary and structured evidence; not exact recent-search pagination.

tools.name: Inspect a profile
tools.description: Research one public X profile using Grok user search; unknown metrics remain null.

tools.name: Research account posts
tools.description: Analyze a sample of posts from one account, with a date range. Not a complete paginated timeline.

tools.name: Convert
tools.description: A single pair's current rate or a converted amount. For many quotes against one base use live_rates; for a past date use historical_table.

tools.name: Currency profile
tools.description: Reference facts about a currency. For rates use convert, live_rates or historical_table.

tools.name: Historical table
tools.description: What a rate was on a given day, or a whole day's table. For a time series of one pair use rate_history.

tools.name: List currencies
tools.description: Discover valid codes and slugs before calling the other functions.

tools.name: Live rates
tools.description: Many rates against one base in one call. For one pair with statistics use convert.

tools.name: Rate history
tools.description: Charting or trend analysis of one pair. For a single past date across all currencies use historical_table.

tools.name: Batches
tools.description: List every batch label published in the public YC directory with its company count, newest first. Use a returned batch label as the search batch filter.

tools.name: Company
tools.description: Read a public YC company profile: description, batch, location, team size, source-reported status and the founders listed on the profile (name, title, bio, LinkedIn and X/Twitter links).

tools.name: Jobs
tools.description: List public jobs advertised on a YC company profile, including source salary text, location, role and requirements. Each record adds best-effort structured locations, a remote/hybrid/onsite flag and ISO country codes parsed from the location text, plus the source role slug, skills, posting age, apply link and batch. No application or contact actions.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Browse or search the public YC company directory. Query is optional: omit it to list every company matching the exact source labels for batch (e.g. Summer 2025), industry, region, status and tag, or the hiring, top company and nonprofit flags. Twenty entries per zero-based page, at most fifty pages.

tools.name: Read YouTube video
tools.description: Read video metadata, description and any available transcript. Transcript availability is not guaranteed. Not channel listings, comments or timestamped captions. Scrape pricing per successful attempt: 1 credit base, plus 4 for audio and 4 for video (5 for either, 9 for both), before other Scrape surcharges. The wrapper adds no charge; underlying Scrape requests are billed separately at their current rate. Invalid YouTube Markdown may trigger one fresh Scrape call.

tools.name: Building
tools.description: Details and unit availability for one building URL from rental_search (is_building = true). Single homes and units use rental.

tools.name: Comparables
tools.description: Zillow home valuation comparables, distinct from nearby homes.

tools.name: Locations
tools.description: Resolve text into region or other typed suggestions. Results vary by type and do not include a bounding box; pass region_id (or region_ids[0]) with region_types[0] / region_subtype straight to search, which accepts a region alone and returns the region's bounds. Do not treat every suggestion id as a property zpid.

tools.name: Map
tools.description: Property/building clusters in a small map viewport (at most 0.1 degrees per axis). Each card carries only what Zillow's safelisted map document returns: zpid, url, status, price, currency, tax_assessed_value, coordinates, provider_listing_id and community/subdivision. Call property with the zpid for beds, baths, areas, home type, photos and the street address.

tools.name: Nearby
tools.description: Nearby property cards, including off-market homes.

tools.name: Price history
tools.description: Public listing and sale price events, timestamps and changes.

tools.name: Property
tools.description: Property facts, original photos, price/tax history, schools and nearby homes; optionally fetch scores and valuation data in the same session.

tools.name: Rental
tools.description: Details for one rental identified by zpid or /homedetails/ URL from rental_search (is_building = false). For apartment communities use building.

tools.name: Rental search
tools.description: Discovery of rentals by area and filters; pass next_cursor back as cursor for later pages. Use rental for one listing and building for one apartment community.

tools.name: Schools
tools.description: Nearby and assigned schools remain distinct, with ratings, grade levels and distance in miles.

tools.name: Scores
tools.description: Walk, transit and bike scores; unavailable scores are null.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Find for-sale listings in a region or a map box. Chain from locations: pass its region_id (or region_ids[0]) as region_id and its region_types[0] / region_subtype as region_type; bounds are then optional and the response's pages[].region.bounds carries the region's box for map or a narrower search. Alternatively supply bounds as {west, east, south, north} in longitude/latitude degrees. Rental listings are not supported by this search.

tools.name: Tax history
tools.description: Tax payment and assessed-value history with provider timestamps.

tools.name: Value history
tools.description: Named valuation chart series. Point timestamps are Unix milliseconds; null values remain null.

tools.name: Zori
tools.description: Market-level rent index questions (median asking rent over time, YoY rent change for a metro/city/county/ZIP). Not for individual listings: use rental_search, rental or building for those. Resolve ambiguous names with the state (`Springfield, IL`) or pass the Zillow RegionID.

tools.name: Company jobs
tools.description: After search_jobs, with the company slug from a card's company_url (e.g. YO-AI-Labs from /co/YO-AI-Labs/Jobs) and a city.

tools.name: Job
tools.description: After search_jobs or company_jobs, with a card's url. Any pasted ziprecruiter.com /c/.../Job/... URL with a jid works.

tools.name: Salary
tools.description: Pay benchmark for a title and city; not a posting's pay (that is on the job card).

tools.name: Search jobs
tools.description: Start here to find job detail URLs and company slugs; pass page=next_page to continue. Filter by posting date (posted_within_days) and annual pay floor (min_annual_pay); title and city/state select the page. Distance, employment-type and location-type filters are not exposed.

tools.name: Suggest locations
tools.description: Resolve a place name to the "City, ST" form that search_jobs, company_jobs and salary take. An unknown prefix returns an empty list.

tools.name: Suggest titles
tools.description: Normalize free text into a title ZipRecruiter knows before search_jobs or salary. An unknown prefix returns an empty list.

tools.name: Class guide
tools.description: Answer what changed for a class in WoW Forever, which talents are new or gone, or whether Zockify has published builds for it yet.

tools.name: Gear items
tools.description: Answer which items are best for a WoW Forever character's slot at its level (for example `level 20 warrior head`), or list upgrade options. Without `preset` the class's first preset is used (warrior: Fury Warrior); get preset ids from `stat_weights`. An unknown preset id is `not_found`.

tools.name: Stat weights
tools.description: Answer which stats matter most for a WoW Forever class or role (stat priority), or pick a `preset` id for `gear_items`. Pass a class to get only its presets; omit it for all of them.

tools.name: Talents
tools.description: Answer what talents a WoW Forever class has, what a talent does at each rank, or plan a build (one point per level from 10, every 5 points in a tree open the next row). Talent trees were reworked for Forever, so Classic talent guides do not apply.
